```dart
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/authoring.dart'
    show
        Catalog,
        CatalogCircle,
        CatalogLine,
        CatalogPolyline,
        CatalogSymbol,
        CatalogUnit,
        encodeLibrary;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/symbol_fixtures.dart';

/// A round table whose served top (its circle, the first leaf) is smaller
/// than its box (a line across it), and a shelf whose first leaf is a line.
final Catalog pbCatalog = Catalog(kit: 'pb', symbols: [
  const CatalogSymbol(
    key: 'pb.table.round',
    name: 'Round table',
    category: 'Tables',
    tags: ['table'],
    unit: CatalogUnit(kind: UnitKinds.table, capacity: 4),
    base: (2100.5, 1300.25),
    shapes: [
      CatalogCircle((2100.5, 1300.25), 450),
      CatalogLine((1400.5, 1300.25), (2800.5, 1300.25)),
    ],
  ),
  const CatalogSymbol(
    key: 'pb.shelf.plain',
    name: 'Plain shelf',
    category: 'Storage',
    tags: ['shelf'],
    base: (610.75, 205.5),
    shapes: [
      CatalogLine((110.75, 405.5), (1110.75, 405.5)),
      CatalogPolyline(
          [(160.75, 5.5), (1060.75, 5.5), (1060.75, 355.5), (160.75, 355.5)],
          closed: true),
    ],
  ),
]);

PlanKit pbKit() => symbolKit('pb', [
      SymbolLibrarySource(label: 'pb', read: () async => encodeLibrary(pbCatalog)),
    ]);

const String table = 'pb.table.round@1';

PlanController make(List<PlanKit> kits) {
  final c = PlanController(kits: kits);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return c;
}

List<double> boxOf(Aabb2 b) => [b.minX, b.minY, b.maxX, b.maxY];

/// The definitions of [d] carrying [key]'s jetcad.symbol.
List<Handle> definitionsOf(DraftDocument d, String key) => [
      for (final h in d.components.withComponent<SymbolComponent>())
        if (d.components.get<SymbolComponent>(h)!.key == key &&
            d.tree.definition(h) != null)
          h,
    ];

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  test(
      'PB-def-twice two calls for one key before its add executes: one ref, '
      'from any kit\'s services; executed once, through the document, the '
      'next call adds nothing', () async {
    final c = make([pbKit(), demoKit()]);
    await settle();
    final s = c.servicesOf('pb');
    final d = c.document;
    final one = s.symbolDefinition(table)!;
    expect(one.add, isA<CompoundCommand>());
    expect(d.tree.definition(one.handle), isNull, reason: 'not added yet');
    // M-PB1: no ref kept pending (each call copies anew).
    expect(identical(s.symbolDefinition(table), one), isTrue);
    // M-PB2: the pending refs kept per kit's services.
    expect(identical(c.servicesOf('demo').symbolDefinition(table), one),
        isTrue);

    // A tool's commit executes straight through the document.
    d.commands.execute(one.add!);
    expect(d.tree.definition(one.handle), isNotNull);
    expect(d.components.get<UnitComponent>(one.handle),
        UnitComponent(kind: UnitKinds.table, capacity: 4));
    final again = s.symbolDefinition(table)!;
    // M-PB3: a pending ref kept after the document holds its definition
    // (its add handed out again).
    expect(again.add, isNull);
    expect(again.handle, one.handle);
    expect(definitionsOf(d, 'pb.table.round'), [one.handle]);
  });

  test(
      'PB-def-execute a controller execute, and a new plan, drop the '
      'pending refs: the next call is a new copy', () async {
    final c = make([pbKit()]);
    await settle();
    final s = c.servicesOf('pb');
    final d = c.document;
    final one = s.symbolDefinition(table)!;
    expect(
        c.execute(addDrafted(d, EntityKind.line,
            linePayload(Vector2(-3100.5, 4200.25), Vector2(-1700.75, 5100.5)),
            layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero)),
        isTrue);
    final next = s.symbolDefinition(table)!;
    // M-PB4: `execute` not clearing the pending refs.
    expect(identical(next, one), isFalse);
    expect(next.add, isNotNull);
    expect(next.handle, isNot(one.handle), reason: 'new handles from the seed');

    c.newPlan();
    final fresh = s.symbolDefinition(table)!;
    // M-PB5: `_open` not clearing them (the old document's handles).
    expect(identical(fresh, next), isFalse);
    expect(fresh.add, isNotNull);
    expect(c.document.tree.definition(fresh.handle), isNull);
  });

  test(
      'PB-def-top the base point, and the top: the first leaf\'s box for a '
      'circle or a closed outline, else the definition\'s box', () async {
    final c = make([pbKit()]);
    await settle();
    final s = c.servicesOf('pb');
    final round = s.symbolDefinition(table)!;
    expect(round.basePoint, Vector2(2100.5, 1300.25));
    // M-PB6: the top always the definition's box.
    expect(boxOf(round.top), [1650.5, 850.25, 2550.5, 1750.25]);
    final shelf = s.symbolDefinition('pb.shelf.plain@1')!;
    expect(shelf.basePoint, Vector2(610.75, 205.5));
    // M-PB7: any first leaf taken as the top (the shelf's line).
    expect(boxOf(shelf.top), [110.75, 5.5, 1110.75, 405.5]);
    // The base point is the ref's own: writing it leaves the library as is.
    shelf.basePoint.x = 0;
    expect(c.symbolById('pb.shelf.plain@1')!.entry.definition.basePoint,
        Vector2(610.75, 205.5));
  });

  test(
      'PB-def-null null for a key no loaded library has, and while loading; '
      'symbolsState is the controller\'s, failed included', () async {
    final c = make([pbKit()]);
    final s = c.servicesOf('pb');
    // M-PB8: the services' own listenable (a ValueNotifier(ready)).
    expect(identical(s.symbolsState, c.symbolsState), isTrue);
    expect(s.symbolsState.value, SymbolsState.loading);
    expect(s.symbolDefinition(table), isNull, reason: 'still loading');
    await settle();
    expect(s.symbolsState.value, SymbolsState.ready);
    expect(s.symbolDefinition('pb.table.round@9'), isNull);
    expect(s.symbolDefinition('pb.table.round'), isNull,
        reason: 'a full versioned key only');
    expect(s.symbolDefinition('pb.chair.none@1'), isNull);
    expect(s.symbolDefinition(table), isNotNull);

    final f = make([
      symbolKit('pb', [
        SymbolLibrarySource(
            label: 'pb', read: () async => throw StateError('offline')),
      ]),
    ]);
    await settle();
    expect(f.servicesOf('pb').symbolsState.value, SymbolsState.failed);
    expect(f.servicesOf('pb').symbolDefinition(table), isNull);
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: The served top.** In `lib/src/symbols/symbol_box.dart`, after `boxOfEntry` (line 128), add:

```dart
/// The served top of [entry] in its definition's coordinates (spec 2b S2,
/// `SymbolDefinitionRef.top`): its first leaf's box when that leaf is a
/// circle or a closed polyline (today's `tableTopOf`,
/// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/service/table_picker.dart:92-110), else the
/// symbol's box ([boxOfEntry]); empty when no leaf draws. The entry's
/// leaves are ascending by handle, so the first is the lowest.
Aabb2 servedTopOfEntry(SymbolEntry entry) {
  final all = boxOfEntry(entry);
  final whole = all == null ? Aabb2.empty() : footprintOf(all);
  if (entry.leaves.isEmpty) return whole;
  final first = entry.leaves.first;
  final kind = first.record.kind;
  final served = kind == EntityKind.circle ||
      (kind == EntityKind.polyline && isClosedPolyline(first.payload));
  if (!served) return whole;
  final top = boxOfLeaves([(kind, first.payload)]);
  return top == null ? whole : footprintOf(top);
}
```

```dart
  /// Spec 2b S2. A pending ref is handed out again until the document holds
  /// its definition (its `add` executed, by whatever path), the controller
  /// executes a command, or the document is replaced; a ref whose
  /// definition the document holds is made afresh, with no `add`.
  @override
  SymbolDefinitionRef? symbolDefinition(String key) {
    final pending = _host.pendingDefinitions;
    final document = this.document;
    final kept = pending[key];
    if (kept != null) {
      if (document.tree.definition(kept.handle) == null) return kept;
      pending.remove(key);
    }
    final entry = _host.symbolById(key)?.entry;
    if (entry == null) return null;
    final made = definitionForEntry(document, entry);
    final ref = SymbolDefinitionRef(
      handle: made.definition,
      add: made.commands.isEmpty
          ? null
          : CompoundCommand(made.commands, label: 'Add ${entry.symbol.name}'),
      basePoint: entry.definition.basePoint.clone(),
      top: servedTopOfEntry(entry),
    );
    if (ref.add != null) pending[key] = ref;
    return ref;
  }

  @override
  ValueListenable<SymbolsState> get symbolsState => _host.symbolsState;
```

    - `typedef ServiceFixture = ({String json, Handle table, Handle tableLabel, Handle tableDefinition, Handle seatDefinition, Handle rowA, List<Handle> seatsA, Handle rowB, List<Handle> seatsB})`; `ServiceFixture serviceFixture()`.
    - `SymbolEntry testEntry(String id)`, `Handle addRow(DraftDocument d, RowComponent row, {required Vector2 at, double angle = 0})`, `List<Handle> rowsOf(DraftDocument d)`, `List<Handle> seatsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle row)`, `List<(Handle, String)> unitLabelsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle instance)`, `Handle labelPlacedUnit(DraftDocument d, Handle instance, SymbolEntry entry, String text)`, `void expectUprightLabel(DraftDocument d, Handle label, Transform2 instanceToWorld)`.

Plan decision (`testKit()` stays as 2a left it): `testKit()` is called 74 times in 11 test files outside `test/support` (`grep -rn "testKit(" test | grep -v support`), among them `TK1`, which pins the words to English and Turkish with one key set (`test/kits/test_kits_test.dart:14-23`), and symbol, tool and lifetime tests that a new library, type or tool would shift. The units come only with `testKit(units: true)`, spelled `unitKit()`. It is the same kit id, `test`, so `unit:test/booth` is the test kit's word.

Plan decision (`test.row` is seats only): its `generate` returns no entity. A seats-only row is the case spec S2's selection rules discuss: the design's click maps a seat to the row, a crossing band takes the row through the seats' ATTRIBs, and a window band over a seats-only row takes nothing (decision 9). A thin row line would hide the last of these.

Plan decision (the row's geometry): seat `i` (0-based) sits on a chord walk of `spacing`, turning by `curve` radians per seat (`curve = 0`: a straight row along the group's +x). With `R = spacing / (2 sin(curve / 2))`, seat `i` is at `(R sin(i·curve), R (1 − cos(i·curve)))`, turned by `i·curve`; its transform is `translate(position) · rotate(i·curve) · translate(−base)`, so the seat's base point lands on the position, as `placementTransform` does (`symbol_placer.dart:48-67`). The component holds the seat definition's handle, base point and top, from `symbolDefinition` (spec S1 "The definition"), so `instances` reads only its own parameters (spec S1).

Plan decision (the free prefix, spec S2 "Uniqueness across objects is the placing tool's"): a prefix `P` is free for a row of `N` seats when none of `P1`…`PN` is the trimmed text of a live `UNIT` ATTRIB in `PlanServices.document`. The prefixes are tried in the order `A`, `B`, …, `Z`, `AA`, `AB`, …. A second check on the rows' own prefixes would be redundant: a live row of prefix `P` always holds `P1`. `UnitIndex` is Task 6's, so the tool reads the ATTRIBs directly.

Plan decision (the row tool): two presses, as the slab tool (`test/support/test_kit.dart:296-344`). The first anchors the row and the second turns it towards the press. On the second press the tool checks the permissions, then calls `symbolDefinition(rowSeatKey)` once (spec S2: "a tool calls it once per placement, never per preview"). Null (libraries loading or failed) places nothing. Otherwise it executes one `CompoundCommand`: the ref's `add` when present, then the row. It has no preview and no letter.

```dart
// table, the seat and the booth symbols, the row type generating labelled
// seats through E5, its tool placing rows through symbolDefinition with the
// first free prefix, and the service fixture later tasks stand on. Rows are
// turned and placed off the origin; the camera is turned and flipped.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/authoring.dart'
    show conformance, encodeLibrary, encodeSnapshot, geometrySnapshot;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show
        KitNames,
        KitProblemCode,
        SymbolComponent,
        SymbolsState,
        UnitComponent,
        UnitKinds,
        UnitLabelling;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart' show PlanController;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/symbols/symbol_placer.dart'
    show placeSymbol;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/harness.dart';
import '../support/service_fixture.dart';
import '../support/symbol_fixtures.dart' show settle;
import '../support/test_kit.dart';
import '../support/tool_events.dart';

const Tolerance exact = Tolerance(linear: 0, angular: 0);

/// Every live UNIT ATTRIB's trimmed text in [d], ascending by handle.
List<String> allLabels(DraftDocument d) {
  final e = d.entities;
  final found = <(Handle, String)>[
    for (final s in e.liveSlots)
      if (e.kindAt(s) == EntityKind.attrib && e.tagAt(s) == 'UNIT')
        (e.handleAt(s), e.textAt(s).trim()),
  ]..sort((a, b) => a.$1.value.compareTo(b.$1.value));
  return [for (final f in found) f.$2];
}

/// One row placed with the row tool: a press at [from], one at [to].
Handle placeRowWithTool(PlanController c, Vector2 from, Vector2 to) {
  final before = rowsOf(c.document).toSet();
  expect(c.selectTool(rowToolId), isTrue);
  tapAt(c, from);
  tapAt(c, to);
  return rowsOf(c.document).singleWhere((r) => !before.contains(r));
}

    expect((units[tableSymbolId]!.kind, units[tableSymbolId]!.capacity),
        (UnitKinds.table, 4));
    expect(units[tableSymbolId]!.labelling, UnitLabelling.numbered);
    expect((units[rowSeatKey]!.kind, units[rowSeatKey]!.capacity),
        (UnitKinds.seat, 1));
    expect(units[rowSeatKey]!.labelling, UnitLabelling.assigned);
    expect((units[boothSymbolId]!.kind, units[boothSymbolId]!.capacity),

    expect(kit.names.words['en']!['unit:test/booth'], 'Booth');
```

```dart
      names: units ? testWords.merge(testUnitWords) : testWords,
    );

/// The test kit with its units (2b): `testKit(units: true)`.
PlanKit unitKit({KitLog? log}) => testKit(log: log, units: true);
```

```dart
/// A row of [count] seats of the definition [seat] (its [base] point and
/// [top] box, from `PlanServices.symbolDefinition`), [spacing] mm apart,
/// turning [curve] radians a seat, labelled `<prefix>1` to `<prefix>N`.
@immutable
final class RowComponent implements Component {
  /// Throws [ArgumentError] for a prefix over 8 code units or with a
  /// control character, a count outside 1 to 999, a spacing that is not
  /// finite and above 0, a curve that is not finite or reaches ±π, and a
  /// base point that is not finite.
  RowComponent({
    required this.prefix,
    required this.count,
    required this.spacing,
    this.curve = 0,
    required this.seat,
    required Vector2 base,
    required this.top,
  }) : base = Vector2.copy(base) {
    if (prefix.length > 8 ||
        prefix.codeUnits.any((u) => u < 0x20 || (u >= 0x7F && u <= 0x9F))) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(prefix, 'prefix',
          'must be at most 8 code units, no control character');
    }
    if (count < 1 || count > 999) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(count, 'count', 'must be 1 to 999');
    }
    if (!spacing.isFinite || spacing <= 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
          spacing, 'spacing', 'must be finite and above 0');
    }
    if (!curve.isFinite || curve.abs() >= math.pi) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(curve, 'curve', 'must be finite, below π');
    }
    if (!this.base.x.isFinite || !this.base.y.isFinite) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(base, 'base', 'must be finite');
    }
  }

  static const String componentTypeId = rowTypeId;

  final String prefix;
  final int count;
  final double spacing;
  final double curve;
  final Handle seat;
  final Vector2 base;
  final Aabb2 top;

  @override
  String get typeId => componentTypeId;

  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
        'base': [base.x, base.y],
        'count': count,
        'curve': curve,
        'prefix': prefix,
        'seat': seat.toJson(),
        'spacing': spacing,
        'top': [top.minX, top.minY, top.maxX, top.maxY],
      };

  static RowComponent fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final base = (json['base']! as List).cast<num>();
    final top = (json['top']! as List).cast<num>();
    return RowComponent(
      prefix: json['prefix']! as String,
      count: json['count']! as int,
      spacing: (json['spacing']! as num).toDouble(),
      curve: (json['curve']! as num).toDouble(),
      seat: Handle.fromJson(json['seat']),
      base: Vector2(base[0].toDouble(), base[1].toDouble()),
      top: Aabb2.raw(top[0].toDouble(), top[1].toDouble(), top[2].toDouble(),
          top[3].toDouble()),
    );
  }

  RowComponent copyWith(
          {String? prefix, int? count, double? spacing, double? curve}) =>
      RowComponent(
        prefix: prefix ?? this.prefix,
        count: count ?? this.count,
        spacing: spacing ?? this.spacing,
        curve: curve ?? this.curve,
        seat: seat,
        base: base,
        top: top,
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is RowComponent &&
      other.prefix == prefix &&
      other.count == count &&
      other.spacing == spacing &&
      other.curve == curve &&
      other.seat == seat &&
      other.base.x == base.x &&
      other.base.y == base.y &&
      other.top.minX == top.minX &&
      other.top.minY == top.minY &&
      other.top.maxX == top.maxX &&
      other.top.maxY == top.maxY;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(prefix, count, spacing, curve, seat, base.x,
      base.y, top.minX, top.minY, top.maxX, top.maxY);

  @override
  String toString() => 'RowComponent($prefix × $count @ $spacing, $curve)';
}

/// Seat [i] (0-based) of [row] in the row's group space: a chord walk of
/// `spacing`, turning `curve` a seat; the seat's base point on its place.
Transform2 rowSeatTransform(RowComponent row, int i) {
  final theta = i * row.curve;
  final double x, y;
  if (row.curve == 0) {
    x = i * row.spacing;
    y = 0;
  } else {
    final r = row.spacing / (2 * math.sin(row.curve / 2));
    x = r * math.sin(theta);
    y = r * (1 - math.cos(theta));
  }
  final c = math.cos(theta), s = math.sin(theta);
  return Transform2.translation(x, y)
      .multiply(Transform2(c, s, -s, c, 0, 0))
      .multiply(Transform2.translation(-row.base.x, -row.base.y));
}

/// The row's engine type: seats only (spec 2b "The test kit"; the
/// selection rules of S2 discuss a seats-only row), each labelled through
/// the kit's `unitLabelAttrib`.
final class RowType extends ParametricType<RowComponent> {
  const RowType();

  @override
  Capability get editCapability => Capability.geometry;

  /// The seats' tops, in the world.
  @override
  Aabb2 reach(RowComponent params, Transform2 toWorld) {
    final t = params.top;
    return Aabb2.fromPoints([
      for (var i = 0; i < params.count; i++)
        for (final (x, y) in [
          (t.minX, t.minY),
          (t.maxX, t.minY),
          (t.maxX, t.maxY),
          (t.minX, t.maxY),
        ])
          toWorld
              .multiply(rowSeatTransform(params, i))
              .transformPoint(Vector2(x, y)),
    ]);
  }

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) => const [];

  @override
  List<GeneratedInstance> instances(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    final row = view.paramsOf<RowComponent>(self)!;
    final toWorld = view.toWorld(self);
    final out = <GeneratedInstance>[];
    for (var i = 0; i < row.count; i++) {
      final seat = rowSeatTransform(row, i);
      out.add(GeneratedInstance(row.seat, seat, attributes: [
        unitLabelAttrib('${row.prefix}${i + 1}',
            instanceToWorld: toWorld.multiply(seat),
            anchor: row.base,
            top: row.top),
      ]));
    }
    return out;
  }
}

/// The first free prefix for a row of [count] seats in [d] (spec S2: the
/// placing tool's job): `A`, `B`, …, `Z`, `AA`, `AB`, …, the first `P` for
/// which none of `P1` to `P<count>` is the trimmed text of a live UNIT
/// ATTRIB. O(entities), once per placement.
String freeRowPrefix(DraftDocument d, int count) {
  final e = d.entities;
  final labels = <String>{
    for (final s in e.liveSlots)
      if (e.kindAt(s) == EntityKind.attrib && e.tagAt(s) == kUnitLabelTag)
        e.textAt(s).trim(),
  };
  for (var n = 0;; n++) {
    final prefix = _letters(n);
    var free = true;
    for (var i = 1; i <= count && free; i++) {
      if (labels.contains('$prefix$i')) free = false;
    }
    if (free) return prefix;
  }
}

/// 0 → A, 25 → Z, 26 → AA: bijective base 26.
String _letters(int n) {
  var k = n + 1;
  final codes = <int>[];
  while (k > 0) {
    k--;
    codes.add(0x41 + k % 26);
    k ~/= 26;
  }
  return String.fromCharCodes(codes.reversed);
}

/// A root-level group at [at] turned by [angle], carrying [row] and the
/// drawing layer: one step (the seats come from the row's regeneration).
CompoundCommand placeRowCommand(DraftDocument d, RowComponent row,
    {required Vector2 at, double angle = 0, Handle? handle}) {
  final h = handle ?? d.handleSeed.next();
  return CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: h,
        parent: d.rootHandle,
        transform: Transform2.translation(at.x, at.y)
            .multiply(Transform2.rotation(angle)),
        children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<RowComponent>(h, row),
    SetComponentCommand<ObjectLayer>(h, ObjectLayer(drawingLayer(d))),
  ], label: 'Add row');
}

/// The definition's top, as `SymbolDefinitionRef.top` gives it (spec S2):
/// the first leaf's box when it is a closed polyline or a circle, else the
/// leaves' vertex box. The unit library's entries all take the first
/// branch.
Aabb2 entryTop(SymbolEntry entry) {
  if (entry.leaves.isEmpty) return Aabb2.empty();
  final first = entry.leaves.first;
  final p = first.payload;
  if (first.record.kind == EntityKind.circle) {
    final r = p.scalars[0];
    return Aabb2.raw(
        p.coords[0] - r, p.coords[1] - r, p.coords[0] + r, p.coords[1] + r);
  }
  if (first.record.kind == EntityKind.polyline && isClosedPolyline(p)) {
    return Aabb2.fromPoints([for (var i = 0; i < p.pointCount; i++) p.pointAt(i)]);
  }
  return Aabb2.fromPoints([
    for (final l in entry.leaves)
      for (var i = 0; i < l.payload.pointCount; i++) l.payload.pointAt(i),
  ]);
}

/// What a row placement needs.
const Set<Capability> rowNeeds = {
  Capability.structure,
  Capability.components,
  Capability.geometry,
};

/// Two presses: the first anchors the row, the second turns it towards the
/// press and places a row of [kRowToolSeats] seats with the first free
/// prefix, through `symbolDefinition` once.
final class RowTool extends PlacementTool {
  RowTool(this.services);

  final PlanServices services;

  @override
  String get name => 'Row';

  @override
  void accept(Vector2 point, ToolContext ctx) {
    if (points.isEmpty) {
      points.add(point);
      return;
    }
    final start = points.first;
    final d = point - start;
    if (d.length <= Tolerance.standard.linear) return;
    clearShape();
    // The permissions first: a refused row allocates no handle (Ruling
    // 05-3), then the definition, once per placement (spec S2).
    if (!rowNeeds.every(ctx.document.commands.permissions.allows)) return;
    final ref = services.symbolDefinition(rowSeatKey);
    if (ref == null) return;
    final document = services.document;
    ctx.execute(CompoundCommand([
      if (ref.add case final add?) add,
      placeRowCommand(
          document,
          RowComponent(
              prefix: freeRowPrefix(document, kRowToolSeats),
              count: kRowToolSeats,
              spacing: kRowToolSpacing,
              seat: ref.handle,
              base: ref.basePoint,
              top: ref.top),
          at: start,
          angle: math.atan2(d.y, d.x)),
    ], label: 'Add row'));
  }

  @override
  void paintRubberBand(Canvas canvas, Vector2 origin, double scale) {}
}

PlanType<RowComponent> rowType() => PlanType<RowComponent>(
      id: rowTypeId,
      fromJson: RowComponent.fromJson,
      parametric: const RowType(),
    );

PlanTool rowTool() => PlanTool(
      id: rowToolId,
      icon: Icons.event_seat,
      needs: rowNeeds,
      create: RowTool.new,
    );
```

  `_letters` uses `StringBuffer.writeCharCodes`; `math`, `Vector2`, `Icons`, `Canvas` are already imported (`:12-18`).

```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';

    show definitionForEntry, placeSymbol;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'harness.dart';
import 'test_kit.dart';

typedef ServiceFixture = ({
  String json,
  Handle table,
  Handle tableLabel,
  Handle tableDefinition,
  Handle seatDefinition,
  Handle rowA,

  Handle rowB,

final SymbolLibrary _library = SymbolLibrary.decode(testUnitLibraryBytes());

/// The unit library's entry [id] (`key@version`).
SymbolEntry testEntry(String id) =>
    _library.entries.firstWhere((e) => e.id == id);

/// [placeRowCommand], executed; the row's handle.
Handle addRow(DraftDocument d, RowComponent row,
    {required Vector2 at, double angle = 0}) {
  final h = d.handleSeed.next();
  d.commands.execute(placeRowCommand(d, row, at: at, angle: angle, handle: h));
  return h;
}

/// The live rows of [d], ascending.
List<Handle> rowsOf(DraftDocument d) => [
      for (final h in d.components.withComponent<RowComponent>())
        if (d.tree[h] is GroupNode) h,
    ]..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));

/// [row]'s instance children, ascending: its seats.
List<Handle> seatsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle row) => [
      for (final h in (d.tree[row]! as GroupNode).children)
        if (d.tree[h] is InstanceNode) h,
    ]..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));

/// [instance]'s UNIT ATTRIBs, (handle, text), ascending by handle.
List<(Handle, String)> unitLabelsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle instance) {
  final e = d.entities;
  return [
    for (final s in e.liveSlots)
      if (e.ownerAt(s) == instance &&
          e.kindAt(s) == EntityKind.attrib &&
          e.tagAt(s) == kUnitLabelTag)
        (e.handleAt(s), e.textAt(s)),
  ]..sort((a, b) => a.$1.value.compareTo(b.$1.value));
}

/// Adds [text] as the UNIT label of the placed [instance] of [entry], as
/// today's placement shapes it (layer 0, BYBLOCK, centred, the stamp for
/// the instance's transform, the height of the entry's top): executed; the
/// label's handle.
Handle labelPlacedUnit(
    DraftDocument d, Handle instance, SymbolEntry entry, String text) {
  final node = d.tree[instance]! as InstanceNode;
  final h = d.handleSeed.next();
  d.commands.execute(AddEntityCommand(
    record: EntityRecord(
      handle: h,
      owner: instance,
      kind: EntityKind.attrib,
      layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero,
      linetype: ReservedHandles.byBlockLinetype,
      linetypeScale: 1.0,
      geomIndex: 0,
      color: const ByBlockColor(),
      lineweight: kByBlock,
      transparency: kByBlock,
      flags: 0,
      text: text,
      tag: kUnitLabelTag,
      textStyle: ReservedHandles.standardTextStyle,
      textAttrs: kUnitLabelTextAttrs,
    ),
    payload: unitLabelPayload(
        anchor: entry.definition.basePoint,
        height: unitLabelHeight(entryTop(entry)),
        instanceToWorld: node.transform),
  ));
  return h;
}

/// The label [label]'s world linear map under [instanceToWorld] is the
/// identity: it reads upright and unmirrored, whatever the instance's turn.
void expectUprightLabel(
    DraftDocument d, Handle label, Transform2 instanceToWorld) {
  final p =
      d.geometry.read(d.entities.geomIndexAt(d.entities.slotOf(label)!));
  final t = instanceToWorld;
  final w = Transform2(t.a, t.b, t.c, t.d, 0, 0)
      .multiply(Transform2.rotation(p.scalars[1]))
      .multiply(Transform2.scale(p.scalars[2], 1));
  expect([w.a, w.b, w.c, w.d], [
    closeTo(1, 1e-12),
    closeTo(0, 1e-12),
    closeTo(0, 1e-12),
    closeTo(1, 1e-12),
  ]);
}

ServiceFixture serviceFixture() {
  late Handle table, tableLabel, tableDefinition, seatDefinition, rowA, rowB;
  late List<Handle> seatsA, seatsB;
  final json = planText([unitKit()], (d) {
    final tableEntry = testEntry(tableSymbolId);
    final before = {for (final n in d.tree.nodes) n.handle};
    d.commands.execute(placeSymbol(d, tableEntry,
        at: Vector2(-2400.5, 3100.25), quarterTurns: 1, mirrored: true));
    final placed = d.tree.nodes
        .whereType<InstanceNode>()
        .singleWhere((n) => !before.contains(n.handle));
    table = placed.handle;
    tableDefinition = placed.definition;
    tableLabel = labelPlacedUnit(d, table, tableEntry, '12');

    final seatEntry = testEntry(rowSeatKey);
    final made = definitionForEntry(d, seatEntry);
    d.commands.execute(CompoundCommand(made.commands, label: 'Seat'));
    seatDefinition = made.definition;
    RowComponent row(String prefix, int count, double spacing, double curve) =>
        RowComponent(
            prefix: prefix,
            count: count,
            spacing: spacing,
            curve: curve,
            seat: seatDefinition,
            base: seatEntry.definition.basePoint,
            top: entryTop(seatEntry));
    rowA = addRow(d, row('A', 6, 600, 0),
        at: Vector2(5200.5, -3100.25), angle: 0.35);
    rowB = addRow(d, row('B', 5, 650, 0.18), at: Vector2(-4800.75, -2600.5));
    seatsA = seatsOf(d, rowA);
    seatsB = seatsOf(d, rowB);
  });
  return (
    json: json,
    table: table,
    tableLabel: tableLabel,
    tableDefinition: tableDefinition,
    seatDefinition: seatDefinition,
    rowA: rowA,
    seatsA: seatsA,
    rowB: rowB,
    seatsB: seatsB,
  );
}
```

Plan decision (`UnitIndex.diagnostics()` returns the engine's `Diagnostic`, not `KitDiagnostic`): controller ruling R-8 (`KitDiagnosticCode` is an enum with no `unit.*` value, `jet_cad_2d_kit/lib/src/kit/kit_diagnostic.dart:9-44`; today's `TableSurvey.diagnostics()` returns `Diagnostic`, `table_index.dart:159-225`). The task is written with `List<Diagnostic> diagnostics()`.

Plan decision (the unit predicate, spec S2 "A unit"): a live `InstanceNode` whose definition is live and carries `UnitComponent`, and whose parent is the root (placed) or a root-level `GroupNode` that is a registered type's object (`catalog.typeIdOf != null`) or a lock-set object (`locks.isLockedObject`) (generated, `owner` that group). Any other such instance is `nested`. `ownerType` is the type id, or for a held object of a missing kit the first unknown kit-namespaced component's type id on the group (`heldTypeOf`, the rule `LockSet._unknownKit` reads, `locks.dart:67-77`).

Plan decision (`locked` and `visible`): `locked` is `isLockedUnit`: the instance's layer locked, or `locks.covers(document, instance)`. `visible` is the instance's layer shown (a missing layer counts as shown, `service_layout.dart:155-157`). A generated instance carries its object's layer (E5, spec S1), so both read the instance's own layer.

Plan decision (`top` and `box`): `box` is the definition's leaves' box (`boxOfLeaves`, 2a's rule, true arc extents). `top` is the lowest-handle leaf's box when it is a closed polyline or a circle, else `box`: the rule of `SymbolDefinitionRef.top` (spec S2) and of today's served top (`table_picker.dart:92-110`). Both are computed once per definition per build, from one bucketing pass over the entities.

Plan decision (`UnitIndexCache`'s key): it rebuilds when `document.commands.stateId` or `document.tables.mutationRevision` moves (today's picker key, `table_picker.dart:230-239`), or when `locked` has notified since the last build. A freeze moves no state id (`undo.dart:179-185`), and `lockBroken` always assigns a new set (`plan_controller.dart:533-541`), so a listener sets a stale flag.

Plan decision (`nextUnitNumber`, spec S2 "Placed, numbered"): `max + 1` over the counted labels (1 to 8 ASCII digits) of placed `numbered` units, then up by one while that text is any unit's label. When that would pass `99999999`, it is the smallest positive integer that is neither a counted placed number nor any unit's label. The pure core `nextUnitNumberOf(numbers, labels)` equals today's `nextTableNumber` when `labels` is empty, so TN1-TN5 port with their assertions.

Plan decision (the order of `diagnostics()`): today's. Duplicates by first appearance, then per unit ascending: `unit.unlabelled` or `unit.bad_label`, `unit.extra_label`, `unit.invalid_data`, `unit.invalid_colour`. Then `unit.nested`, ascending. Severity is `warning` for all but `unit.nested` (`info`), as `table_index.dart:159-225`. `warnings()` gives `DuplicateLabel` (first appearance), then `Unlabelled` (ascending), then `BadLabel` (ascending).

```dart
// The units' fixture (2b Task 6; Task 8 adds the picker's and the
// editor's helpers, and Tasks 7, 9, 10, 14 and 15 reuse it), ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan's test/tables/table_fixture.dart: a servable table

  category: 'Tests',
  tags: ['table', 'test'],

/// [s] as a library entry, built by hand (no library rule is checked): its
/// leaves ascending by handle in shape order, each a BYBLOCK leaf on layer
/// 0; its unit when [CatalogSymbol.unit] is set.
SymbolEntry entryOf(CatalogSymbol s) {
  const definition = Handle(0x0F0);
  final leaves = <SymbolLeaf>[];
  var next = 0x100;
  for (final shape in s.shapes) {
    final (EntityKind kind, GeometryPayload payload) = switch (shape) {
      CatalogPolyline(:final points, :final closed) => (
          EntityKind.polyline,
          polylinePayload([for (final (x, y) in points) Vector2(x, y)],
              closed: closed)
        ),
      CatalogCircle(center: (final x, final y), :final radius) =>
        (EntityKind.circle, circlePayload(Vector2(x, y), radius)),
      CatalogLine(from: (final ax, final ay), to: (final bx, final by)) => (
          EntityKind.line,
          linePayload(Vector2(ax, ay), Vector2(bx, by))
        ),
      _ => throw UnsupportedError('no arc in the unit fixtures'),
    };
    leaves.add((record: leafRecord(next++, definition, kind), payload: payload));
  }
  final unit = s.unit;
  return SymbolEntry(
    symbol: SymbolComponent(
        key: s.key,
        version: s.version,
        name: s.name,
        category: s.category,
        tags: s.tags),
    unit: unit == null
        ? null
        : UnitComponent(
            kind: unit.kind,
            capacity: unit.capacity,
            labelling: unit.labelling),
    definition: Definition(
        handle: definition,
        name: s.id,
        basePoint: Vector2(s.base.$1, s.base.$2),
        children: const []),
    leaves: leaves,
  );
}


/// An empty plan with the plan's components (the unit components among
/// them) and [catalog]'s, in millimetres.
DraftDocument plan({ParametricCatalog? catalog}) {
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty();
  registerPlanComponents(doc.components, catalog ?? ParametricCatalog());
  doc.header.units = DrawingUnits.millimeters;
  return doc;
}

const double kDeg37 = 37 * math.pi / 180;

/// `translate(at) · R(theta) · (mirror x) · translate(-base)`.
Transform2 placementAt(double x, double y, double theta,
        {bool mirrored = false, double baseX = 900, double baseY = 700}) =>
    Transform2.translation(x, y)
        .multiply(Transform2.rotation(theta))
        .multiply(Transform2.scale(mirrored ? -1 : 1, 1))
        .multiply(Transform2.translation(-baseX, -baseY));

/// [doc]'s units, every kit [loaded] unless told otherwise.
UnitIndex unitIndexOf(DraftDocument doc,
        {ParametricCatalog? catalog, bool Function(String kitId)? loaded}) =>
    UnitIndex.of(doc,
        catalog: catalog ?? ParametricCatalog(),
        locks: LockSet.scan(doc, loaded ?? (_) => true));

/// Adds [text] as the label of [i] (today's `addTableLabelCommand`),
/// executed; the label's handle.
Handle labelUnit(DraftDocument doc, InstanceNode i, String text) {
  final command = addUnitLabelCommand(doc,
      instance: i.handle,
      definition: i.definition,
      placement: i.transform,
      text: text);
  doc.commands.execute(command);
  return command.record.handle;
}

/// The labels of [index]'s labelled units, one per unit (today's
/// `TableSurvey.numbers`).
List<String> labelsOf(UnitIndex index) => [
      for (final u in index.units)
        if (u.text != null) u.text!,
    ];
```

```dart
const Tolerance exact = Tolerance(linear: 0, angular: 0);

List<double> boxOf(Aabb2 b) => [b.minX, b.minY, b.maxX, b.maxY];

List<Handle> ascending(Iterable<Handle> hs) =>
    hs.toList()..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));

/// A row of the fixture's seat: [prefix], [count] seats, at [at] turned
/// [angle]; executed through [c]; its handle.
Handle addSeatRow(PlanController c, ServiceFixture f, String prefix, int count,
    {required Vector2 at, double angle = 0, double curve = 0}) {
  final seat = testEntry(rowSeatKey);
  final h = c.document.handleSeed.next();
  expect(
      c.execute(placeRowCommand(
          c.document,
          RowComponent(
              prefix: prefix,
              count: count,
              spacing: 500,
              curve: curve,
              seat: f.seatDefinition,
              base: seat.definition.basePoint,
              top: entryTop(seat)),
          at: at,
          angle: angle,
          handle: h)),
      isTrue);
  return h;
}

/// A plan text whose root holds a group G turned 0.4 rad at (3100.5,
/// -1700.25), carrying a slab (the test kit's type) unless [plain], with
/// one stool (a unit) under it, turned 37°.
({String text, Handle group, Handle seat}) heldPlan({bool plain = false}) {
  final d = plan(catalog: catalogOf([testKit()]));
  final group = d.handleSeed.next();
  d.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: group,
        parent: d.rootHandle,
        transform: Transform2.translation(3100.5, -1700.25)
            .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.4)),
        children: const [])),
    if (!plain)
      SetComponentCommand<SlabComponent>(
          group, SlabComponent(width: 1800, height: 900, angle: 0.4)),
  ], label: 'Holder'));
  final made = definitionForEntry(d, entryOf(stoolSymbol));
  d.commands.execute(CompoundCommand(made.commands, label: 'Stool'));
  final seat = d.handleSeed.next();
  d.commands.execute(AddNodeCommand(InstanceNode(
      handle: seat,
      parent: group,
      transform: placementAt(120, -80, kDeg37, baseX: 400, baseY: 300),
      definition: made.definition,
      layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero)));
  final text = DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(d);
  d.dispose();
  return (text: text, group: group, seat: seat);
}

DraftDocument decodeWith(String text, ParametricCatalog catalog) {
  final d = DraftDocumentCodec.decodeString(text,
      registerComponents: (r) => registerPlanComponents(r, catalog));
  addTearDown(d.dispose);
  return d;
}

/// A plan over unitKit() whose row A (four seats, turned 0.5 rad, off the
/// origin) seats a definition keyed under the kit `gone`.
({String json, Handle row, List<Handle> seats}) goneSeatPlan() {
  late Handle row;
  late List<Handle> seats;
  final json = planText([unitKit(), symbolKit('gone', const [])], (d) {
    final def = d.handleSeed.next();
    final leaf = d.handleSeed.next();
    d.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
      AddDefinitionCommand(Definition(
          handle: def,
          name: 'gone.seat.basic.one@1',
          basePoint: Vector2(250, 265),
          children: const [])),
      SetComponentCommand<SymbolComponent>(
          def,
          SymbolComponent(
              key: 'gone.seat.basic.one',
              version: 1,
              name: 'Gone seat',
              category: 'Gone',
              tags: const ['seat'])),
      SetComponentCommand<UnitComponent>(
          def,
          UnitComponent(
              kind: UnitKinds.seat,
              capacity: 1,
              labelling: UnitLabelling.assigned)),
      AddEntityCommand(
          record: EntityRecord(
            handle: leaf,
            owner: def,
            kind: EntityKind.polyline,
            layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero,
            linetype: ReservedHandles.byBlockLinetype,
            linetypeScale: 1.0,
            geomIndex: 0,
            color: const ByBlockColor(),
            lineweight: kByBlock,
            transparency: kByBlock,
            flags: 0,
          ),
          payload: polylinePayload([
            Vector2(25, 40),
            Vector2(475, 40),
            Vector2(475, 490),
            Vector2(25, 490),
          ], closed: true)),
    ], label: 'Gone seat'));
    row = addRow(
        d,
        RowComponent(
            prefix: 'A',
            count: 4,
            spacing: 600,
            seat: def,
            base: Vector2(250, 265),
            top: const Aabb2.raw(25, 40, 475, 490)),
        at: Vector2(-3900.25, 2700.5),
        angle: 0.5);
    seats = seatsOf(d, row);
  });
  return (json: json, row: row, seats: seats);
}
```

```dart
// A unit's label (spec 2b S2 "The label"): the text rule (today's table
// number rule, jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/tables/table_numbers.dart:5-46,
// renamed), the label record and command of a placed unit
// (table_label.dart:106-179), and how a unit's label and top are read. The
// stamp, the height and the payload are the kit's (Task 3).
//
// No Flutter import: Dart over package:jet_cad_2d and the kit's model.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show kUnitLabelTag, kUnitLabelTextAttrs, unitLabelHeight, unitLabelPayload;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../symbols/symbol_box.dart' show boxOfLeaves;

/// A label's longest length, in UTF-16 code units.
const int kUnitLabelMaxLength = 8;

/// Why a text is not a unit label, as a value a UI words.
enum UnitLabelProblem {
  /// Empty, or longer than [kUnitLabelMaxLength] code units, trimmed.
  length,

  /// A control character, a line break among them.
  control,
}

/// Whether the UTF-16 code unit [u] is a control character: below U+0020
/// (C0, a line break among them) or U+007F to U+009F (DEL and C1). The one
/// rule [unitLabelProblem] and the unit data limits share.
bool isControlCodeUnit(int u) => u < 0x20 || (u >= 0x7F && u <= 0x9F);

/// Why [raw], trimmed, is not a unit label, or null when it is one:
/// non-empty, at most [kUnitLabelMaxLength] code units, no control
/// character.
UnitLabelProblem? unitLabelProblem(String raw) {
  final n = raw.trim();
  if (n.isEmpty || n.length > kUnitLabelMaxLength) {
    return UnitLabelProblem.length;
  }
  if (n.codeUnits.any(isControlCodeUnit)) return UnitLabelProblem.control;
  return null;
}

/// [unitLabelProblem] in English, or null (diagnostic messages; the UI's
/// words are `PlanStrings.labelProblem`).
String? unitLabelError(String raw) => switch (unitLabelProblem(raw)) {
      null => null,
      UnitLabelProblem.length => '1 to $kUnitLabelMaxLength characters',
      UnitLabelProblem.control => 'No line breaks or control characters',
    };

/// The label record of a placed unit: owned by [instance], on layer 0 (so
/// it follows the instance's layer, spec 12b S-2), BYBLOCK style, the
/// standard text style, tag `UNIT`, text [text].
EntityRecord unitLabelRecord(
        {required Handle handle,
        required Handle instance,
        required String text}) =>
    EntityRecord(
      handle: handle,
      owner: instance,
      kind: EntityKind.attrib,
      layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero,
      linetype: ReservedHandles.byBlockLinetype,
      linetypeScale: 1.0,
      geomIndex: 0,
      color: const ByBlockColor(),
      lineweight: kByBlock,
      transparency: kByBlock,
      flags: 0,
      text: text,
      tag: kUnitLabelTag,
      textStyle: ReservedHandles.standardTextStyle,
      textAttrs: kUnitLabelTextAttrs,
    );

/// The lowest-handle leaf [owner] owns, or null. O(entities): at command
/// or document-change rate, never per frame. With [leavesByOwner]
/// ([DraftDocument.leavesByOwner], shared by a caller asking for many
/// owners in one pass), only [owner]'s own leaves are visited.
/// (`tables/table_label.dart:155-181`, `CommandTarget` for `DraftDocument`.)
({EntityKind kind, GeometryPayload payload})? firstLeafOf(
    CommandTarget target, Handle owner,
    [Map<Handle, List<int>>? leavesByOwner]) {
  final entities = target.entities;
  int? best;
  final slots = leavesByOwner == null
      ? entities.liveSlots
      : leavesByOwner[owner] ?? const <int>[];
  for (final slot in slots) {
    if (entities.ownerAt(slot) != owner) continue;
    if (best == null ||
        entities.handleAt(slot).value < entities.handleAt(best).value) {
      best = slot;
    }
  }
  if (best == null) return null;
  return (
    kind: entities.kindAt(best),
    payload: target.geometry.read(entities.geomIndexAt(best)),
  );
}

/// The top of a definition whose [leaves] are given ascending by handle
/// (spec S2, `SymbolDefinitionRef.top`): the first leaf's box when it is a
/// closed polyline or a circle, else the leaves' box (`boxOfLeaves`);
/// empty for none.
Aabb2 unitTopOfLeaves(List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> leaves) {
  if (leaves.isNotEmpty) {
    final (kind, p) = leaves.first;
    if (kind == EntityKind.circle) {
      final r = p.scalars[0];
      return Aabb2.raw(
          p.coords[0] - r, p.coords[1] - r, p.coords[0] + r, p.coords[1] + r);
    }
    if (kind == EntityKind.polyline && isClosedPolyline(p)) {
      final b = boxOfLeaves([leaves.first]);
      if (b != null) return Aabb2.raw(b.left, b.front, b.right, b.back);
    }
  }
  final b = boxOfLeaves(leaves);
  return b == null ? Aabb2.empty() : Aabb2.raw(b.left, b.front, b.right, b.back);
}

/// The box a placed unit's label height reads (spec S2: today's stamp,
/// `tables/table_label.dart:22-44`): the first leaf's box when it is a
/// circle or a polyline, open or closed; else empty, which gives the full
/// height. Not the unit's top ([unitTopOfLeaves], spec S2's rule for
/// `SymbolDefinitionRef.top` and `UnitInfo.top`): today's label reads an
/// open polyline's box and never the other leaves (controller ruling
/// R-21; the placer, the unit API's new label and the fixtures read this).
Aabb2 placedLabelTop(List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> leaves) {
  if (leaves.isEmpty) return Aabb2.empty();
  final (kind, p) = leaves.first;
  switch (kind) {
    case EntityKind.circle:
      final r = p.scalars[0];
      return Aabb2.raw(
          p.coords[0] - r, p.coords[1] - r, p.coords[0] + r, p.coords[1] + r);
    case EntityKind.polyline:
      final c = p.coords;
      var minX = c[0], maxX = c[0], minY = c[1], maxY = c[1];
      for (var i = 2; i + 1 < c.length; i += 2) {
        if (c[i] < minX) minX = c[i];
        if (c[i] > maxX) maxX = c[i];
        if (c[i + 1] < minY) minY = c[i + 1];
        if (c[i + 1] > maxY) maxY = c[i + 1];
      }
      return Aabb2.raw(minX, minY, maxX, maxY);
    default:
      return Aabb2.empty();
  }
}

/// [placedLabelTop] of [definition]'s first leaf in [target].
/// O(entities), at command rate.
Aabb2 placedLabelTopOf(CommandTarget target, Handle definition) {
  final leaf = firstLeafOf(target, definition);
  return leaf == null
      ? Aabb2.empty()
      : placedLabelTop([(leaf.kind, leaf.payload)]);
}

/// The command that adds [text] as the label of [instance], an instance of
/// [definition] placed by [placement]: anchored at the definition's base
/// point, the height of its top, stamped upright. Allocates one handle.
AddEntityCommand addUnitLabelCommand(
  DraftDocument doc, {
  required Handle instance,
  required Handle definition,
  required Transform2 placement,
  required String text,
}) {
  final def = doc.tree.definition(definition);
  return AddEntityCommand(
    record: unitLabelRecord(
        handle: doc.handleSeed.next(), instance: instance, text: text),
    payload: unitLabelPayload(
      anchor: def?.basePoint ?? Vector2.zero(),
      height: unitLabelHeight(placedLabelTopOf(doc, definition)),
      instanceToWorld: placement,
    ),
  );
}

/// The lowest-handle `UNIT` ATTRIB [instance] owns, or null. O(entities),
/// at command rate.
Handle? unitLabelOf(CommandTarget target, Handle instance) {
  final e = target.entities;
  Handle? best;
  for (final slot in e.liveSlots) {
    if (e.ownerAt(slot) != instance ||
        e.kindAt(slot) != EntityKind.attrib ||
        e.tagAt(slot) != kUnitLabelTag) {
      continue;
    }
    final h = e.handleAt(slot);
    if (best == null || h.value < best.value) best = h;
  }
  return best;
}
```

```dart
// The units' diagnostics and label warnings (spec 2b S2 "Diagnostics",
// "Unlabelled, duplicate and bad labels"): today's table codes and
// NumberingWarning (jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/tables/table_index.dart:
// 228-243; host/floor_plan_types.dart:197-243), renamed, plus the bad label.
import 'unit_label.dart' show UnitLabelProblem;

/// The codes `UnitIndex.diagnostics` raises.
abstract final class UnitProblem {
  static const String duplicateLabel = 'unit.duplicate_label';
  static const String unlabelled = 'unit.unlabelled';
  static const String badLabel = 'unit.bad_label';
  static const String extraLabel = 'unit.extra_label';
  static const String nested = 'unit.nested';

  /// Host data outside the limits: kept as read, reads as none.
  static const String invalidData = 'unit.invalid_data';

  /// A colour of another shape, or a swatch this release does not know:
  /// kept as read, drawn as none.
  static const String invalidColour = 'unit.invalid_colour';
}

/// A problem with the plan's unit labels, as a value the host words, or
/// asks `PlanStrings.labelWarning` to. Never a handle.
sealed class UnitLabelWarning {
  const UnitLabelWarning();
}

/// [count] live units carry [label].
final class DuplicateLabel extends UnitLabelWarning {
  const DuplicateLabel({required this.label, required this.count});

  final String label;
  final int count;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is DuplicateLabel && other.label == label && other.count == count;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(label, count);

  @override
  String toString() => 'DuplicateLabel($label, $count)';
}

/// A live unit carries no label. Two of one symbol read alike: the host
/// sees how many there are.
final class Unlabelled extends UnitLabelWarning {
  const Unlabelled(
      {required this.kind, required this.capacity, required this.symbolKey});

  final String kind;
  final int capacity;
  final String? symbolKey;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is Unlabelled &&
      other.kind == kind &&
      other.capacity == capacity &&
      other.symbolKey == symbolKey;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(kind, capacity, symbolKey);

  @override
  String toString() => 'Unlabelled($kind, $capacity, $symbolKey)';
}

/// A live unit's [label] breaks the text rule ([problem]); it is still its
/// label, served by its text.
final class BadLabel extends UnitLabelWarning {
  const BadLabel({required this.label, required this.problem});

  final String label;
  final UnitLabelProblem problem;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is BadLabel && other.label == label && other.problem == problem;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(label, problem);

  @override
  String toString() => 'BadLabel($label, ${problem.name})';
}
```

```dart
// The next number of a placed numbered unit (spec 2b S2 "Placed,
// numbered"), today's nextTableNumber (jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/tables/
// table_numbers.dart:48-73), skipping any unit's label.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show UnitLabelling;

import 'unit_index.dart';

final RegExp _counted = RegExp(r'^[0-9]{1,8}$');

/// The largest number written: eight digits.
const int _kLargestCounted = 99999999;

/// The value of [label] when it counts: 1 to 8 ASCII digits, leading zeros
/// allowed (`"07"` is 7). Null otherwise.
int? countedUnitNumber(String label) =>
    _counted.hasMatch(label) ? int.parse(label) : null;

/// `max + 1` over the counted [numbers] (trimmed), written without leading
/// zeros, then up by one while that text is in [labels]; `"1"` when none
/// counts. When that would take nine digits, the smallest positive integer
/// that is neither a counted number nor in [labels]. With [labels] empty,
/// today's nextTableNumber.
String nextUnitNumberOf(Iterable<String> numbers,
    [Set<String> labels = const {}]) {
  final used = <int>{};
  var max = 0;
  for (final n in numbers) {
    final v = countedUnitNumber(n.trim());
    if (v == null) continue;
    used.add(v);
    if (v > max) max = v;
  }
  var candidate = max + 1;
  while (candidate <= _kLargestCounted && labels.contains('$candidate')) {
    candidate++;
  }
  if (candidate <= _kLargestCounted) return '$candidate';
  candidate = 1;
  while (used.contains(candidate) || labels.contains('$candidate')) {
    candidate++;
  }
  return '$candidate';
}

/// The next number for a placed `numbered` unit of [index]: over the
/// placed numbered units' labels, skipping every unit's label.
String nextUnitNumber(UnitIndex index) => nextUnitNumberOf([
      for (final u in index.units)
        if (!u.generated &&
            u.labelling == UnitLabelling.numbered &&
            u.text != null)
          u.text!,
    ], {
      for (final u in index.units)
        if (u.text != null) u.text!,
    });
```

```dart
// The one lock predicate of a unit (spec 2b S2 "Locked units"): its layer
// is locked (today's locked table), or 2a's lock set covers it (a placed
// unit of a missing kit's symbol, a frozen object's or a missing kit's
// object's seat, a seat of a missing kit's definition). Used by the service
// tool, unitDetails.locked, the record's strict match and the design writes.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show isKitId;

import '../kits/locks.dart';

/// Whether the unit [instance] of [document] is locked.
bool isLockedUnit(CommandTarget document, LockSet locks, Handle instance) {
  final node = document.tree[instance];
  if (node is InstanceNode &&
      (document.tables.layers[node.layer]?.locked ?? false)) {
    return true;
  }
  return locks.covers(document, instance);
}

/// The type id of the first unknown kit-namespaced component on [group] (a
/// kit id, then a dot; not `jetcad`, not `plan`): what a group the lock set
/// holds for a missing kit was, by the rule `LockSet` reads
/// (`locks.dart:67-77`). Null when it carries none.
String? heldTypeOf(CommandTarget document, Handle group) {
  for (final payload in document.components.unknownOf(group)) {
    final typeId = payload['typeId'];
    if (typeId is! String) continue;
    final dot = typeId.indexOf('.');
    if (dot <= 0) continue;
    final kit = typeId.substring(0, dot);
    if (isKitId(kit) && kit != 'jetcad' && kit != 'plan') return typeId;
  }
  return null;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: `unit_index.dart`.** Create `lib/src/units/unit_index.dart`:

```dart
// The units of a plan (spec 2b S2 "A unit", "UnitIndex", "Diagnostics",
// "Unlabelled, duplicate and bad labels"): every live symbol instance whose
// definition carries `jetcad.unit`, placed at the root or generated by an
// object, in one pass, with its label, its lock, its world transform and
// its definition-space top and box. Replaces jet_cad_floor_plan's
// TableSurvey (tables/table_index.dart:61-226); the top and box follow
// service/table_picker.dart:92-110, :259-299.
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ValueListenable;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show SymbolComponent, UnitComponent, UnitLabelling, kUnitLabelTag;

import '../kits/locks.dart';
import '../symbols/symbol_box.dart' show boxOfLeaves;
import 'unit_components.dart';
import 'unit_label.dart';
import 'unit_locks.dart';
import 'unit_problems.dart';

/// One unit.
final class UnitInfo {
  const UnitInfo({
    required this.instance,
    required this.definition,
    this.owner,
    this.ownerType,
    this.label,
    this.text,
    required this.kind,
    required this.capacity,
    required this.labelling,
    this.symbolKey,
    required this.locked,
    required this.visible,
    required this.toWorld,
    required this.top,
    required this.box,
  });

  final Handle instance;
  final Handle definition;

  /// The generating object (a root-level group); null when placed.
  final Handle? owner;

  /// The owner's type id, or the missing kit's component type id of a held
  /// group; null when placed.
  final String? ownerType;

  /// The lowest-handle `UNIT` ATTRIB; null when there is none.
  final Handle? label;

  /// [label]'s text, trimmed; null when unlabelled (no label, or an empty
  /// one).
  final String? text;

  final String kind;
  final int capacity;
  final UnitLabelling labelling;

  /// The definition's `jetcad.symbol` key; null for a hand-made one.
  final String? symbolKey;

  /// [isLockedUnit].
  final bool locked;

  /// The instance's layer is shown (a missing layer counts as shown).
  final bool visible;

  /// Definition space to world: the instance's transform, after its root
  /// group's for a generated unit.
  final Transform2 toWorld;

  /// Definition space: the served top (the first leaf, a closed polyline or
  /// a circle), else [box].
  final Aabb2 top;

  /// Definition space: the symbol's box.
  final Aabb2 box;

  bool get generated => owner != null;

  @override
  String toString() => 'UnitInfo(${instance.toHex()}, $text, $kind)';
}

/// The units of one document, and what their labels and data raise.
final class UnitIndex {
  UnitIndex._(this.units, this.nested, this._byInstance, this._extraLabels,
      this._keptData, this._invalidColour);

  /// One pass, O(nodes + entities): at document-change rate (through
  /// [UnitIndexCache]), never per frame.
  factory UnitIndex.of(CommandTarget document,
      {required ParametricCatalog catalog, required LockSet locks}) {
    final entities = document.entities;
    final tree = document.tree;
    final root = tree.root;
    // One bucketing pass: the UNIT labels by owner, every other leaf by
    // owner (a definition's leaves among them).
    final labels = <Handle, List<(Handle, String)>>{};
    final leaves = <Handle, List<int>>{};
    for (final slot in entities.liveSlots) {
      final owner = entities.ownerAt(slot);
      if (entities.kindAt(slot) == EntityKind.attrib) {
        if (entities.tagAt(slot) == kUnitLabelTag) {
          (labels[owner] ??= [])
              .add((entities.handleAt(slot), entities.textAt(slot)));
        }
        continue;
      }
      (leaves[owner] ??= []).add(slot);
    }
    final shapes = <Handle, (Aabb2, Aabb2)>{};
    (Aabb2, Aabb2) shapeOf(Handle definition) =>
        shapes.putIfAbsent(definition, () {
          final slots = [...?leaves[definition]]..sort((a, b) => entities
              .handleAt(a)
              .value
              .compareTo(entities.handleAt(b).value));
          final list = [
            for (final s in slots)
              (
                entities.kindAt(s),
                document.geometry.read(entities.geomIndexAt(s))
              ),
          ];
          final b = boxOfLeaves(list);
          return (
            unitTopOfLeaves(list),
            b == null
                ? Aabb2.empty()
                : Aabb2.raw(b.left, b.front, b.right, b.back),
          );
        });

    final units = <UnitInfo>[];
    final nested = <Handle>[];
    final extra = <Handle, List<Handle>>{};
    final kept = <Handle>{};
    final invalidColour = <Handle>{};
    // `tree.nodes` is ascending by handle (its contract), so both lists are
    // too.
    for (final node in tree.nodes) {
      if (node is! InstanceNode) continue;
      if (tree.definition(node.definition) == null) continue;
      final unit = document.components.get<UnitComponent>(node.definition);
      if (unit == null) continue;
      Handle? owner;
      String? ownerType;
      var toWorld = node.transform;
      if (node.parent != root) {
        final parent = tree[node.parent];
        if (parent is! GroupNode || parent.parent != root) {
          nested.add(node.handle);
          continue;
        }
        final typeId = catalog.typeIdOf(document, parent.handle);
        if (typeId == null && !locks.isLockedObject(parent.handle)) {
          nested.add(node.handle);
          continue;
        }
        owner = parent.handle;
        ownerType = typeId ?? heldTypeOf(document, parent.handle);
        toWorld = parent.transform.multiply(node.transform);
      }
      final own = labels[node.handle]
        ?..sort((a, b) => a.$1.value.compareTo(b.$1.value));
      if (own != null && own.length > 1) {
        extra[node.handle] = [for (final l in own.skip(1)) l.$1];
      }
      final layer = document.tables.layers[node.layer];
      final (top, box) = shapeOf(node.definition);
      units.add(UnitInfo(
        instance: node.handle,
        definition: node.definition,
        owner: owner,
        ownerType: ownerType,
        label: own?.first.$1,
        // An empty label is no label (today's demo review F-7).
        text: switch (own?.first.$2.trim()) {
          null || '' => null,
          final t => t,
        },
        kind: unit.kind,
        capacity: unit.capacity,
        labelling: unit.labelling,
        symbolKey:
            document.components.get<SymbolComponent>(node.definition)?.key,
        locked: isLockedUnit(document, locks, node.handle),
        visible: layer?.visible ?? true,
        toWorld: toWorld,
        top: top,
        box: box,
      ));
      if (document.components.get<UnitData>(node.handle)?.isKept ?? false) {
        kept.add(node.handle);
      }
      final colour = document.components.get<UnitColour>(node.handle);
      if (colour != null && colour.swatch == null) {
        invalidColour.add(node.handle);
      }
    }
    return UnitIndex._(
        List.unmodifiable(units),
        List.unmodifiable(nested),
        {for (final u in units) u.instance: u},
        Map.unmodifiable(extra),
        kept,
        invalidColour);
  }

  /// Every unit, served or not, ascending by instance handle.
  final List<UnitInfo> units;

  /// Unit instances that are neither placed nor generated (`unit.nested`),
  /// ascending.
  final List<Handle> nested;

  final Map<Handle, UnitInfo> _byInstance;
  final Map<Handle, List<Handle>> _extraLabels;
  final Set<Handle> _keptData;
  final Set<Handle> _invalidColour;

  UnitInfo? operator [](Handle instance) => _byInstance[instance];

  /// The units labelled [label] (trimmed, exact `==`), ascending.
  List<UnitInfo> withLabel(String label) {
    final l = label.trim();
    return [
      for (final u in units)
        if (u.text == l) u,
    ];
  }

  /// The units' diagnostics (spec S2), in a stable order: duplicates by
  /// first appearance; then per unit ascending: unlabelled or a bad label,
  /// extra labels, invalid data, an invalid colour; then the nested ones.
  List<Diagnostic> diagnostics() {
    final out = <Diagnostic>[];
    final byLabel = <String, List<Handle>>{};
    for (final u in units) {
      if (u.text case final t?) (byLabel[t] ??= []).add(u.instance);
    }
    for (final MapEntry(key: label, value: handles) in byLabel.entries) {
      if (handles.length < 2) continue;
      out.add(Diagnostic(
        severity: DiagnosticSeverity.warning,
        code: UnitProblem.duplicateLabel,
        message: 'Label $label is used by ${handles.length} units',
        handles: handles,
      ));
    }
    for (final u in units) {
      final h = u.instance;
      final text = u.text;
      if (text == null) {
        out.add(Diagnostic(
          severity: DiagnosticSeverity.warning,
          code: UnitProblem.unlabelled,
          message: 'Unit ${h.toHex()} has no label',
          handles: [h],
        ));
      } else if (unitLabelError(text) case final error?) {
        out.add(Diagnostic(
          severity: DiagnosticSeverity.warning,
          code: UnitProblem.badLabel,
          message: 'Unit ${h.toHex()} is labelled "$text" ($error); it is '
              'served by its text',
          handles: [h],
        ));
      }
      final more = _extraLabels[h];
      if (more != null) {
        out.add(Diagnostic(
          severity: DiagnosticSeverity.warning,
          code: UnitProblem.extraLabel,
          message: 'Unit ${h.toHex()} has ${more.length + 1} labels; the '
              'first is used',
          handles: [h, ...more],
        ));
      }
      if (_keptData.contains(h)) {
        out.add(Diagnostic(
          severity: DiagnosticSeverity.warning,
          code: UnitProblem.invalidData,
          message: 'Unit ${h.toHex()} carries host data outside the limits; '
              'it is kept as read and reads as none',
          handles: [h],
        ));
      }
      if (_invalidColour.contains(h)) {
        out.add(Diagnostic(
          severity: DiagnosticSeverity.warning,
          code: UnitProblem.invalidColour,
          message: 'Unit ${h.toHex()} carries a colour this release cannot '
              'read; it is kept as read and drawn as none',
          handles: [h],
        ));
      }
    }
    for (final h in nested) {
      out.add(Diagnostic(
        severity: DiagnosticSeverity.info,
        code: UnitProblem.nested,
        message: '${h.toHex()} is neither at the root nor an object\'s and '
            'is not a unit',
        handles: [h],
      ));
    }
    return out;
  }

  /// The label warnings a host sees (`labelWarnings`): [DuplicateLabel] in
  /// first-appearance order, then [Unlabelled], then [BadLabel], ascending.
  List<UnitLabelWarning> warnings() {
    final counts = <String, int>{};
    for (final u in units) {
      if (u.text case final t?) counts[t] = (counts[t] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    return List.unmodifiable(<UnitLabelWarning>[
      for (final MapEntry(key: label, value: count) in counts.entries)
        if (count > 1) DuplicateLabel(label: label, count: count),
      for (final u in units)
        if (u.text == null)
          Unlabelled(
              kind: u.kind, capacity: u.capacity, symbolKey: u.symbolKey),
      for (final u in units)
        if (u.text case final t?)
          if (unitLabelProblem(t) case final p?)
            BadLabel(label: t, problem: p),
    ]);
  }
}

/// One session's [UnitIndex], rebuilt when the document's state id or its
/// tables' revision moves, or when [locked] has notified (a freeze moves no
/// state id, spec S2). A read with none of them moved returns the same
/// index.
final class UnitIndexCache {
  UnitIndexCache(this.document,
      {required this.catalog,
      required this.locks,
      required ValueListenable<Set<Handle>> locked})
      : _locked = locked {
    _locked.addListener(_lockedChanged);
  }

  final DraftDocument document;
  final ParametricCatalog catalog;
  final LockSet locks;
  final ValueListenable<Set<Handle>> _locked;

  UnitIndex? _index;
  int? _state;
  int? _revision;
  bool _stale = true;

  UnitIndex get current {
    final state = document.commands.stateId;
    final revision = document.tables.mutationRevision;
    final index = _index;
    if (index != null &&
        !_stale &&
        state == _state &&
        revision == _revision) {
      return index;
    }
    _state = state;
    _revision = revision;
    _stale = false;
    return _index = UnitIndex.of(document, catalog: catalog, locks: locks);
  }

  void _lockedChanged() => _stale = true;

  void dispose() => _locked.removeListener(_lockedChanged);
}
```

Plan decision (how the placer reads the next number): `placeSymbol` takes the index as a parameter (`UnitIndex? units`), not a document scan. The number must skip a seat's label (spec S2), and only an index built with the catalog and the lock set knows a seat (Task 6's predicate). The symbol tool reads `units` (`() => session.units.current`, the cached index) at the press. A caller with no index (the gallery's thumbnail, `thumbnail_document.dart:16`; 2a's ported placer tests) places no label, as today's `numbered: false` (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/symbols/symbol_placer.dart:176-189`). `units` replaces today's `numbered` flag.

Plan decision (the placed label): the record is Task 6's `unitLabelRecord`; the payload is the kit's `unitLabelPayload(anchor: the entry's base point, height: unitLabelHeight(top), instanceToWorld: placement)`, `top` being Task 6's `placedLabelTop` of the entry's leaves (controller ruling R-21: the first leaf's box when it is a circle or a polyline, else empty). This is today's rule (`symbol_placer.dart:218-232`, `table_label.dart:22-44`), with the height read from that box. The instance's handle is allocated before the label's, as today, so a redo replays the same handles and number.

Plan decision (the label system's scope, spec S2): it stamps **placed** units only: a touched live instance whose parent is the root and whose definition carries `UnitComponent` (today's `_stampFor`, `table_label_system.dart:127-139`, with `SeatingComponent` → `UnitComponent`). A generated unit's label is its type's, restamped by its row's regeneration (spec S1, S2: "Generated labels are the type's"). The cheap path passes a plan with no unit definition through unwrapped.

Plan decision (the stack, spec S2 "The label system"): `DocumentSession` installs the parametric system, then `UnitLabelSystem`, then `LockExpander`, so the lock checks every handle a stamp touches too; disposal runs in reverse (each asserts LIFO: `locks.dart:184-191`, `table_label_system.dart:37-44`).

```dart
// sees its stamps; a placed numbered unit gets the next number, upright, in
// the placement's one step, from the controller's index and through its
// symbol tool; an assigned one gets none; a seat's label stays its type's.
// On the service fixture: a mirrored, turned table, a turned row and a

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

const Tolerance exact = Tolerance(linear: 0, angular: 0);

GeometryPayload payloadOf(DraftDocument d, Handle entity) =>
    d.geometry.read(d.entities.geomIndexAt(d.entities.slotOf(entity)!));

/// The one new root-level instance [action] adds to [c]'s document.
Handle placedBy(PlanController c, void Function() action) {
  final d = c.document;
  final before = {for (final n in d.tree.nodes) n.handle};
  action();
  return d.tree.nodes
      .whereType<InstanceNode>()
      .singleWhere((n) => !before.contains(n.handle))
      .handle;
}

    expect(c.execute(rotateUnitCommand(d, f.table, 1)!), isFalse);
    expect(c.lockHint.value, isTrue);

        isTrue);
```

```dart
// The unit label system (spec 2b S2 "The label system"): keeps every placed
// unit's label upright, inside the edit that turns or mirrors the unit, as
// one undo step. Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan's
// tables/table_label_system.dart (TableLabelSystem, TableLabelEdit) and
// table_label.dart (restampedTableLabel): the servable check is the
// definition's UnitComponent, the root rule is kept. A generated unit's
// label is its type's, restamped by its regeneration (spec S1). A deleted
// unit's data and colour are not this file's: the delete takes them
// (`RemoveNodeCommand`, node-components D-1).
//
// No Flutter import: Dart over package:jet_cad_2d and the kit's model.
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show UnitComponent, kUnitLabelMaxHeight, unitLabelStamp;

import 'unit_label.dart' show unitLabelOf;

/// [payload] re-stamped for [placement]: anchor and height kept, rotation
/// and width factor replaced. Null when they already match by exact `==`
/// (stored values), so a translation writes nothing.
GeometryPayload? restampedUnitLabel(
    GeometryPayload payload, Transform2 placement) {
  final s = unitLabelStamp(placement);
  final scalars = payload.scalars;
  if (scalars.length >= 3 &&
      scalars[1] == s.rotation &&
      scalars[2] == s.widthFactor) {
    return null;
  }
  return GeometryPayload(
    coords: Float64List.fromList(payload.coords),
    scalars: Float64List.fromList([
      scalars.isEmpty ? kUnitLabelMaxHeight : scalars[0],
      s.rotation,
      s.widthFactor,
    ]),
  );
}
```

  In `UnitLabelSystem`: `install`'s message `'the unit label system is installed already'`; `dispose`'s assert message `'UnitLabelSystem disposed out of order (spec 2b S2)'`; its doc names the stack "parametric system → this → lock expander". `_expand` becomes:

```dart
  DraftCommand _expand(DraftCommand command) {
    final inner = _previous?.call(command) ?? command;
    // The cheap path: a plan with no unit definition has no placed unit.
    if (document.components.withComponent<UnitComponent>().isEmpty) {
      return inner;
    }
    return UnitLabelEdit._(inner);
  }
```

  In `UnitLabelEdit`, `_stampFor` and `_labelOf` (`:124-156`) become:

```dart
  /// The stamp [h] needs, or null: [h] is a placed unit (a live, root-level
  /// instance of a definition carrying `jetcad.unit`) with a `UNIT` label
  /// whose rotation or width factor differs from its transform's stamp.
  static DraftCommand? _stampFor(CommandTarget target, Handle h) {
    final node = target.tree[h];
    if (node is! InstanceNode || node.parent != target.tree.root) return null;
    if (target.components.get<UnitComponent>(node.definition) == null) {
      return null;
    }
    final label = unitLabelOf(target, h);
    if (label == null) return null;
    final payload = target.geometry
        .read(target.entities.geomIndexAt(target.entities.slotOf(label)!));
    final next = restampedUnitLabel(payload, node.transform);
    return next == null ? null : SetEntityGeometryCommand(label, next);
  }
```

```dart
/// (an attachment's), else [placementTransform] of [at], [quarterTurns]
/// and [mirrored].
///
/// With [units] (the plan's index), a `numbered` unit gets
/// `nextUnitNumber(units)` as its `UNIT` label after the instance, anchored
/// at the base point, the height of its top, stamped upright for the
/// placement (spec 2b S2). The number is fixed here, with the handles, so
/// a redo replays the same one. An `assigned` unit, and any placement
/// without [units] (a thumbnail), gets no label.
CompoundCommand placeSymbol(
  DraftDocument doc,
  SymbolEntry entry, {
  required Vector2 at,
  int quarterTurns = 0,
  bool mirrored = false,
  Transform2? transform,
  InstanceStyle style = const InstanceStyle(),
  UnitIndex? units,
}) {
  final made = definitionForEntry(doc, entry);
  final commands = <DraftCommand>[...made.commands];
  final instance = doc.handleSeed.next();
  final placement = transform ??
      placementTransform(
        at: at,
        basePoint: entry.definition.basePoint,
        quarterTurns: quarterTurns,
        mirrored: mirrored,
      );
  commands.add(AddNodeCommand(InstanceNode(
    handle: instance,
    parent: doc.rootHandle,
    definition: made.definition,
    layer: drawingLayer(doc),
    transform: placement,
    color: style.color,
    lineweight: style.lineweight,
    transparency: style.transparency,
    linetype: style.linetype,
    linetypeScale: style.linetypeScale,
  )));
  final unit = entry.unit;
  if (units != null &&
      unit != null &&
      unit.labelling == UnitLabelling.numbered) {
    commands.add(AddEntityCommand(
      record: unitLabelRecord(
          handle: doc.handleSeed.next(),
          instance: instance,
          text: nextUnitNumber(units)),
      payload: unitLabelPayload(
        anchor: entry.definition.basePoint,
        height: unitLabelHeight(placedLabelTop([
          for (final leaf in entry.leaves) (leaf.record.kind, leaf.payload),
        ])),
        instanceToWorld: placement,
      ),
    ));
  }
  return CompoundCommand(commands, label: 'Place ${entry.symbol.name}');
}
```

  The handle order is unchanged (the definition's, then the instance's), so 2a's `symbol_placer_test.dart` keeps its handles.

So the picker is ported here, whole, with its own tests (`service/table_picker_test.dart`), and Task 9 (`unitAt`) and Task 14 (the service tool, the allocation invariants) use it.

Plan decision (the profiles): `readOnly` gains `relabel: false` (today's `readOnly` has `renumber: false`, `editor_capabilities.dart:192`). `unitsOnly` is today's `tablesOnly` (`:175`) restricted to `PlanPermissions`' fields: tools `{plan.select, plan.symbol}`, `mirror`, `reshape`, `changeLayer`, `editLayers`, `editPage` false, `selectUnitsOnly` true; everything else as `full`. The panels are `PlanEditor`'s options (2a P7). Neither profile touches `serviceMove` or `serviceMerge`: today's profiles govern the editor alone (`editor_capabilities.dart:133-134`, "the selection mode is governed by the view's own parameters").

Plan decision (`edits`): `relabel` is an edit (a label is entity text); `selectUnitsOnly`, `serviceMove` and `serviceMerge` are not (the first restricts a selection, the other two act on the service copy, never on the design).

Plan decision (`toString`): it names every field whose value differs from `full`'s, in declaration order, so `unitsOnly` prints `selectUnitsOnly: true` (2a's version printed `false` flags only; every 2a flag defaults to true, so its texts are unchanged).

Plan decision (the mapping, spec S2): a key's target `h` (an instance or a root-level entity, the only targets `resolveHit` gives, `selection.dart:54-73`) maps to the root-level node above it when that node is a `GroupNode`, is not `h` itself, and is an object of a registered type (`catalog.typeIdOf(d, g) != null`, frozen objects included: a frozen object keeps its component) or a lock-set object (`locked.value.contains(g)`: the controller's `locked` notifier is `LockSet.objects`, `locks.dart:101`). The walk goes up `Node.parent` with no list: hover rate allocates nothing for it. A table inside a plain group maps to nothing (today's selection).

Plan decision (the band, decision 9): `bandAccepts` refuses a key the mapping would map. The tool's own group rule (`select_tool.dart:582-596`, `:621-645`) then gives the row to a crossing band (its seats' ATTRIBs resolve to it) and nothing to a window band over a seats-only row (the row owns no leaf of its own). `jet_cad_2d_flutter` is unchanged.

Plan decision (`selectUnitsOnly`): the pick is the session's units-only picker (`skipLocked: true`, `placedOnly: true`), with the reach today's gates give it: `e.reachRadiusWorld` for a touch, `e.pickRadiusWorld` for a mouse (`planner_shell.dart:1819-1825`).
