```dart
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The unit API (spec 2b S3), design side (Task 9). Task 11 re-points the
  // seams below to the service copy in service; every member that switches
  // on the mode reads them.

  /// The active document's units (Task 11: the copy's in service).
  UnitIndexCache get _activeUnits => _session.units;

  /// The active document (Task 11: the copy in service).
  DraftDocument get _activeDocument => _session.document;

  /// The active selection (Task 11: the copy's in service).
  SelectionController get _activeSelection => _session.selection;

  /// Whether the design is the active document (Task 11: the mode).
  bool get _inDesign => true;

  /// Throws a [StateError] naming [who] in service (Task 11): a design
  /// write is refused there (spec S3). Nothing in design.
  void _requireDesign(String who) {}

  /// [labels], each label of a group replaced by its members in service
  /// (Task 12). The labels as given in design.
  Set<String> _expandLabels(Set<String> labels) => labels;

  /// The active document's unit index (`@internal`): the panels, the
  /// inspector and the tests read it.
  @internal
  UnitIndex get unitIndex => _activeUnits.current;

  final ValueNotifier<int> _revision = ValueNotifier(0);

  /// Moves whenever the active plan changes: an edit, an undo or a redo of
  /// it, [load], [newPlan] (Task 11 adds the mode switch, Task 13 the reset
  /// and the restore). A host re-reads [units] and [labelWarnings] on it.
  ValueListenable<int> get revision => _revision;

  late final _PlanCameraValue _cameraValue = _PlanCameraValue(camera);

  /// Where the plan is on the canvas: a new [PlanCamera] at every pan, zoom
  /// and fit; two reads with no camera change in between are identical.
  ValueListenable<PlanCamera> get cameraValue => _cameraValue;

  /// The global point that shows [world], or null with no canvas mounted.
  Offset? worldToGlobal(Offset world) {
    final rect = _canvasRect.value;
    if (rect == null) return null;
    return cameraValue.value.worldToCanvas(world) + rect.topLeft;
  }

  /// The world point shown at the global point [global], or null with no
  /// canvas mounted.
  Offset? globalToWorld(Offset global) {
    final rect = _canvasRect.value;
    if (rect == null) return null;
    return cameraValue.value.canvasToWorld(global - rect.topLeft);
  }

  /// The active plan's units, ascending by instance, placed and generated
  /// (a unit on a hidden layer is listed, [PlanUnit.visible] false).
  List<PlanUnit> get units => [
        for (final u in _activeUnits.current.units) _unitOf(u),
      ];

  static PlanUnit _unitOf(UnitInfo u) => PlanUnit(
      label: u.text,
      kind: u.kind,
      capacity: u.capacity,
      symbolKey: u.symbolKey,
      visible: u.visible,
      generatedBy: u.ownerType);

  List<PlanUnitDetail>? _details;
  List<Handle> _detailInstances = const [];
  UnitIndex? _detailsIndex;

  /// The active plan's units with their geometry (today's `tableDetails`,
  /// floor_plan_controller.dart:1495-1514), ascending by instance like
  /// [units], one per unit. Cached per unit index (a state, a layer or a
  /// lock change makes a new one): two reads with nothing changed return
  /// the identical, unmodifiable list.
  List<PlanUnitDetail> get unitDetails {
    final index = _activeUnits.current;
    if (_details == null || !identical(index, _detailsIndex)) {
      final instances = <Handle>[];
      _details = _detailsOf(_activeDocument, index, instances);
      _detailInstances = List.unmodifiable(instances);
      _detailsIndex = index;
    }
    return _details!;
  }

  /// The instance of each entry of [unitDetails], index for index (the
  /// inspector and the overlays key by it). Never a host's.
  @internal
  List<Handle> get unitDetailInstances {
    unitDetails;
    return _detailInstances;
  }

  /// [index]'s units of [d] joined to the picker's candidates by instance
  /// (today's `_detailsOf`, :1527-1555), each instance added to
  /// [instances] in the same order. O(nodes + entities), at document-change
  /// rate.
  List<PlanUnitDetail> _detailsOf(
      DraftDocument d, UnitIndex index, List<Handle> instances) {
    final candidates = {
      for (final c in UnitPicker.candidatesOf(d, index,
          boxes: <Handle, Aabb2>{}, leaves: d.leavesByOwner))
        c.unit.instance: c,
    };
    final layers = d.tables.layers;
    final details = <PlanUnitDetail>[];
    for (final u in index.units) {
      final node = d.tree[u.instance];
      if (node is! InstanceNode) continue;
      instances.add(u.instance);
      final unit = _unitOf(u);
      final layer = layers[node.layer]?.name ?? '';
      final data = d.components.get<UnitData>(u.instance)?.data ??
          const <String, String>{};
      final colour = d.components.get<UnitColour>(u.instance)?.swatch;
      final c = candidates[u.instance];
      details.add(c == null
          ? unitDetailWithoutGeometry(
              unit: unit,
              layer: layer,
              locked: u.locked,
              data: data,
              colour: colour)
          : unitDetailOf(
              unit: unit,
              transform: c.transform,
              box: c.box,
              corners: c.corners,
              layer: layer,
              locked: u.locked,
              data: data,
              colour: colour));
    }
    return List.unmodifiable(details);
  }

  /// The active plan's labelling problems (today's `numberingWarnings`):
  /// duplicates by first appearance, then the unlabelled units, then the
  /// bad labels (Task 6's order).
  List<UnitLabelWarning> get labelWarnings => _activeUnits.current.warnings();

  UnitPicker? _atPicker;
  UnitIndex? _atIndex;

  /// The label of the unit at [canvasPoint] (today's `tableAt`, :1792-
  /// 1818): a point on its top, else in its symbol's box, the one drawn on
  /// top among several; for a touch, failing both, the unit whose box is
  /// nearest within a finger's reach (24 px). A unit on a hidden layer is
  /// never found; a locked one is; an unlabelled one answers null.
  String? unitAt(Offset canvasPoint,
      {PointerDeviceKind kind = PointerDeviceKind.mouse}) {
    final units = _activeUnits;
    final index = units.current;
    var picker = _atPicker;
    if (picker == null ||
        !identical(picker.units, units) ||
        !identical(_atIndex, index)) {
      picker = _atPicker = UnitPicker(_activeDocument, units);
      _atIndex = index;
    }
    final cam = camera.value;
    final world = cam.screenToWorld(Vector2(canvasPoint.dx, canvasPoint.dy));
    final reach = kind == PointerDeviceKind.touch
        ? kTouchPickRadiusPixels / cam.scale
        : 0.0;
    return picker.pick(world, reach: reach)?.text;
  }

  /// Selects every unit carrying one of [labels] that the selection can
  /// hold -- visible, not locked -- replacing the selection (today's
  /// `select`, :1834-1870). A label two units share selects both; an
  /// unknown one is ignored. In design, placed units only (the design's
  /// selection holds root objects).
  void select(Set<String> labels) {
    settlePendingInput();
    _select(labels);
  }

  void _select(Set<String> labels) {
    final index = _activeUnits.current;
    final placedOnly = _inDesign;
    final keys = <SelectionKey>[];
    for (final l in _expandLabels(labels)) {
      for (final u in index.withLabel(l)) {
        if (placedOnly && u.generated) continue;
        if (!u.visible || u.locked) continue;
        keys.add(SelectionKey.root(u.instance));
      }
    }
    _activeSelection.replace(keys);
    _refreshSelected();
  }

  final ValueNotifier<Set<String>> _selectedUnits =
      ValueNotifier(const <String>{});
  final ValueNotifier<Set<String>> _editorSelected =
      ValueNotifier(const <String>{});

  /// The labels of the units selected in the design's editor (today's
  /// `editorSelectedTables`, :796-800): the active selection's in design,
  /// empty in service. Unmodifiable; it notifies only when the set changes.
  ValueListenable<Set<String>> get editorSelectedUnits => _editorSelected;

  /// The labels of the active selection's units (today's
  /// `_refreshSelected`, :1921-1940).
  void _refreshSelected() {
    final index = _activeUnits.current;
    final labels = <String>{
      for (final k in _activeSelection.keys)
        if (k.chain.isEmpty)
          if (index[k.target]?.text case final t?) t,
    };
    if (!setEquals(labels, _selectedUnits.value)) {
      _selectedUnits.value = Set.unmodifiable(labels);
    }
    final editor = _inDesign ? _selectedUnits.value : const <String>{};
    if (!setEquals(editor, _editorSelected.value)) {
      _editorSelected.value = editor;
    }
  }

  /// Frames the units of the active plan carrying one of [labels] (today's
  /// `fitToTables`, :2068-2093): labels trimmed, blanks dropped; a label
  /// two units share frames both; a unit on a hidden layer is not framed,
  /// a locked one is; an unlabelled unit never matches. The world framed is
  /// the bound of each unit's box at its place, grown by [kUnitFitMarginMm]
  /// per side and to at least [kUnitFitMinSpanMm] per axis. Returns whether
  /// one such unit exists now; when none does, nothing changes. Not
  /// document state.
  bool fitToUnits(Set<String> labels) {
    final wanted = Set<String>.unmodifiable({
      for (final l in labels)
        if (l.trim() case final t when t.isNotEmpty) t,
    });
    if (_unitsBounds(wanted) == null) return false;
    _fitTarget = _Units(wanted);
    _request();
    return true;
  }

  Aabb2? _unitsBounds(Set<String> labels) {
    final d = _activeDocument;
    var box = Aabb2.empty();
    for (final c in UnitPicker.candidatesOf(d, _activeUnits.current,
        boxes: <Handle, Aabb2>{}, leaves: d.leavesByOwner)) {
      if (labels.contains(c.unit.text)) box = box.union(c.worldBounds);
    }
    return box.isEmpty ? null : box;
  }

  /// Stores the host's [data] on the unit labelled [label] (today's
  /// `setTableData`, :1593): one design edit, labelled "Unit data",
  /// undoable, saved with the plan, read back as [PlanUnitDetail.data]. An
  /// empty map removes the data. True when the unit's data is now [data];
  /// false, changing nothing, when the trimmed [label] names no unit or
  /// several, or a unit under a locked object (spec S3). A unit on a hidden
  /// or locked layer takes data. Not gated by [permissions] (a host call).
  /// A [StateError] in service; an [ArgumentError] outside the limits.
  bool setUnitData(String label, Map<String, String> data) =>
      setUnitsData({label: data});

  /// [setUnitData] for several units, all or nothing, one undo step.
  bool setUnitsData(Map<String, Map<String, String>> byLabel) {
    _requireDesign('setUnitData');
    final wanted = <String, UnitData?>{};
    for (final MapEntry(key: label, value: data) in byLabel.entries) {
      if (unitDataProblem(data) case final problem?) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(data, 'data', problem);
      }
      wanted[label] = data.isEmpty ? null : UnitData(data);
    }
    return _setUnitComponents<UnitData>(wanted, 'Unit data');
  }

  /// Gives the unit labelled [label] the swatch [colour] (null removes it),
  /// one "Unit colour" step (today's `setTableColor`, :1631), under
  /// [setUnitData]'s rules.
  bool setUnitColour(String label, PlanSwatch? colour) =>
      setUnitsColour({label: colour});

  /// [setUnitColour] for several units, all or nothing, one undo step.
  bool setUnitsColour(Map<String, PlanSwatch?> byLabel) {
    _requireDesign('setUnitColour');
    return _setUnitComponents<UnitColour>({
      for (final MapEntry(key: l, value: c) in byLabel.entries)
        l: c == null ? null : UnitColour(c),
    }, 'Unit colour');
  }

  /// The one path of the data and colour writes (today's
  /// `_setTableComponents`, :1650-1673).
  bool _setUnitComponents<T extends Component>(
      Map<String, T?> wanted, String label) {
    settlePendingInput();
    final index = _session.units.current;
    final doc = document;
    final labels = <String>{};
    final edits = <DraftCommand>[];
    for (final MapEntry(key: raw, value: next) in wanted.entries) {
      if (!labels.add(raw.trim())) return false;
      final found = index.withLabel(raw);
      if (found.length != 1) return false;
      final instance = found.single.instance;
      if (_session.locks.covers(doc, instance)) return false;
      if (doc.components.get<T>(instance) == next) continue;
      edits.add(SetComponentCommand<T>(instance, next));
    }
    return _runHostEdit(edits, label);
  }

  /// Executes [edits] as one step labelled [label], the engine's
  /// permissions lifted (a host call is not gated, 2a P2); true with
  /// nothing to do.
  bool _runHostEdit(List<DraftCommand> edits, String label) {
    if (edits.isEmpty) return true;
    var applied = false;
    _unrestricted(
        () => applied = execute(CompoundCommand(edits, label: label)));
    _refreshFlags();
    return applied;
  }

  /// Makes [next] the label of the placed unit labelled [label] (spec S3):
  /// one "Label" step. An [ArgumentError] when [next] breaks the text rule
  /// (one to eight UTF-16 units, no control character, trimmed); false,
  /// changing nothing, when [label] names no unit or several, a generated
  /// unit (its type gives its label), a unit under a locked object, or when
  /// another unit already holds [next]. A [StateError] in service.
  bool setUnitLabel(String label, String next) =>
      setUnitsLabel({label: next});

  /// [setUnitLabel] for several units, all or nothing, one step: a [next]
  /// is free when no unit outside the call holds it and no other entry
  /// names it, so two units may swap their labels.
  bool setUnitsLabel(Map<String, String> byLabel) {
    _requireDesign('setUnitLabel');
    for (final next in byLabel.values) {
      if (unitLabelProblem(next) case final problem?) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(next, 'next', 'not a label: $problem');
      }
    }
    settlePendingInput();
    final index = _session.units.current;
    final doc = document;
    final keys = <String>{};
    final renamed = <Handle, String>{};
    for (final MapEntry(key: raw, value: next) in byLabel.entries) {
      if (!keys.add(raw.trim())) return false;
      final found = index.withLabel(raw);
      if (found.length != 1) return false;
      final u = found.single;
      if (u.generated || _session.locks.covers(doc, u.instance)) return false;
      renamed[u.instance] = next.trim();
    }
    final taken = <String>{};
    for (final MapEntry(key: h, value: next) in renamed.entries) {
      if (!taken.add(next)) return false;
      for (final other in index.withLabel(next)) {
        if (other.instance != h && !renamed.containsKey(other.instance)) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    return _runHostEdit([
      for (final MapEntry(key: h, value: next) in renamed.entries)
        if (unitLabelCommand(doc, index[h]!, next) case final command?)
          command,
    ], 'Label');
  }

  // ---- unitChanges (today's designChanges, :1680-1776) ----

  late final StreamController<PlanUnitChange> _unitOut =
      StreamController<PlanUnitChange>.broadcast(
          onListen: _watchUnits, onCancel: _unwatchUnits);
  late final Stream<PlanUnitChange> _unitStream =
      _unitOut.stream.where((_) => !_disposed);
  _UnitBaseline? _unitBaseline;
  int _unitScans = 0;

  /// How many times the design's units were read for [unitChanges].
  @visibleForTesting
  int get debugUnitScans => _unitScans;

  /// The design's unit changes (spec S3), a broadcast stream: after every
  /// design edit, undo or redo, the units added, removed and changed since
  /// the last report, ascending by instance; matched by instance, so a
  /// relabel is one [PlanUnitChanged] and a row edit one change per seat it
  /// changed, an add or a remove per seat it grew or shrank. [load] and
  /// [newPlan] report what is still owed, then [PlanUnitsReplaced] alone.
  /// Nothing done in service is reported. Delivered asynchronously; nothing
  /// is sent on listen; nothing is read while no one listens; closed by
  /// [dispose].
  Stream<PlanUnitChange> get unitChanges => _unitStream;

  void _watchUnits() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _unitBaseline = _unitsNow();
  }

  void _unwatchUnits() => _unitBaseline = null;

  /// The design's units now: the cached [unitDetails] while the design is
  /// active, else read from the design's own index.
  _UnitBaseline _unitsNow() {
    _unitScans++;
    final cache = _session.units;
    final index = cache.current;
    if (identical(cache, _activeUnits)) {
      return _UnitBaseline(index, unitDetailInstances, unitDetails);
    }
    final found = <Handle>[];
    final details = _detailsOf(_session.document, index, found);
    return _UnitBaseline(index, List.unmodifiable(found), details);
  }

  /// Reports what changed in the design since the baseline, and moves it.
  void _reportUnits() {
    final before = _unitBaseline;
    if (before == null || _disposed || before.isAt(_session.units.current)) {
      return;
    }
    final after = _unitBaseline = _unitsNow();
    for (final change in diffUnitDetails(
        before.instances, before.details, after.instances, after.details)) {
      _unitOut.add(change);
    }
  }

  /// A design change (its `commands.changes`): the flags, the revision
  /// while the design is active, the selected labels, the unit changes.
  void _onDesignChange() {
    _refreshFlags();
    if (_inDesign) _revision.value++;
    _refreshSelected();
    _reportUnits();
  }
```

Plan decision (the words): the unit words are today's table words where today has one, with today's texts in the three languages (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/l10n/strings_{en,de,tr}.dart`): `merge`, `split`, `number`, `rotateLeft`, `rotateRight`; `capacity` is today's `seats` ("Seats", "Plätze", "Kişilik"); `labelProblem`, `labelUsed` and `labelWarning`'s `DuplicateLabel` are today's `tableNumberProblem`, `tableNumberUsed` and `numberingWarning`'s `DuplicateNumber` texts, so the ported VW2, VW3 and SE1 keep their assertions; `Unlabelled` says today's text for a table and names the kind for any other; `BadLabel` is new. `label` ("Label", "Bezeichnung", "Etiket"), `unitKind` ("Table"/"Tisch"/"Masa", "Seat"/"Sitzplatz"/"Koltuk") are new. The table-flavoured texts (a seat's duplicate label "used by 2 tables") stay as today's for 0.8.0; a later rewording is sub-project 4's.

Plan decision (the kind's word, spec S4 "Words"): the kit id is the unit's `symbolKey`'s first segment (`kitOfKey`); a unit with no symbol key (a definition without `SymbolComponent`) skips the kit's word. The kit's word is read through its services' `KitWords.maybe('unit:<kit>/<kind>')`, so a host's word (Task 4's merge) comes first. A kit that is not loaded has no services: its step is skipped. The language class for the second step is the one the widgets last reported (`reportLocale`'s `strings`), else the built-in language of the controller's locale: `PlanController.planStrings`.

Plan decision (the unit section, spec S4): it shows for one selected **placed** unit the lock does not cover (2a's rule: a locked object shows no section), after the symbol section (today's order, `selection_panel.dart:1396-1414`): the kind's word as its title (key `unit-section`), the label field (key `unit-label`, titled `number` for a `numbered` unit, `label` for an `assigned` one), the refusal line (`unit-label-error`), the shared-label warning (`unit-label-duplicate`), the capacity (`unit-capacity`), and the ±90 buttons (`unit-rotate-left`, `unit-rotate-right`). The field follows the panel's field cycle (pinned target, commit on focus loss and Enter, revert on refusal); it edits while `permissions.relabel` is on and the document's permissions allow `geometry` (a label is entity text, today's `_editable`, `selection_panel.dart:362-366`). The buttons show while `permissions.rotate` is on and the document allows `transform` and `geometry` (today's `_rotatable`, `:743-748`). The refusal line lasts until the next keystroke in the field or a change of the shown unit (today's `:1003-1006`, `:1097-1099`).

Plan decision (the colour row): today's colour row covers rooms **and tables** (`colors/color_picker.dart:18-67`). 2a ported the rooms' half as the kit types' colour targets; the tables' half is the placed units of the selection that the lock does not cover (a generated seat is never in the design's selection: Task 8 maps it to its row). Their colour is `jetcad.unit_colour`; the row lists the kit targets first, then the units, each in key order (today's rooms, then tables); a unit with a colour of another shape lists a marker that marks nothing (today's `_keptMarker`). `colourRowBlocked` is unchanged in kind: `components` refused → read-only, `recolor` off → refused.

Plan decision (the inspector, spec S4 "The unit inspector"): today's `_TableInspector` (`planner_shell.dart:1626-1700`) and `FloorPlanView._inspect` (`host/floor_plan_view.dart:622-643`), as one internal widget under the property panel: it shows for exactly one selected key, a root key whose target is a placed unit with a label no other unit has; it is built at a selection change that changes the unit shown (frame-safe), at each change of the plan while one is shown (`revision`), and at each host rebuild; never on pan, zoom or hover. It goes with the property panel (`propertyPanel: false` shows none). The design mode only: Task 16 shows `PlanServiceView` in service.

```dart
// 2b Task 10, spec S4 "The unit inspector" (the unit section): one selected
// placed unit shows its kind, its label field (Number for a numbered unit,
// Label for an assigned one; gated by relabel), its capacity and the ±90
// buttons (gated by rotate). Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan's
// tables/table_section_test.dart (TS1-TS8, assertions unchanged) and new
// cases (UW-*). Units are placed off the origin, turned and mirrored.
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show kDoubleTapTimeout;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart' show SelectionKey;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/authoring.dart' show CatalogUnit;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/harness.dart';
import '../support/unit_fixtures.dart';

Finder get section => find.byKey(const Key('unit-section'));
Finder get label => find.byKey(const Key('unit-label'));
Finder get capacity => find.byKey(const Key('unit-capacity'));
Finder get error => find.byKey(const Key('unit-label-error'));
Finder get duplicate => find.byKey(const Key('unit-label-duplicate'));
Finder get left => find.byKey(const Key('unit-rotate-left'));
Finder get right => find.byKey(const Key('unit-rotate-right'));

String fieldText(WidgetTester tester) =>
    tester.widget<TextField>(label).controller!.text;

/// The label field's title.
String fieldTitle(WidgetTester tester) =>
    tester.widget<TextField>(label).decoration!.labelText!;

Future<void> pumpPanel(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c) =>
    pumpApp(tester, SingleChildScrollView(child: PlanPropertyPanel(controller: c)));

Future<void> select(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, Handle h) async {
  c.selection.replace([SelectionKey.root(h)]);
  await tester.pump();
}

Future<void> enterAndSubmit(WidgetTester tester, String text) async {
  await tester.pump(kDoubleTapTimeout * 2);
  await tester.tap(label);
  await tester.pump();
  await tester.enterText(label, text);
  await tester.testTextInput.receiveAction(TextInputAction.done);
  await tester.pump();
  await tester.pump();
}

/// A seat (an assigned unit): [tableSymbol]'s shapes and base point.
const CatalogSymbol seatSymbol = CatalogSymbol(
  key: 'fx.seat.single',
  name: 'Test seat',
  category: 'Tests',
  tags: ['seat', 'test'],
  unit: CatalogUnit(
      kind: UnitKinds.seat, capacity: 1, labelling: UnitLabelling.assigned),
  base: (900, 700),
  shapes: [
    CatalogPolyline([(300, 300), (1500, 300), (1500, 1100), (300, 1100)],
        closed: true),
  ],
);

/// A seat placed by hand (no label) and a table labelled 1, both off the
/// origin, turned or mirrored.
({String json, String seatKey}) seatAndTable() {
  final json = planText([fxKit()], (d) {
    placeAt(d, seatSymbol, Vector2(-2400.5, 1300.25), quarterTurns: 1);
    addUnitLabel(
        d,
        placeAt(d, tableSymbol(seats: 4), Vector2(2400.75, 1300.5),
            mirrored: true),
        '1');
  });
  return (json: json, seatKey: seatSymbol.key);
}

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'UW-section-assigned an assigned unit: the kind\'s word as the title, '
      'the field titled Label, empty; typing gives it a label', (tester) async {
    final f = seatAndTable();
    final c = controllerFor(kits: [fxKit()], json: f.json);
    await pumpPanel(tester, c);
    final seat = c.unitIndex.units.singleWhere((u) => u.text == null);
    await select(tester, c, seat.instance);
    expect(tester.widget<Text>(section).data, 'Seat');
    // M-UW5: the field always titled by `number`.
    expect(fieldTitle(tester), 'Label');
    expect(fieldText(tester), '');
    await enterAndSubmit(tester, 'S1');
    expect(c.unitIndex.withLabel('S1').single.instance, seat.instance);
    final table = c.unitIndex.withLabel('1').single;
    await select(tester, c, table.instance);
    expect(fieldTitle(tester), 'Number');
    expect(tester.widget<Text>(capacity).data, '4');
  });

  testWidgets(
      'UW-relabel-gate relabel off: the field is read-only and a typed '
      'label commits nothing; the buttons still show', (tester) async {
    final f = seatAndTable();
    final c = controllerFor(kits: [fxKit()], json: f.json);
    c.permissions = PlanPermissions.full.copyWith(relabel: false);
    await pumpPanel(tester, c);
    final table = c.unitIndex.withLabel('1').single;
    await select(tester, c, table.instance);
    // M-UW6: `_editable` of the unit target ignoring `relabel`.
    expect(tester.widget<TextField>(label).readOnly, isTrue);
    final depth = c.document.commands.undoDepth;
    await enterAndSubmit(tester, '5');
    expect(c.document.commands.undoDepth, depth);
    expect(c.unitIndex.withLabel('1'), hasLength(1));
    expect(left, findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets(
      'UW-locked-none a placed unit under the lock (its kit missing) shows '
      'no unit section', (tester) async {
    final f = seatAndTable();
    final c = controllerFor(kits: const [], json: f.json);
    await pumpPanel(tester, c);
    final table = c.unitIndex.withLabel('1').single;
    expect(c.isLocked(table.instance), isTrue, reason: 'premise');
    await select(tester, c, table.instance);
    // M-UW7: the unit target ignoring `isLocked`.
    expect(section, findsNothing);
  });
}
```

  In `strings_en.dart` (imports: `UnitKinds` from `package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart`, `'../units/unit_label.dart' show UnitLabelProblem, kUnitLabelMaxLength;` and `'../units/unit_problems.dart' show BadLabel, DuplicateLabel, Unlabelled, UnitLabelWarning;`), before the closing brace:

```dart
  @override
  String get merge => 'Merge';

  @override
  String get split => 'Split';

  @override
  String get number => 'Number';

  @override
  String get label => 'Label';

  @override
  String get capacity => 'Seats';

  @override
  String get rotateLeft => 'Rotate 90° left';

  @override
  String get rotateRight => 'Rotate 90° right';

  @override
  String labelProblem(UnitLabelProblem problem) => switch (problem) {
        UnitLabelProblem.length => '1 to $kUnitLabelMaxLength characters',
        UnitLabelProblem.control => 'No line breaks or control characters',
      };

  @override
  String labelUsed(String label) => 'Number $label is already used';

  @override
  String labelWarning(UnitLabelWarning warning) => switch (warning) {
        DuplicateLabel(:final label, :final count) =>
          'Number $label is used by $count tables',
        Unlabelled(:final kind, :final capacity) => capacity == 1
            ? 'A ${_kindLower(kind)} with 1 seat has no number'
            : 'A ${_kindLower(kind)} with $capacity seats has no number',
        BadLabel(:final label, :final problem) =>
          '"$label" is no label: ${labelProblem(problem)}',
      };

  String _kindLower(String kind) => (unitKind(kind) ?? kind).toLowerCase();

  @override
  String? unitKind(String kind) => switch (kind) {
        UnitKinds.table => 'Table',
        UnitKinds.seat => 'Seat',
        _ => null,
      };
```

```dart
        Unlabelled(:final kind, :final capacity) => kind == UnitKinds.table
            ? '$capacity kişilik bir masanın numarası yok'
            : '$capacity kişilik ${unitKind(kind) ?? kind}: numara yok',
        BadLabel(:final label, :final problem) =>
          '"$label" bir etiket değil: ${labelProblem(problem)}',
      };

  @override
  String? unitKind(String kind) => switch (kind) {
        UnitKinds.table => 'Masa',
        UnitKinds.seat => 'Koltuk',
        _ => null,
      };
```

```dart
// A unit kind's word (spec 2b S4 "Words"): the kit's own, as
// `unit:<kit id>/<kind>` in its KitNames (a host's word first, through the
// kit's KitWords, Task 4); else the contract's word in PlanStrings (table,
// seat); else the kind as stored. The kit id is the unit's symbol key's
// first segment; a unit with no symbol key skips the kit's word.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show kitOfKey;

import '../controller/plan_controller.dart';
import 'unit_index.dart';

/// [unit]'s kind in the controller's language.
String unitKindWord(PlanController c, UnitInfo unit) {
  final key = unit.symbolKey;
  if (key != null) {
    final kit = kitOfKey(key);
    if (c.kits.kitOf(kit) != null) {
      final word = c.servicesOf(kit).words.maybe('unit:$kit/${unit.kind}');
      if (word != null) return word;
    }
  }
  return c.planStrings.unitKind(unit.kind) ?? unit.kind;
}
```

```dart
// The unit section's model (spec 2b S4, the unit section; today's Table
// section, jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/selection_panel.dart:437-456,
// :1193-1248): which placed unit it shows and why a text cannot be its
// label. The widgets are the property panel's.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';

import '../l10n/strings.dart';
import '../units/unit_index.dart';
import '../units/unit_label.dart' show unitLabelProblem;

/// The placed unit [handle] names in [index], or null (no unit, or a
/// generated one: its object stands for it in design).
UnitInfo? placedUnitOf(UnitIndex index, Handle handle) {
  final u = index[handle];
  return u == null || u.generated ? null : u;
}

/// Why [text] (trimmed) cannot be [unit]'s label, worded on demand: the
/// text rule's problem, or a label another unit holds (today's
/// `_parseNumber`, :437-456). Null when it can, or when it is the unit's
/// own label (an unlabelled unit's empty field included: no error).
String Function(PlanStrings)? labelRefusal(
    UnitIndex index, UnitInfo unit, String text) {
  final t = text.trim();
  if (t == (unit.text ?? '')) return null;
  final problem = unitLabelProblem(t);
  if (problem != null) return (s) => s.labelProblem(problem);
  if (index.withLabel(t).any((o) => o.instance != unit.instance)) {
    return (s) => s.labelUsed(t);
  }
  return null;
}
```

```dart
List<Handle> unitColourTargets(PlanController c, Iterable<SelectionKey> keys) {
```

```dart
// The host's unit inspector (spec 2b S4 "The unit inspector"; today's
// _TableInspector, jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/planner_shell.dart:1626-1700,
// and FloorPlanView._inspect, host/floor_plan_view.dart:622-643): built under
// the property panel for exactly one selected placed unit whose label no
// other unit has; again when the unit shown changes (a selection change,
// frame-safe), at each change of the plan while one is shown (the detail is
// read fresh), and at each host rebuild. A hover, the camera and a selection
// change that keeps the unit build nothing.
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show Handle;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show SelectionController;

import '../controller/plan_controller.dart';
import '../panels/frame_safe_relay.dart';
import '../units/unit_detail.dart';

class UnitInspector extends StatefulWidget {
  const UnitInspector(
      {super.key, required this.controller, required this.builder});

  final PlanController controller;
  final Widget? Function(BuildContext context, PlanUnitDetail unit) builder;

  @override
  State<UnitInspector> createState() => _UnitInspectorState();
}

class _UnitInspectorState extends State<UnitInspector> {
  /// The unit shown; null for none.
  Handle? _shown;
  SelectionController? _selection;
  FrameSafeRelay? _relay;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _bind();
    widget.controller.revision.addListener(_onDocument);
    _shown = _inspected();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(UnitInspector oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (!identical(oldWidget.controller, widget.controller)) {
      oldWidget.controller.revision.removeListener(_onDocument);
      widget.controller.revision.addListener(_onDocument);
    }
    _bind();
    _shown = _inspected();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.controller.revision.removeListener(_onDocument);
    _unbind();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// The relay over the controller's current selection (a new one per
  /// document).
  void _bind() {
    final selection = widget.controller.selection;
    if (identical(selection, _selection)) return;
    _unbind();
    _selection = selection;
    _relay = FrameSafeRelay(selection)..addListener(_onSelection);
  }

  void _unbind() {
    _relay
      ?..removeListener(_onSelection)
      ..dispose();
    _relay = null;
    _selection = null;
  }

  /// The selection's one key when it is a root key on a placed unit.
  Handle? _inspected() {
    final c = widget.controller;
    final keys = c.selection.keys;
    if (keys.length != 1) return null;
    final key = keys.single;
    if (key.chain.isNotEmpty) return null;
    return c.unitIndex[key.target]?.generated == false ? key.target : null;
  }

  void _onSelection() {
    final next = _inspected();
    if (next == _shown) return;
    setState(() => _shown = next);
  }

  void _onDocument() {
    _bind();
    final next = _inspected();
    if (next == null && _shown == null) return;
    setState(() => _shown = next);
  }

  /// [instance]'s fresh detail, or null for an unlabelled unit or a label
  /// another unit shares (today's _inspect: the label names no one unit,
  /// and setUnitData refuses it).
  PlanUnitDetail? _detail(Handle instance) {
    final c = widget.controller;
    final details = c.unitDetails;
    final i = c.unitDetailInstances.indexOf(instance);
    if (i < 0) return null;
    final detail = details[i];
    final label = detail.unit.label;
    if (label == null) return null;
    for (var j = 0; j < details.length; j++) {
      if (j != i && details[j].unit.label == label) return null;
    }
    return detail;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final shown = _shown;
    final detail = shown == null ? null : _detail(shown);
    if (detail == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return widget.builder(context, detail) ?? const SizedBox.shrink();
  }
}
```

Plan decisions:
- **The copy is the design's text, decoded under `DraftPermissions.runtime`** (today's `_copyOf`, `jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/host/floor_plan_controller.dart:1305-1319`), with the controller's own registration (`_registerComponents`, which by Task 6 registers the unit components too) and `keepUnreadableComponents: true`, so a component E4 kept raw in the design is kept raw in the copy. No manifest check, no load probe: the design passed both.
- **The copy's systems** stack as the design's (Task 7): `ParametricSystem(copy, catalog, isFrozen: design.frozen.contains)` → `UnitLabelSystem(copy)` → `LockExpander(copy, design.locks)`; disposed in reverse. The frozen set and the lock set are the design session's objects themselves (spec S3: "the handles are the same in both documents").
- **The copy's boundary** is a `FailureBoundary` of its own (document = the copy, system = the copy's, frozen = the design's set, log = the controller's), wired to the copy's lock expander exactly as `_open` wires the design's (`plan_controller.dart:669-681`). Its `lock` callback is `_lockFromCopy(session, objects)`: the objects go into the design's `LockSet` (refreshed over the **design**, so the closure that catches a removal holds the design's handles, which the copy shares), the **copy's** history is cleared, `locked` and the flags are refreshed, the design's grips are told; the design's history is never touched (spec S3, B3 ruling in Risks). The callbacks take the session, so a copy being built (Task 13's restore) clears its own history, never the active one's.
- **A rollback that throws in the copy** (E3) is the copy's alone: `_damageCopy` calls `notifyLoaded()` on the copy (which clears its history, `undo.dart:261-266`), refreshes the flags and notifies; the design's `damaged` stays as it is (the design was not touched). The boundary logs `rollbackFailed` as in the design.
- **The tool:** until Task 14 the copy's tool controller holds an idle placeholder (`_IdleTool`, name `plan.service`): it reacts to nothing. `ToolController` needs an initial tool (`jet_cad_2d_flutter/lib/src/tool.dart:159-163`) and the service tool needs Task 12's groups, so the placeholder is the one temporary piece; Task 14 builds `ServiceTool` in the constructor and deletes `_IdleTool` (controller ruling R-17). There is no `tool:` factory.
- **`deleteSelection` answers false in service** (today's `floor_plan_controller.dart:708-709`): the design is not edited in service, as `execute` (spec S3).
- **The design's tool is reset to `plan.select` on entering service** (today's `toolChanged(FloorPlanTool.select)`, `floor_plan_controller.dart:1279-1281`), so a shape part-way is cancelled and `undo` in service is never held back by a design tool (`_midShape` is consulted in design only, today's `_editorMidShape`, `:1082-1083`).
- **The camera is not reframed on a switch here**: today's `_reframe` moves it by the two views' chrome (`floor_plan_controller.dart:1272-1277`); the chrome is Task 16's (`PlanServiceView`).
- **`_unrestricted` takes the dispatcher it lifts** (`_unrestricted(CommandDispatcher commands, void Function() step)`): `undo`/`redo` pass the active document's, `reportLocale` the design's (it settles the design's separator even in service).

```dart
// Plans for the service-mode tests (2b Tasks 11-13). A placed unit is built
// by engine commands, independent of any symbol library: a definition
// carrying `jetcad.symbol` and `jetcad.unit` with one closed leaf off the
// origin, and an instance carrying its UNIT label (`unitLabelAttrib`, Task
// 3). Every placement is off the origin, turned, most mirrored (CLAUDE.md).
// The helpers are today's (jet_cad_floor_plan's
// test/host/controller_test.dart:26-79): `move`, `drawLine`, `parts`.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/symbols/symbol_placer.dart'
    show placementTransform;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'harness.dart';
import 'service_fixture.dart' show serviceFixture;
import 'test_kit.dart';
import 'unit_fixtures.dart' show addLayer, kDeg37;

// One owner per helper (controller ruling R-19): `kDeg37` and `addLayer`
// are the units' fixture's (Tasks 6 and 8), re-exported for Tasks 11-13.
export 'unit_fixtures.dart' show addLayer, kDeg37;

/// A unit definition made by [unitDefinition]: its handle, its base point
/// and its first leaf's box (the served top).
typedef UnitDef = ({Handle handle, Vector2 base, Aabb2 top});

/// The table's leaf: a closed 1200 x 800 rectangle off the origin; the base
/// point is its box's centre.
final List<Vector2> tableOutline = [
  Vector2(50, 30),
  Vector2(1250, 30),
  Vector2(1250, 830),
  Vector2(50, 830),
];

/// The table's base point, the centre of [tableOutline]'s box.
final Vector2 tableBase = Vector2(650, 430);

/// Adds a symbol definition keyed [key] (version 1) to [d], one closed
/// leaf (a rectangle, or a circle when [round]); with [unit], a
/// `jetcad.unit` of [kind], [capacity] and [labelling].
UnitDef unitDefinition(DraftDocument d,
    {required String key,
    String name = 'Table',
    String kind = UnitKinds.table,
    int capacity = 4,
    UnitLabelling labelling = UnitLabelling.numbered,
    bool unit = true,
    bool round = false}) {
  final def = d.handleSeed.next();
  final leaf = d.handleSeed.next();
  final base = round ? Vector2(300, 260) : tableBase;
  final top = round
      ? Aabb2.fromPoints([Vector2(50, 10), Vector2(550, 510)])
      : Aabb2.fromPoints(tableOutline);
  d.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    AddDefinitionCommand(Definition(
        handle: def,
        name: '$key@1',
        basePoint: base,
        children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<SymbolComponent>(
        def,
        SymbolComponent(
            key: key,
            version: 1,
            name: name,
            category: 'Service',
            tags: const ['service'])),
    if (unit)
      SetComponentCommand<UnitComponent>(
          def,
          UnitComponent(
              kind: kind, capacity: capacity, labelling: labelling)),
    AddEntityCommand(
        record: draftRecord(
            leaf, def, round ? EntityKind.circle : EntityKind.polyline,
            layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero),
        payload: round
            ? circlePayload(Vector2(300, 260), 250)
            : polylinePayload(tableOutline, closed: true)),
  ], label: 'Add definition'));
  return (handle: def, base: base, top: top);
}

/// Places [def] at [at] on [layer] (layer 0 by default), with a UNIT label
/// reading [label] when one is given (the shape the placer writes: layer
/// 0, BYBLOCK, centred, upright in the world); the instance's handle.
Handle placeDef(DraftDocument d, UnitDef def, Transform2 at,
    {String? label, Handle? layer}) {
  final instance = d.handleSeed.next();
  final commands = <DraftCommand>[
    AddNodeCommand(InstanceNode(
        handle: instance,
        parent: d.rootHandle,
        definition: def.handle,
        layer: layer ?? ReservedHandles.layerZero,
        transform: at)),
  ];
  if (label != null) {
    final a = unitLabelAttrib(label,
        instanceToWorld: at, anchor: def.base, top: def.top);
    commands.add(AddEntityCommand(
        record: EntityRecord(
            handle: d.handleSeed.next(),
            owner: instance,
            kind: EntityKind.attrib,
            layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero,
            linetype: ReservedHandles.byBlockLinetype,
            linetypeScale: 1.0,
            geomIndex: 0,
            color: const ByBlockColor(),
            lineweight: kByBlock,
            transparency: kByBlock,
            flags: 0,
            text: a.text,
            tag: a.tag,
            textAttrs: a.textAttrs),
        payload: a.payload));
  }
  d.commands.execute(CompoundCommand(commands, label: 'Place unit'));
  return instance;
}

/// A placement whose [def]'s base point lands at ([x], [y]), turned by
/// [angle] (radians), mirrored when [mirrored].
Transform2 turned(UnitDef def, double x, double y, double angle,
        {bool mirrored = false}) =>
    Transform2.translation(x, y)
        .multiply(Transform2.rotation(angle))
        .multiply(Transform2.scale(mirrored ? -1 : 1, 1))
        .multiply(Transform2.translation(-def.base.x, -def.base.y));

/// Today's `planJson` (controller_test.dart:26-43), saved: tables 1
/// (a quarter turn, mirrored) and 2, a stool 3 (capacity 1, half-turned)
/// and a planter (a symbol that is no unit). [duplicate] labels the stool
/// "2"; [secondAt] moves table 2.
String servicePlanText({bool duplicate = false, Vector2? secondAt}) =>
    planText([testKit()], (d) {
      final table = unitDefinition(d, key: 'test.table.square.four');
      final stool = unitDefinition(d,
          key: 'test.stool.round.one',
          name: 'Stool',
          capacity: 1,
          round: true);
      final planter = unitDefinition(d,
          key: 'test.planter.square.one', name: 'Planter', unit: false);
      placeDef(
          d,
          table,
          placementTransform(
              at: Vector2(-2600, 1400),
              basePoint: table.base,
              quarterTurns: 1,
              mirrored: true),
          label: '1');
      placeDef(
          d,
          table,
          placementTransform(
              at: secondAt ?? Vector2(2300, 1400), basePoint: table.base),
          label: '2');
      placeDef(
          d,
          stool,
          placementTransform(
              at: Vector2(300, -2100),
              basePoint: stool.base,
              quarterTurns: 2),
          label: duplicate ? '2' : '3');
      placeDef(d, planter,
          placementTransform(at: Vector2(4100, -900), basePoint: planter.base));
    });

/// A saved plan with tables 1 and 2 of the test kit and a table 5 whose
/// symbol's kit (`gone`) the host does not load: locked (spec S2 "Locked
/// units").
String lockedPlanText() => planText([testKit()], (d) {
      final table = unitDefinition(d, key: 'test.table.square.four');
      final gone = unitDefinition(d, key: 'gone.table.square.four');
      placeDef(d, table, turned(table, -2600.25, 1400.5, kDeg37, mirrored: true),
          label: '1');
      placeDef(d, table, turned(table, 2300.75, 1700.25, -kDeg37), label: '2');
      placeDef(d, gone, turned(gone, 5100.5, -900.75, kDeg37 * 2), label: '5');
    });

/// [instance]'s UNIT label entity: the lowest handle, as `UnitIndex` reads
/// it; null when it has none.
Handle? labelEntityOf(DraftDocument d, Handle instance) {
  Handle? lowest;
  final e = d.entities;
  for (final slot in e.liveSlots) {
    if (e.ownerAt(slot) != instance) continue;
    if (e.kindAt(slot) != EntityKind.attrib || e.tagAt(slot) != kUnitLabelTag) {
      continue;
    }
    final h = e.handleAt(slot);
    if (lowest == null || h.value < lowest.value) lowest = h;
  }
  return lowest;
}

/// [instance]'s label, trimmed; null when it has none or an empty one.
String? labelOf(DraftDocument d, Handle instance) {
  final h = labelEntityOf(d, instance);
  if (h == null) return null;
  final text = d.entities.textAt(d.entities.slotOf(h)!).trim();
  return text.isEmpty ? null : text;
}

/// The root-level instances of [d] labelled [label], ascending.
List<InstanceNode> unitNodes(DraftDocument d, String label) => [
      for (final n in d.tree.nodes)
        if (n is InstanceNode &&
            n.parent == d.rootHandle &&
            labelOf(d, n.handle) == label)
          n,
    ]..sort((a, b) => a.handle.value.compareTo(b.handle.value));

/// The one root-level instance of [d] labelled [label] (today's
/// `tableNode`).
InstanceNode unitNode(DraftDocument d, String label) =>
    unitNodes(d, label).single;

List<double> parts(Transform2 t) => [t.a, t.b, t.c, t.d, t.e, t.f];

/// A move of the unit labelled [label] in the active document (a service
/// move in service, a design edit in design): one step.
void move(PlanController c, String label, double dx, double dy) {
  final node = unitNode(c.activeDocument, label);
  c.activeDocument.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
    TransformNodeCommand(
        node.handle, Transform2.translation(dx, dy).multiply(node.transform))
  ], label: 'Move'));
}

/// An edit of the active document: a line on layer 0 (refused by the
/// copy's runtime permissions).
void drawLine(PlanController c) =>
    addLine(c.activeDocument, Vector2(-500, 700), Vector2(1800, 2400));

/// Task 5's service fixture as these tests read it (a plan over
/// `unitKit()`): the plan text, the placed table (labelled `12`, turned and
/// mirrored), the two rows (A, six seats, turned; B, five seats, curved)
/// and each row's seats ascending by handle (`A1…`, `B1…`).
({String json, Handle table, List<Handle> rows, List<List<Handle>> seats})
    hall() {
  final f = serviceFixture();
  return (
    json: f.json,
    table: f.table,
    rows: [f.rowA, f.rowB],
    seats: [f.seatsA, f.seatsB],
  );
}
```

```dart
    // M-SM12: the flags read the design.
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isFalse, reason: 'the copy has no history');
    final designed = parts(unitNode(c.activeDocument, '1').transform);
    move(c, '1', 333.5, -71.25);
    await tester.pump();
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isTrue);
    // M-SM11: undo acts on the design.
    c.undo();
    expect(parts(unitNode(c.activeDocument, '1').transform), designed);
    await tester.pump();
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isFalse);
    expect(c.canRedo.value, isTrue);
    c.redo();
    expect(parts(unitNode(c.activeDocument, '1').transform),
        isNot(designed));
    expect(c.document.commands.undoDepth, 1, reason: 'the design untouched');
    expect(c.document.commands.canRedo, isFalse);
    c.setMode(PlanMode.design);
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isTrue);
    expect(c.canRedo.value, isFalse);
    await tester.pump();
  });

      'SM-execute-false in service execute answers false and leaves the '

    expect(

    expect(c.dirty.value, isFalse);

    c.setMode(PlanMode.design);

    await tester.pump();

    expect(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(copy), before,

  testWidgets(
      'SM-copy-boundary a kit hook throwing during a service move: the '
      'object frozen and locked in both documents, one diagnostic, the '
      'copy\'s history cleared and the design\'s kept, the move applied by '
      'the retry; a second type throwing on the retry refuses the move',
      (tester) async {
    final sw = Switches();
    final c = controllerFor(kits: [boxKit(sw), ringKit(sw)]);
    final d = c.document;
    final square =
        addObject(d, atSquare, const SquareParams(side: 1200, poisoned: true));
    final table = unitDefinition(d, key: 'box.table.square.four');
    final t = placeDef(d, table, turned(table, -2600.25, 1400.5, kDeg37,
        mirrored: true), label: '1');
    await tester.pump();
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isTrue, reason: 'premise: the design has history');

    c.setMode(PlanMode.service);
    final copy = c.activeDocument;
    move(c, '1', 120.5, 0);
    expect(copy.commands.undoDepth, 1, reason: 'premise: a first step');
    sw.failing.add('reach');
    final at = transformOf(copy, t);
    final to = Transform2.translation(750.5, -250.25).multiply(at);
    copy.commands.execute(TransformNodeCommand(t, to));
    expect(parts(transformOf(copy, t)), parts(to), reason: 'the retry');
    // M-SM6: `_lockFromCopy` does not add to the lock set.
    expect(c.locked.value, {square});
    // M-SM7: the copy's system ignores the shared frozen set.

    expect(failures, hasLength(1));
    expect((failures.single.kitId, failures.single.subject),
        ('box', SquareParams.id));
    // M-SM5: the lock clears the design's history instead of the copy's.
    expect(copy.commands.undoDepth, 1,
        reason: 'the copy\'s history cleared, then the retried move');
    expect(c.document.commands.canUndo, isTrue,
        reason: 'the design\'s history is kept');
    final sq = transformOf(copy, square);
    expect(
        () => copy.commands.execute(TransformNodeCommand(
            square, Transform2.translation(10.5, 0).multiply(sq))),
        throwsA(isA<PlanLocked>()),
        reason: 'locked in the copy');

    c.setMode(PlanMode.design);
    expect(c.canUndo.value, isTrue);
    expect(
        c.execute(TransformNodeCommand(
            square,
            Transform2.translation(10.5, 0)
                .multiply(transformOf(c.document, square)))),
        isFalse,
        reason: 'locked in the design');
    expect(c.lockHint.value, isTrue);

    // A second type's hook throws on the retry: the move is refused.
    final sw2 = Switches();
    final c2 = controllerFor(kits: [boxKit(sw2), ringKit(sw2)]);
    final d2 = c2.document;
    final square2 =
        addObject(d2, atSquare, const SquareParams(side: 1200, poisoned: true));
    final disc = addObject(d2, nearSquare(-3000.5, 2500.25, 0.5),
        const DiscParams(radius: 400, poisoned: true));
    expect(square2.value < disc.value, isTrue,
        reason: 'premise: the square is surveyed first');
    final table2 = unitDefinition(d2, key: 'box.table.square.four');
    final t2 = placeDef(
        d2, table2, turned(table2, 2300.75, -1700.5, -kDeg37), label: '1');
    c2.setMode(PlanMode.service);
    final copy2 = c2.activeDocument;
    final before = DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(copy2);
    sw2.failing.add('reach');
    expect(
        () => copy2.commands.execute(TransformNodeCommand(t2,
            Transform2.translation(640.375, 12.5).multiply(transformOf(copy2, t2)))),
        throwsA(isA<KitHookFailure>()));
    expect(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(copy2), before,
        reason: 'refused: nothing applied');
    expect(c2.frozen, {square2},
        reason: 'the first type froze; the second failed on the retry');
    expect(copy2.commands.canUndo, isFalse);
    await tester.pump();
  });
}
```

```dart
    expect(y(), closeTo(designed.y - 250, 1e-12 * designed.y.abs()));

    c.setMode(PlanMode.design);
    await tester.pump();
    expect(x(), closeTo(designed.x, 1e-12 * designed.x.abs()));
    expect(y(), closeTo(designed.y, 1e-12 * designed.y.abs()));
  });
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The service session.** Create `lib/src/service/service_session.dart`:

```dart
// The service copy and everything over it (spec 2b S3 "Mode and copy"):
// the design's text decoded under runtime permissions, its parametric
// system over the guarded catalog and the design's frozen set, its unit
// label system, its lock expander over the design's lock set, its own
// failure boundary, its index, page, selection, outlines, unit index and
// tool controller. Today's service copy and its systems
// (jet_cad_floor_plan's floor_plan_controller.dart:1305-1319,
// host/service_view.dart:124-130, :242-245), built like 2a's
// DocumentSession (controller/session.dart:29-89).
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ValueListenable, VoidCallback;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart' show Canvas, KeyEventResult, Size;
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show KeyEvent;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';

import '../controller/diagnostics_log.dart';
import '../kits/guard.dart';
import '../kits/locks.dart';
import '../units/unit_index.dart';
import '../units/unit_label_system.dart';

/// The controller's two modes (spec S3).
enum PlanMode {
  /// The editor over the plan the host loads and saves.
  design,

  /// A copy of the design under runtime permissions: units are tapped,
  /// selected, given statuses, grouped and moved; nothing done here
  /// reaches the design.
  service,
}

/// [design]'s text decoded as a service copy (today's `_copyOf`): under
/// `DraftPermissions.runtime` (transforms and components only), with
/// [register]'s components, a component the design keeps raw (E4) kept
/// raw. The handles are the design's.
DraftDocument serviceCopyOf(DraftDocument design,
        {required void Function(ComponentRegistry registry) register,
        required TextMeasurer measurer}) =>
    DraftDocumentCodec.decodeString(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(design),
        measurer: measurer,
        permissions: DraftPermissions.runtime,
        diagnostics: <Diagnostic>[],
        keepUnreadableComponents: true,
        registerComponents: register);

/// The service copy and its systems and views (spec S3). Made when service
/// is entered (and by a load, a new plan, a reset or a restore in
/// service), disposed after the frame that unmounts its view.
final class ServiceSession {
  /// [locks] and [frozen] are the design session's own (the handles are
  /// the same in both documents); [lock] and [damage] receive this
  /// session with what its boundary found. The copy's one tool is an idle
  /// placeholder until Task 14's `ServiceTool`.
  ServiceSession({
    required this.document,
    required this.measurer,
    required ParametricCatalog catalog,
    required CameraController camera,
    required LockSet locks,
    required Set<Handle> frozen,
    required ValueListenable<Set<Handle>> locked,
    required DiagnosticsLog log,
    required void Function(ServiceSession session, Set<Handle> objects) lock,
    required void Function(ServiceSession session, PartialMutationError error)
        damage,
  })  : page = PageNotifier(document),
        index = SpatialIndex(document) {
    // The selection before the outlines (it prunes a dead key first), as
    // the design's (session.dart:49-56).
    selection = SelectionController(document);
    outlines = OutlineCache(document, selection);
    units = UnitIndexCache(document,
        catalog: catalog, locks: locks, locked: locked);
    toolContext = ToolContext(
        document: document,
        index: index,
        camera: camera,
        selection: selection,
        page: page);
    tool = _IdleTool();
    tools = ToolController(initial: tool, context: toolContext);
    // The design's stack (Task 7): parametric, unit labels, lock.
    parametric = ParametricSystem(document, catalog, isFrozen: frozen.contains)
      ..install();
    labels = UnitLabelSystem(document)..install();
    lockExpander = LockExpander(document, locks)..install();
    boundary = FailureBoundary(
        document: document,
        catalog: catalog,
        system: parametric,
        frozen: frozen,
        log: log,
        lock: (objects) => lock(this, objects),
        damage: (error) => damage(this, error));
    // As the design's (plan_controller.dart:677-681): a hook failure is
    // probed, frozen and retried once.
    lockExpander
      ..onHookFailure = boundary.recover
      ..onPartialMutation = boundary.partialMutation
      ..onRefusedEdit = boundary.recoverRefused
      ..onRetryFailed = boundary.retryFailed;
  }

  /// The copy.
  final DraftDocument document;
  final FlutterTextMeasurer measurer;
  final PageNotifier page;
  final SpatialIndex index;
  late final SelectionController selection;
  late final OutlineCache outlines;

  /// The copy's units: what everything in service reads.
  late final UnitIndexCache units;
  late final ToolContext toolContext;

  /// The copy's one tool, which [tools] holds.
  late final Tool tool;
  late final ToolController tools;
  late final ParametricSystem parametric;
  late final UnitLabelSystem labels;
  late final LockExpander lockExpander;
  late final FailureBoundary boundary;

  /// The controller's subscription to the copy's changes, and its
  /// selection listener; [detach] drops both.
  StreamSubscription<DocChange>? history;
  VoidCallback? onSelection;

  bool get canUndo => document.commands.canUndo;
  bool get canRedo => document.commands.canRedo;

  /// Stops the controller listening, at once.
  void detach() {
    final h = history;
    history = null;
    if (h != null) unawaited(h.cancel());
    final l = onSelection;
    onSelection = null;
    if (l != null) selection.removeListener(l);
  }

  /// Everything, after the frame that unmounts the view: the tool
  /// controller before the tool, the outlines before the selection, the
  /// systems last in first out, the index before the document.
  void dispose() {
    tools.dispose();
    tool.dispose();
    outlines.dispose();
    selection.dispose();
    page.dispose();
    units.dispose();
    lockExpander.dispose();
    labels.dispose();
    parametric.dispose();
    index.dispose();
    unawaited(document.dispose());
    measurer.clear();
  }
}

/// The copy's tool until Task 14's service tool: it reacts to nothing.
final class _IdleTool extends Tool {
  @override
  String get name => 'plan.service';
  @override
  ToolPhase get phase => ToolPhase.idle;
  @override
  void onPointerDown(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) {}
  @override
  void onPointerMove(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) {}
  @override
  void onPointerUp(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) {}
  @override
  void onPointerExit(ToolContext ctx) {}
  @override
  KeyEventResult onKey(KeyEvent event, ToolContext ctx) =>
      KeyEventResult.ignored;
  @override
  void cancel(ToolContext ctx) {}
  @override
  void paintOverlay(Canvas canvas, ViewportTransform camera, Size viewport,
      PaperPalette paper) {}
}
```

```dart
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The mode (spec 2b S3 "Mode and copy").

  final ValueNotifier<PlanMode> _mode = ValueNotifier(PlanMode.design);

  /// The service copy while the mode is service; null in design.
  ServiceSession? _service;

  /// Copies let go of whose disposal waits for the next frame (R-2).
  final List<ServiceSession> _droppedServices = [];

  /// The mode. Changed by [setMode].
  ValueListenable<PlanMode> get mode => _mode;

  /// The document the mode shows: the design, or the service copy.
  DraftDocument get activeDocument => _service?.document ?? _session.document;

  /// The active document's selection: the design's, or the copy's.
  SelectionController get activeSelection =>
      _service?.selection ?? _session.selection;

  /// The service copy and its systems; null in design.
  @internal
  ServiceSession? get serviceSession => _service;

  /// Switches the mode (spec S3). Into service: a copy of the design, the
  /// design's tool back to plan.select. Out of it: the copy is discarded
  /// with every service edit. The selected labels are selected again in
  /// the new mode, by its rules. Moves [revision] and notifies.
  void setMode(PlanMode next) {
    if (next == _mode.value) return;
    settlePendingInput();
    // The settle may have relabelled a selected unit: read it now.
    _refreshSelected();
    final labels = _selectedUnits.value;
    if (next == PlanMode.service) {
      final design = _session;
      // `_onTools` moves `activeTool` back to plan.select.
      design.tools.activate(design.toolById(planSelectToolId)!);
      final copy = _buildService();
      _attachService(copy);
      _service = copy;
    } else {
      final old = _service!;
      _service = null;
      _dropService(old);
    }
    _mode.value = next;
    _select(labels);
    _refreshFlags();
    _revision.value++;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// A copy of the design, its systems installed, nothing listening yet.
  ServiceSession _buildService() {
    final design = _session;
    final measurer = FlutterTextMeasurer();
    final DraftDocument copy;
    try {
      copy = serviceCopyOf(design.document,
          register: _registerComponents, measurer: measurer);
    } catch (_) {
      measurer.clear();
      rethrow;
    }
    return ServiceSession(
        document: copy,
        measurer: measurer,
        catalog: catalog,
        camera: camera,
        locks: design.locks,
        frozen: design.frozen,
        locked: _locked,
        log: _diagnostics,
        lock: _lockFromCopy,
        damage: _damageCopy);
  }

  /// The controller listens to [s]: its changes and its selection.
  void _attachService(ServiceSession s) {
    s.history = s.document.commands.changes.listen((_) {
      if (_disposed || !identical(s, _service)) return;
      _onServiceChanged();
    });
    void onSelection() {
      if (!_disposed && identical(s, _service)) _refreshSelected();
    }

    s.onSelection = onSelection;
    s.selection.addListener(onSelection);
  }

  /// The active copy changed (a move, an undo or a redo of one).
  void _onServiceChanged() {
    _refreshFlags();
    _revision.value++;
    _refreshSelected();
  }

  /// Lets [s] go (R-2): its listeners now, the session after the frame
  /// that unmounts its view.
  void _dropService(ServiceSession s) {
    s.detach();
    _droppedServices.add(s);
    SchedulerBinding.instance
      ..addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (_droppedServices.remove(s)) s.dispose();
      })
      ..ensureVisualUpdate();
  }

  /// The copy's boundary froze [objects] (spec S3): they join the design's
  /// lock set (refreshed over the design, whose handles the copy shares),
  /// the copy's history is cleared so no earlier service step is undone
  /// onto them, and the listeners are told. The design's history is never
  /// touched (Risks, B3).
  void _lockFromCopy(ServiceSession s, Set<Handle> objects) {
    if (objects.isEmpty) return;
    _session.locks.addBroken(document, objects);
    s.document.commands.clearHistory();
    _locked.value = _session.locks.objects;
    _refreshFlags();
    grips.gatesChanged();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// E3 in the copy: a rollback threw there. The copy is rebuilt from
  /// what it holds (its history cleared); the design is not touched.
  void _damageCopy(ServiceSession s, PartialMutationError error) {
    s.document.commands.notifyLoaded();
    _refreshFlags();
    notifyListeners();
  }
```

Plan decisions:
- **A unit's lock in the group rules is `UnitInfo.locked`** (`isLockedUnit`, spec S2): a placed unit of a missing kit's symbol and a seat of a frozen row count as locked members (visible, never selectable, the group never dragged), where today's `GroupTable.locked` read the layer alone (`jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/host/floor_plan_controller.dart:1906-1914`).
- **A seat is a member like a table** (spec S3: "a group may mix kinds"); `GroupUnit.generated` is carried so that Task 14 can refuse to drag a group holding one (`hasGeneratedVisibleMember`).
- **The lookup is rebuilt when the active unit index or the groups change** (identity of `UnitIndexCache.current`, which moves with the state id, the layers' revision and `locked`, Task 6; identity of the groups map): today's three keys (`floor_plan_controller.dart:1896-1920`) in one.
- **A status resolves by label** (`statusOfUnit`): the status of the label's group when that group has one, else the label's own; an unlabelled unit has none. So two units sharing a label both take it (spec S2), and a locked member takes its group's (spec S2 "its group's status paints on it").
- `serviceChanges` on `setUnitGroups` in service is Task 13's (it owns `serviceChanges`).

```dart
/// The labels given to the tables in handle order: not sorted.
const List<String> kGroupLabels = ['12', '3', '7', '20', '5', '8', '9'];

/// Today's `groupsPlanJson` (table_groups_controller_test.dart:23-85),
/// saved: tables labelled [kGroupLabels] in handle order, each off the
/// origin, turned or mirrored; table 8 on a visible locked layer, table 9
/// on a hidden one; an unlabelled table last. [duplicate] labels table 5
/// "3"; [hideNine] false leaves table 9 on layer 0. [eightTwice] labels
/// table 5 "8", so 8 is carried by table 5's unlocked table and the locked
/// one; [lockFive] then puts table 5's table on the locked layer instead,
/// so the locked carrier of 8 comes first in handle order.
String groupsPlanText(
        {bool duplicate = false,
        bool hideNine = true,
        bool eightTwice = false,
        bool lockFive = false}) =>
    planText([testKit()], (d) {
      final locked = addLayer(d, 'Locked', visible: true, locked: true);
      final hidden = addLayer(d, 'Hidden', visible: false, locked: false);
      final table = unitDefinition(d, key: 'test.table.square.four');
      final placements = [
        turned(table, -2600, 1400, kDeg37, mirrored: true),
        turned(table, 2300, 1700, kDeg37 * 2),
        turned(table, 5100, -900, -kDeg37, mirrored: true),
        turned(table, -4300, -2600, 0, mirrored: true),
        turned(table, 800, -3300, kDeg37),
        turned(table, 7400, 2200, kDeg37 * 3),
        turned(table, -7100, 3900, -kDeg37 * 2, mirrored: true),
      ];
      final units = <Handle>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < placements.length; i++) {
        final label = switch (kGroupLabels[i]) {
          '5' when duplicate => '3',
          '5' when eightTwice => '8',
          final l => l,
        };
        units.add(placeDef(d, table, placements[i], label: label));
      }
      placeDef(d, table,
          placementTransform(
              at: Vector2(3600, 5200), basePoint: table.base, quarterTurns: 3));
      d.commands.execute(
          SetInstanceLayerCommand(units[lockFive ? 4 : 5], locked));
      if (hideNine) {
        d.commands.execute(SetInstanceLayerCommand(units[6], hidden));
      }
    });

/// The selection keys of the units labelled [labels] in the active
/// document (today's `keysOf`).
Set<SelectionKey> keysOf(PlanController c, Set<String> labels) => {
      for (final l in labels)
        for (final n in unitNodes(c.activeDocument, l))
          SelectionKey.root(n.handle),
    };

/// The key of the unlabelled unit of the active document.
SelectionKey unlabelledKey(PlanController c) => SelectionKey.root(
    c.unitIndex.units.firstWhere((u) => u.text == null).instance);

/// One design edit: [row]'s seat count set to [count] (Task 5's row).
void setRowCount(PlanController c, Handle row, int count) {
  final r = c.document.components.get<RowComponent>(row)!;
  if (!c.execute(
      SetComponentCommand<RowComponent>(row, r.copyWith(count: count)))) {
    throw StateError('the row edit was refused');
  }
}
```
