```dart
// Service state (spec 2b S3 "Service state"): a unit's status, a group of
// units, the validation of a host's groups, and the group rules the
// controller, the service tool, the painters and the service bar share, so
// each applies one rule. Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan's
// lib/src/host/floor_plan_types.dart (TableStatus :128-159, TableGroup
// :244-300) and lib/src/service/table_groups.dart (whole file), keyed by
// label instead of number; a unit's lock is `isLockedUnit` (spec S2
// "Locked units"), not its layer's alone.
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show immutable, setEquals;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart' show Color, StringCharacters;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show Handle;

import '../units/unit_index.dart';

/// A unit's status as the host colours it in service (spec S3): a fill
/// under the drafting and an optional short caption. Not document state:
/// never saved, exported, printed or undone.
@immutable
final class UnitStatus {
  /// [caption] is cut to [maxCaption] characters (grapheme clusters).
  UnitStatus({required this.color, String? caption})
      : caption = caption?.characters.take(maxCaption).toString();

  /// The longest caption, in characters.
  static const int maxCaption = 12;

  /// The fill, drawn as given: a translucent colour lets the paper show.
  final Color color;

  final String? caption;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is UnitStatus && other.color == color && other.caption == caption;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(color, caption);

  @override
  String toString() => 'UnitStatus($color, $caption)';
}

/// A group of units the host merged (spec S3): in service its members are
/// framed, labelled, selected and moved as one. Addressed by the host's
/// group id. Not document state.
@immutable
final class UnitGroup {
  /// [members] are unit labels, each trimmed, a blank one dropped. [label]
  /// is trimmed, a blank one meaning none, then cut to [maxLabel]
  /// characters (grapheme clusters).
  UnitGroup({required Set<String> members, String? label})
      : members = Set.unmodifiable(<String>{
          for (final m in members)
            if (m.trim().isNotEmpty) m.trim()
        }),
        label = switch (label?.trim()) {
          null || '' => null,
          final l => l.characters.take(maxLabel).toString(),
        };

  /// The longest label, in characters.
  static const int maxLabel = 24;

  /// The member labels, trimmed, none blank; unmodifiable. A label with no
  /// live unit is kept and resolves once such a unit exists.
  final Set<String> members;

  /// The host's text for the group's chip, or null for its labels.
  final String? label;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is UnitGroup &&
      other.label == label &&
      setEquals(other.members, members);

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(Object.hashAllUnordered(members), label);

  @override
  String toString() => 'UnitGroup($members, $label)';
}

/// [groups] with their ids trimmed, in their given order, unmodifiable.
///
/// Throws an [ArgumentError], before anything is returned, for an empty or
/// blank id, for two ids that are the same after trimming, for a group
/// with no member (a [UnitGroup] drops blank members), and for a label in
/// two groups; the message names the label and both ids.
Map<String, UnitGroup> validateUnitGroups(Map<String, UnitGroup> groups) {
  final out = <String, UnitGroup>{};
  final owner = <String, String>{};
  for (final MapEntry(key: raw, value: group) in groups.entries) {
    final id = raw.trim();
    if (id.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(raw, 'groups', 'A group id is blank');
    }
    if (out.containsKey(id)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
          raw, 'groups', 'Two group ids are "$id" after trimming');
    }
    if (group.members.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(raw, 'groups', 'Group "$id" has no member');
    }
    for (final l in group.members) {
      final other = owner[l];
      if (other != null) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(raw, 'groups',
            'Unit label "$l" is in two groups, "$other" and "$id"');
      }
      owner[l] = id;
    }
    out[id] = group;
  }
  return Map.unmodifiable(out);
}

/// The id of the group each member label of [groups] belongs to; [groups]
/// as [validateUnitGroups] returns them, so a label has one group.
Map<String, String> groupIdsByLabel(Map<String, UnitGroup> groups) => {
      for (final MapEntry(key: id, value: g) in groups.entries)
        for (final l in g.members) l: id,
    };

/// One unit as the group rules see it.
final class GroupUnit {
  const GroupUnit(
      {required this.handle,
      required this.label,
      required this.visible,
      required this.locked,
      this.generated = false});

  /// The unit's instance.
  final Handle handle;

  /// Its label, trimmed, or null while it has none.
  final String? label;

  /// On a shown layer (a hidden unit counts for nothing).
  final bool visible;

  /// `isLockedUnit`: shown and tapped, never selected (spec S2).
  final bool locked;

  /// Made by its object's type: never dragged (spec S4).
  final bool generated;

  /// Visible and unlocked: what a selection may hold.
  bool get selectable => visible && !locked;

  @override
  String toString() => 'GroupUnit(${handle.toHex()}, $label'
      '${visible ? '' : ', hidden'}${locked ? ', locked' : ''}'
      '${generated ? ', generated' : ''})';
}

/// [index]'s units as the group rules see them.
List<GroupUnit> groupUnitsOf(UnitIndex index) => [
      for (final u in index.units)
        GroupUnit(
            handle: u.instance,
            label: u.text,
            visible: u.visible,
            locked: u.locked,
            generated: u.generated),
    ];

/// The groups resolved against one document's units. Built at
/// document-change or groups-change rate, never per frame or per pointer
/// event.
final class UnitGroupLookup {
  /// [groups] as [validateUnitGroups] returns them; [units] in any order.
  factory UnitGroupLookup(
      Map<String, UnitGroup> groups, Iterable<GroupUnit> units) {
    final byLabel = groupIdsByLabel(groups);
    final sorted = units.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.handle.value.compareTo(b.handle.value));
    final visible = <String, List<GroupUnit>>{};
    for (final u in sorted) {
      final l = u.label;
      if (l == null || !u.visible) continue;
      final id = byLabel[l];
      if (id != null) (visible[id] ??= []).add(u);
    }
    return UnitGroupLookup._(
      groups,
      Map.unmodifiable(byLabel),
      {
        for (final MapEntry(key: id, value: list) in visible.entries)
          id: List.unmodifiable(list),
      },
      {
        for (final MapEntry(key: id, value: list) in visible.entries)
          id: List.unmodifiable([
            for (final u in list)
              if (u.selectable) u
          ]),
      },
      {
        for (final MapEntry(key: id, value: list) in visible.entries)
          if (list.any((u) => u.locked)) id,
      },
      {
        for (final MapEntry(key: id, value: list) in visible.entries)
          if (list.any((u) => u.generated)) id,
      },
    );
  }

  UnitGroupLookup._(this.groups, this.byLabel, this._visible,
      this._selectable, this._locked, this._generated);

  /// The groups this lookup resolves.
  final Map<String, UnitGroup> groups;

  /// The id of each member label's group; unmodifiable.
  final Map<String, String> byLabel;

  final Map<String, List<GroupUnit>> _visible;
  final Map<String, List<GroupUnit>> _selectable;
  final Set<String> _locked;
  final Set<String> _generated;

  /// The id of the group [label] (trimmed) belongs to, or null.
  String? groupOf(String label) => byLabel[label.trim()];

  /// The group's members on a shown layer, a locked one included,
  /// ascending by handle; every unit carrying a member label counts (a
  /// shared label gives several). Empty for an unknown id.
  List<GroupUnit> visibleMembers(String id) => _visible[id] ?? const [];

  /// The group's visible, unlocked members, ascending by handle: what a
  /// tap, a drag or a selection by label may select.
  List<GroupUnit> selectableMembers(String id) => _selectable[id] ?? const [];

  /// Whether a visible member of the group is locked: the group is then
  /// never dragged. A locked member on a hidden layer does not count.
  bool hasLockedVisibleMember(String id) => _locked.contains(id);

  /// Whether a visible member of the group is generated (a seat): the
  /// group is then never dragged (spec S4 "A drag").
  bool hasGeneratedVisibleMember(String id) => _generated.contains(id);

  /// The Split rule, the id `PlanController.selectedGroup` holds: the group
  /// whose selectable members' labels are exactly [selectedLabels], when
  /// that set is not empty and no unlabelled unit is selected
  /// ([unlabelledSelected]); else null.
  String? splitGroup(Set<String> selectedLabels,
      {required bool unlabelledSelected}) {
    if (unlabelledSelected || selectedLabels.isEmpty) return null;
    // A label is in one group at most, so only the first's can match.
    final id = groupOf(selectedLabels.first);
    if (id == null) return null;
    final labels = <String>{
      for (final u in selectableMembers(id)) u.label!,
    };
    final selected = <String>{for (final l in selectedLabels) l.trim()};
    if (labels.length != selected.length || !labels.containsAll(selected)) {
      return null;
    }
    return id;
  }
}

/// The Merge rule: whether [selectedLabels] span two or more units of
/// merging, each a group of [groups] or a selected label in no group. One
/// unit, two units sharing one label, and exactly one group do not;
/// unlabelled units carry no label and count for nothing.
bool mergeQualifies(Set<String> selectedLabels, Map<String, UnitGroup> groups) {
  final byLabel = groupIdsByLabel(groups);
  final parts = <(bool, String)>{};
  for (final raw in selectedLabels) {
    final l = raw.trim();
    if (l.isEmpty) continue;
    final id = byLabel[l];
    parts.add(id == null ? (false, l) : (true, id));
    if (parts.length >= 2) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/// The lead order over [labels]: numeric when every one is all ASCII
/// digits -- (length after stripping leading zeros, then that string,
/// then the label as written), never `int.parse`, so any length compares
/// -- else plain string order.
Comparator<String> unitLabelOrder(Iterable<String> labels) {
  if (labels.isNotEmpty && labels.every(_digits.hasMatch)) return _numeric;
  return _plain;
}

final RegExp _digits = RegExp(r'^[0-9]+$');

int _plain(String a, String b) => a.compareTo(b);

int _numeric(String a, String b) {
  final sa = _stripZeros(a), sb = _stripZeros(b);
  final byLength = sa.length.compareTo(sb.length);
  if (byLength != 0) return byLength;
  final byValue = sa.compareTo(sb);
  if (byValue != 0) return byValue;
  return a.compareTo(b);
}

String _stripZeros(String s) {
  var i = 0;
  while (i < s.length && s.codeUnitAt(i) == 0x30) {
    i++;
  }
  return s.substring(i);
}

/// The labelled units of [members] in lead order: by [unitLabelOrder] over
/// their labels, ties (a shared label) to the lowest handle. The first is
/// the lead.
List<GroupUnit> inLeadOrder(Iterable<GroupUnit> members) {
  final list = [
    for (final u in members)
      if (u.label != null) u
  ];
  final order = unitLabelOrder([for (final u in list) u.label!]);
  list.sort((a, b) {
    final byLabel = order(a.label!, b.label!);
    if (byLabel != 0) return byLabel;
    return a.handle.value.compareTo(b.handle.value);
  });
  return list;
}

/// The status a unit labelled [label] shows: its group's when the group
/// has one, else its own; none for an unlabelled unit (today's
/// `TableStatusPainter` order, group over table).
UnitStatus? statusOfUnit(String? label,
    {required Map<String, UnitStatus> statuses,
    required Map<String, UnitStatus> groupStatuses,
    required Map<String, String> groupByLabel}) {
  if (label == null) return null;
  final id = groupByLabel[label];
  if (id != null) {
    final group = groupStatuses[id];
    if (group != null) return group;
  }
  return statuses[label];
}
```

  // Service state (spec 2b S3 "Service state"), by label. Kept for the
  // controller's life: across mode switches, resetService, restoreService,
  // load and newPlan. Not document state: no command, undo step, dirty or
  // revision; never saved, exported or printed.

  final ValueNotifier<Map<String, UnitStatus>> _statuses =

  /// in service only, on every live, visible unit carrying the label.
  ValueListenable<Map<String, UnitStatus>> get unitStatuses => _statuses;

  /// Replaces every status at once: labels trimmed.
  void setUnitStatus(Map<String, UnitStatus> statuses) {
    _statuses.value = Map.unmodifiable(
        {for (final e in statuses.entries) e.key.trim(): e.value});
  }

  /// The unit groups by trimmed id, as [setUnitGroups] last set them; they

  /// for a blank id, two ids the same after trimming, a group with no
  /// member after trimming, or a label in two groups; then nothing is
  /// assigned and no listener is notified. A member label with no live
  /// unit is kept; a shared label is allowed; a group may mix kinds.
  void setUnitGroups(Map<String, UnitGroup> groups) {
    final valid = validateUnitGroups(groups);
    _groups.value = valid;
    _refreshSelectedGroup();
  }

  /// The groups' statuses by trimmed id, as [setGroupStatus] last set them.
  ValueListenable<Map<String, UnitStatus>> get groupStatuses => _groupStatuses;

  /// Replaces every group status at once: ids trimmed. A group's status
  /// fills every visible member and overrides each member's own status
  /// while it is set. A status whose id has no group is kept, draws
  /// nothing, and applies again when a group with that id comes back.
  void setGroupStatus(Map<String, UnitStatus> statuses) {
    _groupStatuses.value = Map.unmodifiable(
        {for (final e in statuses.entries) e.key.trim(): e.value});
  }

  /// The labels in focus, as [setUnitFocus] last set them: null for none.
  /// In service every unit outside a focus lies under a veil.
  ValueListenable<Set<String>?> get unitFocus => _focus;

  /// Replaces the focus: null for none, else [labels] trimmed, blanks
  /// dropped, copied into an unmodifiable set, so `{}` and `{''}` are a
  /// focus with no unit. Every call notifies [unitFocus], an equal set
  /// included. Presentation only: no command, undo step, dirty, revision,
  /// service change or notification of this controller.
  void setUnitFocus(Set<String>? labels) {
    _focus.replace(labels == null
        ? null
        : Set<String>.unmodifiable({
            for (final l in labels)
              if (l.trim() case final t when t.isNotEmpty) t,
          }));
  }

  /// It updates after [selectedUnits] and [unitGroups] have notified.
  ValueListenable<String?> get selectedGroup => _selectedGroup;

  /// The labels the service bar's Merge would send: in service
  /// [selectedUnits], unmodifiable, when they span two or more groups or
  /// ungrouped labels; null otherwise, and always in design.
  ValueListenable<Set<String>?> get mergeCandidate => _mergeCandidate;

  /// The labels of group [groupId]'s (trimmed) selectable members in the
  /// active document: its live members on a shown layer that no lock
  /// covers. A label several units carry is in it once. Empty for an
  /// unknown id; unmodifiable; valid in both modes, fresh at every call.
  Set<String> selectableMembers(String groupId) => Set.unmodifiable({
        for (final u in _groupLookup.selectableMembers(groupId.trim()))
          u.label!,
      });

  UnitGroupLookup get groupLookup => _groupLookup;

  /// The status [unit] shows (Tasks 15-16): its group's over its own.
  @internal
  UnitStatus? statusOf(UnitInfo unit) => statusOfUnit(unit.text,
      statuses: _statuses.value,
      groupStatuses: _groupStatuses.value,
      groupByLabel: _groupLookup.byLabel);

  UnitGroupLookup? _lookup;
  UnitIndex? _lookupUnits;
  Map<String, UnitGroup>? _lookupGroups;

  /// The groups resolved against the active units, made again when the
  /// unit index (a state, layer or lock change) or the groups move.
  UnitGroupLookup get _groupLookup {
    final units = _activeUnits.current;
    final groups = _groups.value;
    if (_lookup == null ||
        !identical(_lookupUnits, units) ||
        !identical(_lookupGroups, groups)) {
      _lookup = UnitGroupLookup(groups, groupUnitsOf(units));
      _lookupUnits = units;
      _lookupGroups = groups;
    }
    return _lookup!;
  }

  /// [labels], each label of a group replaced by all its members: in
  /// service only, where groups act. (Task 9's seam, given its body here.)
  Set<String> _expandLabels(Set<String> labels) {
    final groups = _groups.value;
    if (_service == null || groups.isEmpty) return labels;
    final lookup = _groupLookup;
    return {
      for (final l in labels)
        ...switch (lookup.groupOf(l)) {
          null => [l],
          final id => groups[id]!.members,
        }
    };
  }

  /// [selectedGroup] and [mergeCandidate] over the active document.
  void _refreshSelectedGroup() {
    final service = _service != null;
    String? id;
    if (service && _groups.value.isNotEmpty) {
      final keys = activeSelection.keys;
      final unlabelled = _activeUnits.current.units.any((u) =>
          u.text == null && keys.contains(SelectionKey.root(u.instance)));
      id = _groupLookup.splitGroup(_selectedUnits.value,
          unlabelledSelected: unlabelled);
    }
    _selectedGroup.value = id;
    final selected = _selectedUnits.value;
    final candidate =
        service && mergeQualifies(selected, _groups.value) ? selected : null;
    final last = _mergeCandidate.value;
    if (candidate == null ? last != null : !setEquals(candidate, last)) {
      _mergeCandidate.value = candidate;
    }
  }

Plan decisions:
- **The record's shape** is the spec's (S3): `{"format", "version", "moves": [{"handle", "label", "from", "to"}], "groups": [{"id", "members", "label"}]}`, in that key order. Moves are ascending by handle (today's `serviceLayoutOf`, `jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/host/service_layout.dart:47-64`); groups in the controller's order, members in each group's set order, so `serviceJson()` after a restore is byte for byte the record restored.
- **What is a `FormatException`** (nothing changed): text that is not JSON or not an object; a `format` other than `jet_cad.service` (today's `jet_cad.service_layout` included); a `version` other than 1; `moves` or `groups` missing or not a list; a move as today's layout entry would be refused (`service_layout.dart:86-130`, `number` read as `label`); a group that is not an object, whose `id` is not a string, whose `members` is not a list of strings, or whose `label` is neither a string nor null (absent counts as null). Groups that break `setUnitGroups`' validation are **not** a `FormatException` (spec S3): they are dropped by the match.
- **The groups' match**, in record order, each group checked against the groups applied before it: its `id` trimmed must not be blank nor equal one applied; its members (trimmed, blanks dropped by `UnitGroup`) must not be empty; every member must name a unit of the design (any unit carrying the label, hidden or locked included; a shared label is kept, spec S3); no member may already belong to an applied group (the later group drops). A group failing any check is dropped whole, never shrunk; `appliedGroups` and `droppedGroups` list the trimmed ids in record order.
- **The moves' strict match** is today's (`service_layout.dart:138-169`) over the design's `UnitIndex`: the handle is a unit of the design, **placed** (`!generated`, spec S3 "Only placed units move"), not `isLockedUnit` (spec S3), on a visible unlocked layer (a missing layer counts as visible), carrying the same label (null for an unlabelled one), exactly at `from`, `to` a translation of `from`, every value finite.
- **A restore builds the new copy before it drops the old one**: the applied moves are executed on the new copy (its systems installed, so a place reader regenerates as on any service move; a translation re-stamps no label), its history cleared, and only then is the controller attached to it (`_attachService`), so the restore is no step and fires no change of its own; a failure while applying disposes the new copy and leaves everything as it was. Today's restore executed before attaching too (`floor_plan_controller.dart:1142-1155`).
- **The groups held when service was entered** (`_groupsAtEnter`, for `serviceEdited`): set by `setMode` into service and by a load or a new plan in service (a fresh copy, as today a fresh copy reads unedited), set to none by `resetService` (which clears the groups), left as they were by `restoreService` (so a record's groups that differ from those held on entering read as an edit).
- **`serviceChanges` timing** is today's (`floor_plan_controller.dart:1103-1111`, `:1425-1436`): on a change of the active copy's history state (a move, an undo, a redo), announced by `undo`/`redo` before they return and heard once; `resetService`; `restoreService`; and, new (spec S3, S5 row 4), `setUnitGroups` in service. Never on `setMode`, `load` or `newPlan`. In design `setUnitGroups` notifies `unitGroups` only.

Rulings for the ported tests, accepted by controller ruling R-11 (each a premise the spec changed; each an execution ruling the ledger records):
- **R13-a (the format is the premise):** LC2's `contains('"format":"jet_cad.service_layout"')` becomes `contains('"format":"jet_cad.service"')`; LC3's and LC4's texts are written in the new format (`moves`, `label`, `groups: []`), each bad text keeping its kind of breakage; C16's `jsonDecode(…)['tables']` reads `['moves']`; C20's `contains('"tables":[{')` and `contains('"tables":[]')` read `'"moves":[{'` and `'"moves":[]'`. Spec S3 (the record), S5 row 7 (no compatibility).

No assertion changes.

// jet_cad_floor_plan's test/host/service_layout_test.dart (LC1-LC6),
// ported to the service record (spec 2b S3 "The service record"):
// assertions unchanged but where the format itself is the premise
// (ruling R13-a). Units are turned, mirrored and off the origin; moves are
// off-grid; the copy is a decoded copy of the design under runtime

/// Units 1 (a quarter turn, mirrored), 2, 3 (a stool, half-turned) and 4
/// (on layer `L`), and a planter (today's `design()`,
/// service_layout_test.dart:16-45).
DraftDocument design() {
  final d = planDocument([testKit()]);
  final table = unitDefinition(d, key: 'test.table.square.four');
  final stool = unitDefinition(d,
      key: 'test.stool.round.one', name: 'Stool', capacity: 1, round: true);
  final planter = unitDefinition(d,
      key: 'test.planter.square.one', name: 'Planter', unit: false);
  placeDef(
      d,
      table,
      placementTransform(
          at: Vector2(-2600.25, 1400.5),
          basePoint: table.base,
          quarterTurns: 1,
          mirrored: true),
      label: '1');
  placeDef(
      d,
      table,
      placementTransform(at: Vector2(2300.75, 1400), basePoint: table.base),
      label: '2');
  placeDef(
      d,
      stool,
      placementTransform(
          at: Vector2(300, -2100.125), basePoint: stool.base, quarterTurns: 2),
      label: '3');
  final four = placeDef(
      d,
      table,
      placementTransform(
          at: Vector2(5100.5, -3300.25),
          basePoint: table.base,
          quarterTurns: 3),
      label: '4');
  placeDef(d, planter,
      placementTransform(at: Vector2(4100, -900), basePoint: planter.base));
  final layer = addLayer(d, 'L', visible: true, locked: false);
  d.commands.execute(SetInstanceLayerCommand(four, layer));
  return d;
}

DraftDocument copyOf(DraftDocument doc) => DraftDocumentCodec.decodeString(
    DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(doc),
    permissions: DraftPermissions.runtime,
    registerComponents: (r) => registerPlanComponents(r, catalogOf([testKit()])));

/// [d]'s units, every kit but the test kit missing.
UnitIndex unitsOf(DraftDocument d) => UnitIndex.of(d,
    catalog: catalogOf([testKit()]),
    locks: LockSet.scan(d, (kit) => kit == 'test'));

InstanceNode table(DraftDocument doc, String label) => unitNode(doc, label);

void moveIn(DraftDocument doc, String label, double dx, double dy) {
  final node = table(doc, label);
  doc.commands.execute(TransformNodeCommand(
      node.handle, Transform2.translation(dx, dy).multiply(node.transform)));
}

/// [d]'s copy with every unit moved, the highest handle first.
DraftDocument movedCopy(DraftDocument d) {
  final copy = copyOf(d);
  for (final (l, dx, dy) in const [
    ('4', 111.125, -37.5),
    ('3', -250.5, 75.25),
    ('2', 640.375, 12.5),
    ('1', -95.75, -410.625),
  ]) {
    moveIn(copy, l, dx, dy);
  }
  return copy;
}

List<ServiceMove> movesOf(DraftDocument d, DraftDocument copy) =>
    serviceMovesOf(d, copy, unitsOf(copy));

void main() {
  test(
      'LC1 the record lists the moved units, ascending by handle although '
      'moved highest first; a unit moved back exactly is not listed (S1, '
      'M-14d-n)', () {
    final d = design();
    final copy = movedCopy(d);
    moveIn(copy, '2', -640.375, -12.5);
    final entries = movesOf(d, copy);
    expect([for (final e in entries) e.label], ['1', '3', '4']);
    final handles = [for (final e in entries) e.handle.value];
    expect(handles, [...handles]..sort());
    expect(handles.first < handles.last, isTrue, reason: 'premise');
    for (final e in entries) {
      expect(parts(e.from), parts(table(d, e.label!).transform));
      expect(parts(e.to), parts(table(copy, e.label!).transform));
    }
    expect(parts(entries.first.to)[4],
        closeTo(parts(entries.first.from)[4] - 95.75, 1e-9));
  });

  test(
      'LC2 the encoding round-trips, and is byte-equal twice and after the '
      'design is encoded and decoded (S1, M-14d-n)', () {
    final d = design();
    final copy = movedCopy(d);
    final text = encodeServiceRecord(movesOf(d, copy), const {});
    expect(encodeServiceRecord(movesOf(d, copy), const {}), text);
    expect(encodeServiceRecord(movesOf(copyOf(d), copy), const {}), text);
    final back = decodeServiceRecord(text);
    expect(encodeServiceRecord(back.moves, const {}), text);
    // Ruling R13-a: today's 'jet_cad.service_layout'.
    expect(text, contains('"format":"jet_cad.service"'));
    expect(text, contains('"version":1'));
  });

  test('LC3 a text that is not a version-1 record is refused (S2, R13-a)', () {
    String record(String moves, {String format = 'jet_cad.service'}) =>
        '{"format":"$format","version":1,"moves":$moves,"groups":[]}';
    const ok = '[1,0,0,1,10.5,-3]';
    String entry(
            {String handle = '"2F"',
            String label = '"1"',
            String from = ok,
            String to = ok}) =>
        '{"handle":$handle,"label":$label,"from":$from,"to":$to}';
    expect(decodeServiceRecord(record('[${entry()}]')).moves, hasLength(1));
    expect(
        decodeServiceRecord(record('[${entry(label: 'null')}]'))
            .moves
            .single
            .label,
        isNull);
    for (final bad in [
      'not json',
      '[]',
      record('[]', format: 'other'),
      '{"format":"jet_cad.service","version":2,"moves":[],"groups":[]}',
      record('{}'),
      record('[3]'),
      record('[${entry(handle: '"XYZ"')}]'),
      record('[${entry(handle: '47')}]'),
      record('[${entry(label: '5')}]'),
      record('[${entry(from: '[1,0,0,1,10]')}]'),
      record('[${entry(to: '[1,0,0,1,10,"x"]')}]'),
      record('[${entry()},${entry(label: '"2"')}]'),
    ]) {
      expect(() => decodeServiceRecord(bad), throwsFormatException,
          reason: bad);
    }
  });

  test('LC4 `1` and `1.0` read alike (V-21, R13-a)', () {
    final a = decodeServiceRecord('{"format":"jet_cad.service",'
        '"version":1,"moves":[{"handle":"A","label":null,'
        '"from":[1,0,0,1,2,3],"to":[1,0,0,1,4,5]}],"groups":[]}');
    final b = decodeServiceRecord('{"format":"jet_cad.service",'
        '"version":1,"moves":[{"handle":"A","label":null,'
        '"from":[1.0,0.0,0.0,1.0,2.0,3.0],"to":[1.0,0.0,0.0,1.0,4.0,5.0]}],'
        '"groups":[]}');
    expect(parts(a.moves.single.to), parts(b.moves.single.to));
    expect(sameTransform(a.moves.single.from, b.moves.single.from), isTrue);
  });

  test(
      'LC6 an unlabelled unit moved is listed with a null label and '
      'applied by the match (S1, S2, review F-3)', () {
    final d = design();
    final spare = table(d, '2');
    d.commands.execute(SetEntityTextCommand(
        labelEntityOf(d, spare.handle)!, '', kUnitLabelTag));
    expect(unitsOf(d).units.where((u) => u.text == null), hasLength(1),
        reason: 'premise: one unlabelled unit');
    final copy = copyOf(d);
    final node = copy.tree[spare.handle]! as InstanceNode;
    copy.commands.execute(TransformNodeCommand(node.handle,
        Transform2.translation(-310.375, 58.25).multiply(node.transform)));
    final entries =
        decodeServiceRecord(encodeServiceRecord(movesOf(d, copy), const {}))
            .moves;
    expect([for (final e in entries) e.label], [null]);
    expect(entries.single.handle, spare.handle);
    final m = matchServiceMoves(d, unitsOf(d), entries);
    expect([for (final e in m.applied) e.label], [null]);
    expect(m.dropped, isEmpty);
  });

  group('LC5 the strict match (S2, M-14d-l)', () {
    late DraftDocument d;
    late List<ServiceMove> entries;
    setUp(() {
      d = design();
      entries = decodeServiceRecord(
              encodeServiceRecord(movesOf(d, movedCopy(d)), const {}))
          .moves;
    });
    List<String?> dropped() => [
          for (final e in matchServiceMoves(d, unitsOf(d), entries).dropped)
            e.label
        ];

    test('an unchanged design applies every entry', () {
      final m = matchServiceMoves(d, unitsOf(d), entries);
      expect([for (final e in m.applied) e.label], ['1', '2', '3', '4']);
      expect(m.dropped, isEmpty);
    });

    test('a unit moved in the design since is dropped', () {
      moveIn(d, '2', 0.5, 0);
      expect(dropped(), ['2']);
    });

    test('a unit relabelled in the design since is dropped', () {
      d.commands.execute(SetEntityTextCommand(
          labelEntityOf(d, table(d, '3').handle)!, '9', kUnitLabelTag));
      expect(dropped(), ['3']);
    });

    test('a unit locked or hidden in the design since is dropped', () {
      final layer = d.tables.layers[table(d, '4').layer]!;
      d.commands.execute(SetLayerCommand(layer.copyWith(locked: true)));
      expect(dropped(), ['4']);
      d.commands.execute(
          SetLayerCommand(layer.copyWith(locked: false, visible: false)));
      expect(dropped(), ['4']);
    });

    test(
        'an entry for a missing node, a non-unit, or another unit with the '
        'label of the first is dropped', () {
      final first = entries.first;
      final units = unitsOf(d);
      final planter = d.tree.nodes
          .whereType<InstanceNode>()
          .where((n) => units[n.handle] == null)
          .single
          .handle;
      entries = [
        for (final h in [
          Handle(d.handleSeed.current.value + 50),
          planter,
          table(d, '2').handle,
        ])
          ServiceMove(
              handle: h, label: first.label, from: first.from, to: first.to),
      ];
      expect(matchServiceMoves(d, unitsOf(d), entries).applied, isEmpty);
    });

    test(
        'an entry that turns the unit, shears it in one term, or holds a '
        'NaN or an infinity, is dropped (review F-5)', () {
      final e = entries.first;
      final t = e.to;
      for (final to in [
        Transform2.rotation(0.25).multiply(t),
        Transform2(t.a, t.b + 0.25, t.c, t.d, t.e, t.f),
        Transform2(t.a, t.b, t.c, t.d, double.nan, t.f),
        Transform2(t.a, t.b, t.c, t.d, t.e, double.infinity),
      ]) {
        final one = [
          ServiceMove(handle: e.handle, label: e.label, from: e.from, to: to)
        ];
        expect(matchServiceMoves(d, unitsOf(d), one).applied, isEmpty,
            reason: '$to');
      }
      expect(matchServiceMoves(d, unitsOf(d), [e]).applied, hasLength(1),
          reason: 'premise: the entry itself applies');
    });
  });

  test(
      'SR-codec-shapes the groups: a list of objects with a string id, a list '
      'of string members and a string or null label; anything else is a '
      'FormatException; a group the validation would refuse decodes as '
      'written', () {
    String record(String groups) =>
        '{"format":"jet_cad.service","version":1,"moves":[],"groups":$groups}';
    final ok = decodeServiceRecord(record(
        '[{"id":" ","members":[],"label":null},{"id":"g1","members":["1"," 1 "]}]'));
    expect([for (final g in ok.groups) g.id], [' ', 'g1']);
    expect(ok.groups.last.members, ['1', ' 1 ']);
    expect(ok.groups.last.label, isNull);
    for (final bad in [
      // M-SR19: `groups` missing read as none.
      '{"format":"jet_cad.service","version":1,"moves":[]}',
      record('{}'),
      record('[3]'),
      record('[{"members":["1"]}]'),
      record('[{"id":3,"members":["1"]}]'),
      record('[{"id":"g","members":"1"}]'),
      record('[{"id":"g","members":[1]}]'),
      record('[{"id":"g","members":["1"],"label":5}]'),
    ]) {
      expect(() => decodeServiceRecord(bad), throwsFormatException,
          reason: bad);
    }
  });
}

/// A version-1 record of [moves] and [groups], as a host would store one.
String record(
        {List<Map<String, Object?>> moves = const [],
        List<Map<String, Object?>> groups = const []}) =>
    jsonEncode({
      'format': 'jet_cad.service',
      'version': 1,
      'moves': moves,
      'groups': groups,
    });

/// A record's move of [node] (labelled [label]) by ([dx], [dy]).
Map<String, Object?> moveOf(
        InstanceNode node, String? label, double dx, double dy) =>
    {
      'handle': node.handle.toHex(),
      'label': label,
      'from': node.transform.toJson(),
      'to': Transform2.translation(dx, dy).multiply(node.transform).toJson(),
    };

/// A record's group.
Map<String, Object?> groupOf(String id, List<String> members,
        [String? label]) =>
    {'id': id, 'members': members, 'label': label};

- [ ] **Step 5: The record.** Create `lib/src/service/service_record.dart`:

```dart
// The service record (spec 2b S3 "The service record", decision 4): the
// moves the service copy made and the host's groups, as a small JSON a
// host stores apart from the design, and the strict match that decides
// which of a stored record's moves and groups still apply to the design.
// Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan's lib/src/host/service_layout.dart (the
// whole file), keyed by label, with groups added; today's
// `jet_cad.service_layout` text is refused (no compatibility, spec S5).
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show immutable;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';

import '../units/unit_index.dart';
import 'service_state.dart';

/// The record's `format` value.
const String kServiceFormat = 'jet_cad.service';

/// The record's `version` value.
const int kServiceVersion = 1;

/// One moved unit: its instance, its label when it had one, its transform
/// in the design ([from]) and in the copy ([to]).
final class ServiceMove {
  const ServiceMove(
      {required this.handle,
      required this.label,
      required this.from,
      required this.to});

  final Handle handle;
  final String? label;
  final Transform2 from;
  final Transform2 to;

  @override
  String toString() => 'ServiceMove(${handle.toHex()}, $label)';
}

/// One group as a record holds it, before any check: its id, its members
/// and its label as written.
final class RecordGroup {
  const RecordGroup(
      {required this.id, required this.members, required this.label});

  final String id;
  final List<String> members;
  final String? label;
}

/// A decoded record.
final class ServiceRecord {
  const ServiceRecord({required this.moves, required this.groups});

  final List<ServiceMove> moves;
  final List<RecordGroup> groups;
}

/// Whether [a] and [b] are the same stored value: `Transform2` has no
/// `==` on purpose, and a record compares stored transforms exactly.
bool sameTransform(Transform2 a, Transform2 b) =>
    a.a == b.a &&
    a.b == b.b &&
    a.c == b.c &&
    a.d == b.d &&
    a.e == b.e &&
    a.f == b.f;

/// The placed units of [copy] (as [copyUnits] lists them) whose transform
/// differs from the same instance's in [design], ascending by handle.
/// Generated units never move alone, so none is listed.
List<ServiceMove> serviceMovesOf(
    DraftDocument design, DraftDocument copy, UnitIndex copyUnits) {
  final out = <ServiceMove>[];
  for (final u in copyUnits.units) {
    if (u.generated) continue;
    final moved = copy.tree[u.instance];
    final designed = design.tree[u.instance];
    if (moved is! InstanceNode || designed is! InstanceNode) continue;
    if (sameTransform(moved.transform, designed.transform)) continue;
    out.add(ServiceMove(
        handle: u.instance,
        label: u.text,
        from: designed.transform,
        to: moved.transform));
  }
  return out;
}

/// [moves] and [groups] as the record's JSON, in the given orders.
String encodeServiceRecord(
        List<ServiceMove> moves, Map<String, UnitGroup> groups) =>
    jsonEncode({
      'format': kServiceFormat,
      'version': kServiceVersion,
      'moves': [
        for (final m in moves)
          {
            'handle': m.handle.toHex(),
            'label': m.label,
            'from': m.from.toJson(),
            'to': m.to.toJson(),
          }
      ],
      'groups': [
        for (final MapEntry(key: id, value: g) in groups.entries)
          {
            'id': id,
            'members': [...g.members],
            'label': g.label,
          }
      ],
    });

/// The record [text]. Throws a [FormatException] unless it is a version-1
/// `jet_cad.service` record: its moves as today's layout entries (a
/// hexadecimal handle, a string or null label, six numbers in each of
/// `from` and `to`, no handle twice), its groups objects with a string
/// `id`, a list of string `members` and a string or null `label`. Values
/// are not checked for finiteness, nor groups against the validation:
/// [matchServiceMoves] and [matchServiceGroups] drop such entries.
ServiceRecord decodeServiceRecord(String text) {
  Never bad(String why) => throw FormatException('Not a service record: $why');
  final Object? json;
  try {
    json = jsonDecode(text);
  } on FormatException catch (e) {
    bad(e.message);
  }
  if (json is! Map<String, Object?>) bad('not an object');
  if (json['format'] != kServiceFormat) bad('format');
  if (json['version'] != kServiceVersion) bad('version');
  final moves = json['moves'];
  if (moves is! List<Object?>) bad('moves');
  final groups = json['groups'];
  if (groups is! List<Object?>) bad('groups');
  Transform2 transform(Object? v, String name) {
    if (v is! List<Object?> || v.length != 6 || v.any((x) => x is! num)) {
      bad(name);
    }
    // The web writes `1` where the VM writes `1.0` (V-21).
    final d = [for (final x in v) (x! as num).toDouble()];
    return Transform2(d[0], d[1], d[2], d[3], d[4], d[5]);
  }

  final seen = <Handle>{};
  final outMoves = <ServiceMove>[];
  for (final m in moves) {
    if (m is! Map<String, Object?>) bad('a move');
    final hex = m['handle'];
    if (hex is! String) bad('a handle');
    final Handle handle;
    try {
      handle = Handle.parseHex(hex);
    } on HandleRangeError {
      bad('a handle');
    }
    if (!seen.add(handle)) bad('handle $hex twice');
    final label = m['label'];
    if (label != null && label is! String) bad('a label');
    outMoves.add(ServiceMove(
        handle: handle,
        label: label as String?,
        from: transform(m['from'], 'from'),
        to: transform(m['to'], 'to')));
  }
  final outGroups = <RecordGroup>[];
  for (final g in groups) {
    if (g is! Map<String, Object?>) bad('a group');
    final id = g['id'];
    if (id is! String) bad('a group id');
    final members = g['members'];
    if (members is! List<Object?> || members.any((m) => m is! String)) {
      bad('a group\'s members');
    }
    final label = g['label'];
    if (label != null && label is! String) bad('a group label');
    outGroups.add(RecordGroup(
        id: id,
        members: List.unmodifiable(members.cast<String>()),
        label: label as String?));
  }
  return ServiceRecord(
      moves: List.unmodifiable(outMoves), groups: List.unmodifiable(outGroups));
}

/// The moves of a record that apply to a design, and those dropped.
typedef ServiceMoveMatch = ({
  List<ServiceMove> applied,
  List<ServiceMove> dropped,
});

/// Splits [moves] by the strict match against [design] (spec S3): a move
/// applies iff its handle is a placed unit of [designUnits] that no lock
/// covers (`isLockedUnit`), on a visible, unlocked layer (a missing layer
/// counts as visible), carrying the same label, at exactly
/// [ServiceMove.from], and [ServiceMove.to] only translates it (the same
/// linear part) with every value finite.
ServiceMoveMatch matchServiceMoves(
    DraftDocument design, UnitIndex designUnits, List<ServiceMove> moves) {
  final applied = <ServiceMove>[];
  final dropped = <ServiceMove>[];
  for (final e in moves) {
    final unit = designUnits[e.handle];
    final node = design.tree[e.handle];
    final layer =
        node is InstanceNode ? design.tables.layers[node.layer] : null;
    final ok = unit != null &&
        !unit.generated &&
        !unit.locked &&
        node is InstanceNode &&
        (layer == null || (layer.visible && !layer.locked)) &&
        unit.text == e.label &&
        sameTransform(node.transform, e.from) &&
        _finite(e.from) &&
        _finite(e.to) &&
        e.to.a == e.from.a &&
        e.to.b == e.from.b &&
        e.to.c == e.from.c &&
        e.to.d == e.from.d;
    (ok ? applied : dropped).add(e);
  }
  return (applied: applied, dropped: dropped);
}

bool _finite(Transform2 t) =>
    t.a.isFinite &&
    t.b.isFinite &&
    t.c.isFinite &&
    t.d.isFinite &&
    t.e.isFinite &&
    t.f.isFinite;

/// The groups of a record that apply, and the ids applied and dropped.
typedef ServiceGroupMatch = ({
  Map<String, UnitGroup> applied,
  List<String> appliedIds,
  List<String> droppedIds,
});

/// Applies [groups] in record order, each whole or not at all (spec S3):
/// a group is dropped when its trimmed id is blank or that of a group
/// applied before it, when it has no member after trimming, when a member
/// names no unit of [designUnits] (any unit carrying the label), or when a
/// member is in a group applied before it. The ids are trimmed.
ServiceGroupMatch matchServiceGroups(
    List<RecordGroup> groups, UnitIndex designUnits) {
  final applied = <String, UnitGroup>{};
  final owner = <String, String>{};
  final appliedIds = <String>[];
  final droppedIds = <String>[];
  for (final r in groups) {
    final id = r.id.trim();
    final group = UnitGroup(members: r.members.toSet(), label: r.label);
    final ok = id.isNotEmpty &&
        !applied.containsKey(id) &&
        group.members.isNotEmpty &&
        group.members.every((m) => designUnits.withLabel(m).isNotEmpty) &&
        group.members.every((m) => !owner.containsKey(m));
    if (!ok) {
      droppedIds.add(id);
      continue;
    }
    applied[id] = group;
    appliedIds.add(id);
    for (final m in group.members) {
      owner[m] = id;
    }
  }
  return (
    applied: Map.unmodifiable(applied),
    appliedIds: appliedIds,
    droppedIds: droppedIds,
  );
}

/// What `PlanController.restoreService` did (spec S3): the labels of the
/// moves it applied and dropped, in record order (an unlabelled unit's is
/// null, so a label may repeat and the lengths are the counts), and the
/// ids of the groups it applied and dropped, in record order.
@immutable
final class ServiceRestore {
  ServiceRestore(
      {required List<String?> appliedMoves,
      required List<String?> droppedMoves,
      required List<String> appliedGroups,
      required List<String> droppedGroups})
      : appliedMoves = List.unmodifiable(appliedMoves),
        droppedMoves = List.unmodifiable(droppedMoves),
        appliedGroups = List.unmodifiable(appliedGroups),
        droppedGroups = List.unmodifiable(droppedGroups);

  final List<String?> appliedMoves, droppedMoves;
  final List<String> appliedGroups, droppedGroups;

  @override
  String toString() => 'ServiceRestore(moves: $appliedMoves, dropped '
      '$droppedMoves; groups: $appliedGroups, dropped $droppedGroups)';
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The controller.** In `lib/src/controller/plan_controller.dart`, import `'../service/service_record.dart'`, then:
  1. Add the section (today's `floor_plan_controller.dart:1092-1164`, `:1288-1303`, `:1425-1436`):

```dart
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The service record (spec 2b S3, decision 4).

  final _Requests _serviceChanges = _Requests();

  /// The active copy's history state last announced on [serviceChanges]:
  /// an undo is announced at once and again by the change stream, which is
  /// heard once.
  int? _announced;

  /// The groups held when service was entered (or the copy rebuilt by a
  /// load or a new plan; none after a reset): what [serviceEdited]
  /// compares the groups with.
  Map<String, UnitGroup> _groupsAtEnter = const {};

  /// Whether service has something to record: the copy has a placed unit
  /// away from its design place, or the groups differ from those held when
  /// service was entered. Not the undo depth. Surveys the copy at each
  /// read: read it on a change, not per frame. False in design.
  bool get serviceEdited {
    final s = _service;
    if (s == null) return false;
    return serviceMovesOf(document, s.document, s.units.current).isNotEmpty ||
        !mapEquals(_groups.value, _groupsAtEnter);
  }

  /// Fires after a move, an undo or a redo of the copy (for [undo] and
  /// [redo], before they return), [resetService], [restoreService], and
  /// [setUnitGroups] in service. Never on [setMode], [load] or [newPlan],
  /// so a host that saves [serviceJson] on it never overwrites its record
  /// with the empty one a new copy starts with.
  Listenable get serviceChanges => _serviceChanges;

  /// The service record as JSON (spec S3): the placed units moved away
  /// from the design, ascending by handle, and the groups. Null in design.
  String? serviceJson() {
    settlePendingInput();
    final s = _service;
    if (s == null) return null;
    return encodeServiceRecord(
        serviceMovesOf(document, s.document, s.units.current), _groups.value);
  }

  /// Puts a stored record back (spec S3): service only (a [StateError] in
  /// design). A [json] that is not a version-1 `jet_cad.service` record
  /// throws a [FormatException] and changes nothing. Otherwise the copy is
  /// rebuilt from the design, every move of the strict match applied and
  /// the copy's history cleared (Undo does not remove them), and the
  /// groups **replaced** by the record's that apply, each whole or not at
  /// all. The focus is kept; the selection is selected again by label;
  /// [revision] moves; [serviceChanges] fires.
  ServiceRestore restoreService(String json) {
    final old = _service;
    if (old == null) {
      throw StateError('restoreService needs the service mode (spec 2b S3)');
    }
    final record = decodeServiceRecord(json);
    settlePendingInput();
    _refreshSelected();
    final labels = _selectedUnits.value;
    final designUnits = _session.units.current;
    final moves = matchServiceMoves(document, designUnits, record.moves);
    final groups = matchServiceGroups(record.groups, designUnits);
    final next = _buildService();
    if (moves.applied.isNotEmpty) {
      final commands = next.document.commands;
      try {
        commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
          for (final m in moves.applied) TransformNodeCommand(m.handle, m.to)
        ], label: 'Restore'));
      } catch (_) {
        next.dispose();
        rethrow;
      }
      // The restore is the copy's floor, no step (today's C16).
      commands.clearHistory();
    }
    _attachService(next);
    _service = next;
    _dropService(old);
    _groups.value = groups.applied;
    _select(labels);
    _refreshFlags();
    _revision.value++;
    _serviceChanges.bump();
    notifyListeners();
    return ServiceRestore(
        appliedMoves: [for (final m in moves.applied) m.label],
        droppedMoves: [for (final m in moves.dropped) m.label],
        appliedGroups: groups.appliedIds,
        droppedGroups: groups.droppedIds);
  }

  /// Service only: the copy rebuilt from the design, every service move
  /// gone, and the groups cleared (today's `resetLayout` kept them: spec
  /// S5). The selection is kept by label. A silent no-op in design.
  void resetService() {
    final old = _service;
    if (old == null) return;
    settlePendingInput();
    _refreshSelected();
    final labels = _selectedUnits.value;
    final next = _buildService();
    _attachService(next);
    _service = next;
    _dropService(old);
    _groups.value = const <String, UnitGroup>{};
    _groupsAtEnter = const <String, UnitGroup>{};
    _select(labels);
    _refreshFlags();
    _revision.value++;
    _serviceChanges.bump();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Fires [serviceChanges] if the active copy's history moved since it
  /// last did. The change stream is asynchronous: without this, a host
  /// that calls [undo] and then [setMode] in one synchronous step would
  /// never hear the undo (review 14d-2).
  void _announceService() {
    final s = _service;
    if (s == null) return;
    final state = s.document.commands.stateId;
    if (state == _announced) return;
    _announced = state;
    _serviceChanges.bump();
  }

In 2b the session owns the tool controller (Task 11), so the tool reads `session.host`, a `ServiceHost` of read-at-each-call functions that Task 16's `PlanServiceView` sets while its canvas is mounted and puts back to `ServiceHost.none` when it goes (Task 16's design, adopted as written). The controller passes `moves: () => permissions.serviceMove`.

Plan decision (**a drag with seats**, spec S4 "A drag"): the moving set is every selected root key whose unit is **placed** (`UnitInfo.generated` false), plus the selectable members of every group one of them belongs to. A selected seat stays where it is. The drag is spent, the selection untouched (today's rule for a group with a locked member, `T:310-344`), when a group involved has a locked or a generated visible member (Task 12's `hasGeneratedVisibleMember`), or when the moving set is empty (a drag from an unselected seat, or from a seat selected with no placed unit). Known limit, not a defect: the engine strokes a move preview for every selected key the grip cache does not call immovable (`jet_cad_2d_flutter/lib/src/selection_overlay.dart:240-248`), and the copy's `ToolContext` has no grip cache (as today's), so a selected seat's preview outline follows a mixed drag; the seat itself stays.

A band's key for a seat is `SelectionKey.root(seat)` (spec S4); `forEachInstanceInBand` walks the flattened instance list, seats included (spec Facts, `spatial_index.dart:445-488`).

/// [rowOfTables] numbered as today's placer numbered them: `1` … `n` in
/// placement order (`floor_plan/test/service/table_status_painter_test.dart:
/// 59-79` placed them through the numbering placer).
DraftDocument numberedRowOfTables(int n) {
  final doc = rowOfTables(n);
  final instances = [
    for (final node in doc.tree.nodes)
      if (node is InstanceNode) node.handle
  ]..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));
  for (final (i, h) in instances.indexed) {
    addUnitLabel(doc, h, '${i + 1}');
  }
  return doc;
}

/// [design] decoded as a service copy (Task 11's `serviceCopyOf`, today's
/// `_copyOf`): runtime permissions, the plan's components, the handles the
/// design's.
DraftDocument copyForService(DraftDocument design) => serviceCopyOf(design,
    register: (r) => registerPlanComponents(r, ParametricCatalog()),
    measurer: const InsertionPointMeasurer());

```dart
// Drives a controller's service tool with explicit ToolPointerEvents (2b
// Task 14): the controller in service over a plan text, a y-up camera that
// is not the identity (0.1 px/mm, panned), and the host's callbacks logged
// through the session's ServiceHost. World points are the inputs; the
// expectations are the fixture's handles and labels.
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show PointerDeviceKind, kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:flutter/painting.dart' show Offset;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show PlanKit;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/controller/plan_controller.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/service/service_session.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/service/service_tool.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/symbols/symbol_placer.dart'
    show definitionForEntry;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'harness.dart' show planText;
import 'service_fixture.dart' show addRow, testEntry;
import 'test_kit.dart';

// `parts` is Task 11's (`service_plans.dart`), re-exported for the tool
// and paint tests (one owner per helper, controller ruling R-19).
export 'service_plans.dart' show parts;

final class ServiceRig {
  /// [json] loaded over [kits] (`unitKit()` by default); [design] runs on
  /// the design before service is entered.
  ServiceRig(String json,
      {List<PlanKit>? kits, void Function(PlanController c)? design})
      : c = PlanController(kits: kits ?? [unitKit()], json: json) {
    design?.call(c);
    c.setMode(PlanMode.service);
    c.camera.value = ViewportTransform(
        worldToScreenMatrix: const Transform2(0.1, 0, 0, -0.1, 700, 450));
    session.host = ServiceHost(
        callbacks: () => callbacks,
        options: () => options,
        events: () => events);
  }

  final PlanController c;
  ServiceSession get session => c.serviceSession!;
  ServiceTool get tool => session.tool;
  ToolContext get ctx => session.toolContext;
  DraftDocument get doc => session.document;
  Set<SelectionKey> get keys => ctx.selection.keys;

  final List<String> taps = [];
  final List<String> doubleTaps = [];
  final List<String> groupTaps = [];
  final List<(String, Offset)> menus = [];
  final List<List<Handle>> moved = [];
  int layouts = 0;

  late final ServiceCallbacks callbacks = (
    onUnitTap: taps.add,
    onLayoutChanged: () => layouts++,
    onGroupTap: (id, label) => groupTaps.add('$id:$label'),
    onMergeRequested: null,
    onSplitRequested: null,
  );

  ServiceOptions options = kDefaultServiceOptions;

  late final ServiceEvents<Handle> events = (
    onUnitsMoved: moved.add,
    onUnitDoubleTap: doubleTaps.add,
    onFloorTap: null,
    onUnitHover: null,
  );

  /// [options] with a context menu that logs into [menus].
  void withMenu() => options = (
        longPress: options.longPress,
        onUnitContextMenu: (l, p) => menus.add((l, p)),
        floorDrag: options.floorDrag,
      );

  void dispose() => c.dispose();

  InstanceNode node(Handle h) => doc.tree[h]! as InstanceNode;

  SelectionKey key(Handle h) => SelectionKey.root(h);

  /// A world point inside unit [h]'s top: its top box's centre through its
  /// world transform (the fixture's tops are convex).
  Vector2 inside(Handle h) {
    final u = c.unitIndex[h]!;
    final t = u.top;
    return u.toWorld
        .transformPoint(Vector2((t.minX + t.maxX) / 2, (t.minY + t.maxY) / 2));
  }

  /// [h]'s symbol box through its world transform, axis-aligned.
  Aabb2 worldBox(Handle h) {
    final u = c.unitIndex[h]!;
    final b = u.box;
    return Aabb2.fromPoints([
      for (final (x, y) in [
        (b.minX, b.minY),
        (b.maxX, b.minY),
        (b.maxX, b.maxY),
        (b.minX, b.maxY)
      ])
        u.toWorld.transformPoint(Vector2(x, y)),
    ]);
  }

  Offset screen(Vector2 w) {
    final s = c.camera.value.worldToScreen(w);
    return Offset(s.x, s.y);
  }

  ToolPointerEvent ev(Vector2 world,
          {int buttons = kPrimaryButton,
          bool shift = false,
          Duration time = Duration.zero}) =>
      ToolPointerEvent(
        screen: screen(world),
        world: world.clone(),
        pointer: 1,
        buttons: buttons,
        shift: shift,
        control: false,
        meta: false,
        alt: false,
        pickRadiusWorld: 6 / c.camera.value.scale,
        kind: PointerDeviceKind.mouse,
        timeStamp: time,
      );

  void down(Vector2 w, {bool shift = false, Duration time = Duration.zero}) =>
      tool.onPointerDown(ev(w, shift: shift, time: time), ctx);
  void move(Vector2 w) => tool.onPointerMove(ev(w), ctx);
  void up(Vector2 w, {Duration time = Duration.zero}) =>
      tool.onPointerUp(ev(w, buttons: 0, time: time), ctx);

  void tap(Vector2 w, {bool shift = false, Duration time = Duration.zero}) {
    down(w, shift: shift, time: time);
    up(w, time: time + const Duration(milliseconds: 40));
  }

  /// A drag from [from] by [by], in two moves, past the touch slop.
  void drag(Vector2 from, Vector2 by) {
    down(from);
    move(from + by * 0.5);
    move(from + by);
    up(from + by);
  }

  /// A band over world [box] under `PlanFloorDrag.band`: a window from its
  /// upper left to its lower right, or a crossing from its upper right to
  /// its lower left. Its press is on the floor (the caller pads the box off
  /// every unit).
  void band(Aabb2 box, {bool crossing = false}) {
    options = (
      longPress: options.longPress,
      onUnitContextMenu: options.onUnitContextMenu,
      floorDrag: PlanFloorDrag.band,
    );
    final start = Vector2(crossing ? box.maxX : box.minX, box.maxY);
    final end = Vector2(crossing ? box.minX : box.maxX, box.minY);
    down(start);
    move(Vector2((start.x + end.x) / 2, (start.y + end.y) / 2));
    move(end);
    up(end);
  }
}

/// [a] grown by [pad] on every side.
Aabb2 padded(Aabb2 a, double pad) =>
    Aabb2.raw(a.minX - pad, a.minY - pad, a.maxX + pad, a.maxY + pad);

/// The union of [boxes].
Aabb2 unionOf(Iterable<Aabb2> boxes) => Aabb2.fromPoints([
      for (final b in boxes) ...[Vector2(b.minX, b.minY), Vector2(b.maxX, b.maxY)]
    ]);

bool overlaps(Aabb2 a, Aabb2 b) =>
    a.minX <= b.maxX && a.maxX >= b.minX && a.minY <= b.maxY && a.maxY >= b.minY;

/// 2b Review Focus 5: a hall of 25 rows of 20 seats (500 generated units),
/// rows 1.5 m apart from 40 m off the origin, the even rows turned 37
/// degrees, the odd ones curved 0.03 rad a seat; a plan text over
/// [unitKit], every seat generated by the row type (planText installs the
/// kit's system).
String hallJson() => planText([unitKit()], (d) {
      final seat = testEntry(rowSeatKey);
      final made = definitionForEntry(d, seat);
      d.commands.execute(CompoundCommand(made.commands, label: 'Seat'));
      for (var i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
        addRow(
            d,
            RowComponent(
                prefix: String.fromCharCode(0x41 + i),
                count: 20,
                spacing: 600,
                curve: i.isOdd ? 0.03 : 0,
                seat: made.definition,
                base: seat.definition.basePoint,
                top: entryTop(seat)),
            at: Vector2(40000, -27000 - 1500.0 * i),
            angle: i.isEven ? 37 * math.pi / 180 : 0);
      }
    });

/// A controller over [hallJson], in service. The caller disposes it.
PlanController hallController() {
  final c = PlanController(kits: [unitKit()], json: hallJson());
  c.setMode(PlanMode.service);
  return c;
}
```

// 2b spec S4 "The service tool", "A drag"; S2 "Locked units", "Unlabelled,
// duplicate and bad labels"; Review Focus 4: the service tool over placed
// and generated units, on the controller's service copy. The fixture is
// Task 5's serviceFixture(): a table a quarter turn and mirrored off the
// origin, row A (six seats) turned, row B (five seats) curved, all off the
// origin.
import 'package:flutter/painting.dart' show Offset;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show PlanKit, kUnitLabelTag;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/controller/plan_controller.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/service/service_state.dart'
    show UnitGroup;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/service/service_tool.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/service_fixture.dart';
import '../support/service_rig.dart';

/// [json] in service over `unitKit()`, or over no kit ([missingKit]: the
/// table and both rows are then held by the lock set).
ServiceRig rig(String json,
    {bool missingKit = false, void Function(PlanController c)? design}) {
  final r = ServiceRig(json,
      kits: missingKit ? const <PlanKit>[] : null, design: design);
  addTearDown(r.dispose);
  return r;
}

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'ST-seat a seat is picked, selected alone and reported by its label; '
      'a seat in a group selects the group and reports it (M-ST-seat)',
      (tester) async {
    final f = serviceFixture();
    final r = rig(f.json);
    final a3 = f.seatsA[2], b2 = f.seatsB[1], b3 = f.seatsB[2];
    expect(r.c.unitIndex[a3]!.generated, isTrue, reason: 'premise: a seat');
    r.c.setUnitGroups({
      'g': UnitGroup(members: {'B2', 'B3'})
    });

    r.tap(r.inside(a3));
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(a3)});
    expect(r.taps, ['A3']);
    expect(r.c.selectedUnits.value, {'A3'});

    r.tap(r.inside(b2), time: const Duration(seconds: 1));
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(b2), r.key(b3)});
    expect(r.taps, ['A3', 'B2']);
    expect(r.groupTaps, ['g:B2']);
  });

  testWidgets(
      'ST-mixed-drag a drag from the table with two seats selected moves the '
      'table alone, translation only, one step; the seats stay '
      '(M-ST-mixed)', (tester) async {
    final f = serviceFixture();
    final r = rig(f.json);
    final t = f.table, a1 = f.seatsA[0], a2 = f.seatsA[1];
    r.tap(r.inside(t));
    r.tap(r.inside(a1), shift: true);
    r.tap(r.inside(a2), shift: true);
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(t), r.key(a1), r.key(a2)}, reason: 'premise');
    final table0 = parts(r.node(t).transform);
    final seats0 = [parts(r.node(a1).transform), parts(r.node(a2).transform)];
    final from = r.inside(t);
    final by = Vector2(600, -300);
    final dx = (from.x + by.x) - from.x, dy = (from.y + by.y) - from.y;

    r.drag(from, by);
    expect(parts(r.node(t).transform),
        [...table0.take(4), table0[4] + dx, table0[5] + dy]);
    expect(parts(r.node(a1).transform), seats0[0]);
    expect(parts(r.node(a2).transform), seats0[1]);
    expect(r.layouts, 1);
    expect(r.moved, [
      [t]
    ]);
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(t), r.key(a1), r.key(a2)},
        reason: 'the selection is kept');
  });

  testWidgets(
      'ST-group-seat a group mixing the table and a seat is never dragged: '
      'the drag is spent, nothing moves, the selection is kept '
      '(M-ST-group)', (tester) async {
    final f = serviceFixture();
    final r = rig(f.json);
    final t = f.table, a1 = f.seatsA[0];
    final label = r.c.unitIndex[t]!.text!;
    r.c.setUnitGroups({
      'g': UnitGroup(members: {label, 'A1'})
    });
    r.tap(r.inside(t));
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(t), r.key(a1)}, reason: 'premise: the group');
    final table0 = parts(r.node(t).transform);

    r.drag(r.inside(t), Vector2(600, -300));
    expect(parts(r.node(t).transform), table0);
    expect(r.layouts, 0);
    expect(r.moved, isEmpty);
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(t), r.key(a1)});
  });

  testWidgets(
      'ST-locked-seat Review Focus 4: the kit missing, a seat is tapped and '
      'reported with its group, never selected by a tap, a long press, a '
      'band or a context click, never dragged (M-ST-locked)', (tester) async {
    final f = serviceFixture();
    final r = rig(f.json, missingKit: true);
    final a2 = f.seatsA[1];
    expect(r.c.unitIndex[a2]!.locked, isTrue, reason: 'premise: locked');
    expect(r.c.unitIndex[a2]!.generated, isTrue, reason: 'premise: a seat');
    r.c.setUnitGroups({
      'g': UnitGroup(members: {'A2', 'A3'})
    });

    r.tap(r.inside(a2));
    expect(r.taps, ['A2']);
    expect(r.groupTaps, ['g:A2']);
    expect(r.keys, isEmpty, reason: 'a tap selects nothing');

    // Under toggle a locked press starts no timer (T:236-243): held past
    // the long press, it is a tap.
    r.down(r.inside(a2), time: const Duration(seconds: 2));
    await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    r.up(r.inside(a2), time: const Duration(seconds: 3));
    expect(r.keys, isEmpty, reason: 'a long press selects nothing');

    r.band(padded(unionOf([for (final s in f.seatsA) r.worldBox(s)]), 400),
        crossing: true);
    expect(r.keys, isEmpty, reason: 'a band selects nothing');

    r.withMenu();
    r.tool.secondaryClick(r.inside(a2), const Offset(12, 34), r.ctx.selection);
    expect(r.menus, [('A2', const Offset(12, 34))]);
    expect(r.keys, isEmpty, reason: 'a context click selects nothing');

    r.options = kDefaultServiceOptions;
    final seat0 = parts(r.node(a2).transform);
    r.drag(r.inside(a2), Vector2(600, -300));
    expect(parts(r.node(a2).transform), seat0);
    expect(r.layouts, 0);
    expect(r.moved, isEmpty);
  });

  testWidgets(
      'ST-unlabelled an unlabelled table is selected by a tap and dragged, '
      'reported by onUnitsMoved, never by a label-keyed callback '
      '(M-ST-unlabelled)', (tester) async {
    final f = serviceFixture();
    final r = rig(f.json, design: (c) {
      for (final (label, _) in unitLabelsOf(c.document, f.table)) {
        expect(c.execute(SetEntityTextCommand(label, '', kUnitLabelTag)),
            isTrue);
      }
    });
    final t = f.table;
    expect(r.c.unitIndex[t]!.text, isNull, reason: 'premise: unlabelled');

    r.tap(r.inside(t));
    r.tap(r.inside(t), time: const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(t)});
    expect(r.taps, isEmpty);
    expect(r.doubleTaps, isEmpty);

    r.drag(r.inside(t), Vector2(600, -300));
    expect(r.layouts, 1);
    expect(r.moved, [
      [t]
    ]);
  });

  testWidgets(
      'ST-band-two-rows a crossing band over both rows takes every seat of '
      'both as a root key and not the table; a window round row B takes row '
      'B\'s seats alone (M-ST-band)', (tester) async {
    final f = serviceFixture();
    final r = rig(f.json);
    final rows = unionOf([
      for (final s in [...f.seatsA, ...f.seatsB]) r.worldBox(s)
    ]);
    final rowB = unionOf([for (final s in f.seatsB) r.worldBox(s)]);
    expect(overlaps(padded(rows, 50), r.worldBox(f.table)), isFalse,
        reason: 'premise: the table lies off both rows');
    for (final s in f.seatsA) {
      expect(overlaps(padded(rowB, 50), r.worldBox(s)), isFalse,
          reason: 'premise: row A lies off row B\'s window');
    }

    r.band(padded(rows, 50), crossing: true);
    expect(r.keys, {
      for (final s in [...f.seatsA, ...f.seatsB]) r.key(s)
    });

    r.band(padded(rowB, 50));
    expect(r.keys, {for (final s in f.seatsB) r.key(s)});
  });

  testWidgets(
      'ST-secondary a context click on an unselected seat selects it alone '
      'and reports its label; on a selected unit it keeps the selection; '
      'with no menu it does nothing (M-ST-secondary)', (tester) async {
    final f = serviceFixture();
    final r = rig(f.json);
    final a1 = f.seatsA[0], t = f.table;
    r.withMenu();
    r.tool.secondaryClick(r.inside(a1), const Offset(5, 6), r.ctx.selection);
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(a1)});
    expect(r.menus, [('A1', const Offset(5, 6))]);

    r.tap(r.inside(t), shift: true);
    final label = r.c.unitIndex[t]!.text!;
    r.tool.secondaryClick(r.inside(t), const Offset(7, 8), r.ctx.selection);
    expect(r.keys, {r.key(a1), r.key(t)}, reason: 'a selected unit keeps it');
    expect(r.menus.last, (label, const Offset(7, 8)));

    r.options = kDefaultServiceOptions;
    r.ctx.selection.clear();
    r.tool.secondaryClick(r.inside(a1), const Offset(5, 6), r.ctx.selection);
    expect(r.keys, isEmpty, reason: 'no menu: nothing');
    expect(r.menus, hasLength(2));
  });

  testWidgets(
      'ST-move-gate serviceMove false: a drag from the table pans, the '
      'table stays; the permission is read at each press (M-ST-gate)',
      (tester) async {
    final f = serviceFixture();
    final r = rig(f.json);
    final t = f.table;
    final table0 = parts(r.node(t).transform);
    r.c.permissions = r.c.permissions.copyWith(serviceMove: false);
    final camera0 = parts(r.c.camera.value.worldToScreenMatrix);

    r.drag(r.inside(t), Vector2(600, -300));
    expect(parts(r.node(t).transform), table0);
    expect(r.layouts, 0);
    expect(parts(r.c.camera.value.worldToScreenMatrix), isNot(camera0),
        reason: 'the drag panned');

    r.c.permissions = r.c.permissions.copyWith(serviceMove: true);
    r.drag(r.inside(t), Vector2(600, -300));
    expect(r.layouts, 1, reason: 'read again at the next press');
  });
}

/// What a long press on a unit does in service (today's FloorPlanLongPress).
enum PlanLongPress {
  /// Adds the unit to the selection or removes it (a group whole).
  toggleSelection,

  /// Reports the unit to `onUnitContextMenu`, as a secondary click does.
  contextMenu,
}

/// What a drag on the floor does in service (today's FloorPlanFloorDrag).
enum PlanFloorDrag {
  /// The camera pans; Shift, Ctrl or Cmd with a mouse or stylus bands.
  pan,

  /// A band selects: left to right the units wholly inside, right to left
  /// those it touches. The camera pans with two fingers, a trackpad's
  /// scroll or the middle button.
  band,
}

```dart
/// What the tool and the service bar tell their host, read at each call
/// (R-5). [onMergeRequested] and [onSplitRequested] are the service bar's.
typedef ServiceCallbacks = ({
  void Function(String label)? onUnitTap,
  void Function()? onLayoutChanged,
  void Function(String groupId, String label)? onGroupTap,
  void Function(Set<String> labels)? onMergeRequested,
  void Function(String groupId)? onSplitRequested,
});

/// No callback.
const ServiceCallbacks kNoServiceCallbacks = (
  onUnitTap: null,
  onLayoutChanged: null,
  onGroupTap: null,
  onMergeRequested: null,
  onSplitRequested: null,
);

/// The view's options for the tool, read at each press;
/// [onUnitContextMenu] takes a global position. Moves are the permission
/// `serviceMove` (spec S4), read through the tool's `moves`.
typedef ServiceOptions = ({
  PlanLongPress longPress,
  void Function(String label, Offset globalPosition)? onUnitContextMenu,
  PlanFloorDrag floorDrag,
});

/// Today's behaviour: a long press toggles, no menu, a floor drag pans.
const ServiceOptions kDefaultServiceOptions = (
  longPress: PlanLongPress.toggleSelection,
  onUnitContextMenu: null,
  floorDrag: PlanFloorDrag.pan,
);

/// The view events, read at each call (R-5). [M] is what a drag reports as
/// moved: the live instances at the tool, the controller's fresh details at
/// the view (Task 16).
typedef ServiceEvents<M> = ({
  void Function(List<M> moved)? onUnitsMoved,
  void Function(String label)? onUnitDoubleTap,
  void Function(Offset world)? onFloorTap,
  void Function(String? label)? onUnitHover,
});

/// No view event. Its fields are `Null`, so it is a [ServiceEvents] whatever
/// its type argument.
const kNoServiceEvents = (
  onUnitsMoved: null,
  onUnitDoubleTap: null,
  onFloorTap: null,
  onUnitHover: null,
);

ServiceCallbacks _noCallbacks() => kNoServiceCallbacks;
ServiceOptions _defaultOptions() => kDefaultServiceOptions;
ServiceEvents<Handle> _noEvents() => kNoServiceEvents;
Offset _sameOffset(Offset local) => local;
bool _always() => true;

/// What a service session's tool reads from the view that shows the
/// session, at each call (2b; today's ServiceView closures,
/// service_view.dart:133-142). The view sets one on `ServiceSession.host`
/// while its canvas is mounted; [none] is today's behaviour with no view.
final class ServiceHost {
  const ServiceHost({
    this.callbacks = _noCallbacks,
    this.options = _defaultOptions,
    this.userCamera = _always,
    this.toGlobal = _sameOffset,
    this.events = _noEvents,
    this.idleKeys = _always,
  });

  /// No view: no callback, today's options, a free camera, the local
  /// offset, the keys bound.
  static const ServiceHost none = ServiceHost();

  final ServiceCallbacks Function() callbacks;
  final ServiceOptions Function() options;

  /// Whether a drag on the floor pans (host embedding API spec G-3).
  final bool Function() userCamera;

  /// The layer's local point as a global one, for a context menu.
  final Offset Function(Offset local) toGlobal;

  /// Read at each button-less move: a view hands back a record it keeps.
  final ServiceEvents<Handle> Function() events;

  /// Whether the tool's idle Escape acts (spec C-7, S-16).
  final bool Function() idleKeys;
}

```dart
/// A context gesture's selection (spec 14d S6): an unselected, unlocked
/// unit becomes the selection alone -- or, a member of a group, its
/// [group]'s selectable members -- a selected one keeps the selection, a
/// locked one changes nothing. Returns the unit's label, which the host is
/// told when it is not null.
String? contextSelect(UnitInfo hit, SelectionController selection,
    {Set<SelectionKey>? group}) {
  if (!hit.locked) {
    final key = SelectionKey.root(hit.instance);
    if (!selection.keys.contains(key)) selection.replace(group ?? [key]);
  }
  return hit.text;
}

  10. `_startDrag` (`T:310-344`):

```dart
  /// The drag's start (S4, G4; 2b S4 "A drag"): an unselected unit, or its
  /// whole group, replaces the selection; what moves is every selected
  /// placed unit, each group having a member among them taken whole. A
  /// selected seat stays where it is. False, with the selection untouched,
  /// when such a group has a locked or a generated visible member, or when
  /// no placed unit would move: the drag is then spent.
  bool _startDrag(UnitInfo hit, ToolContext ctx) {
    final key = SelectionKey.root(hit.instance);
    // With no group every unit stands alone, as before groups (G7).
    final lookup = _groupLookup();
    final groupOf = lookup == null ? const <Handle, String>{} : _groupByHandle;
    final hitGroup = groupOf[hit.instance];
    final replace = !ctx.selection.keys.contains(key);
    final selected = !replace
        ? ctx.selection.keys
        : hitGroup == null
            ? {key}
            : _memberKeys(lookup!, hitGroup);
    final index = picker.units.current;
    final roots = [
      for (final k in selected)
        if (k.chain.isEmpty && !(index[k.target]?.generated ?? false))
          k.target
    ];
    final involved = <String>{
      for (final h in roots)
        if (groupOf[h] case final id?) id
    };
    if (roots.isEmpty ||
        involved.any((id) =>
            lookup!.hasLockedVisibleMember(id) ||
            lookup.hasGeneratedVisibleMember(id))) {
      return false;
    }
    if (replace) ctx.selection.replace(selected);
    _moving = _sorted({
      ...roots,
      for (final id in involved)
        for (final t in lookup!.selectableMembers(id)) t.handle,
    });
    _gesture = _Gesture.dragging;
    return true;
  }
```

  /// The band's keys (RB-3), ascending by handle: a seat's a root key too
  /// (2b S4). `snapping`, not `picking`: a locked layer's unit reaches the
  /// window's group rule (review V-1); a locked unit is never a key.
  List<SelectionKey> _bandKeys(Aabb2 world, BandMode mode, ToolContext ctx) {
    final byHandle = _units();
    final passing = <Handle>{};
    ctx.index.forEachInstanceInBand(world, mode, const QueryFilter.snapping(),
        (h) {
      if (byHandle.containsKey(h)) passing.add(h);
    });

  15. `_groupLookup` (`T:540-567`) becomes the code below, with `_units` beside it:

```dart
  /// The picker's candidates by instance (see [_byHandle]).
  Map<Handle, UnitInfo> _units() {
    final candidates = picker.candidates;
    if (!identical(_byHandleFor, candidates)) {
      _byHandle = {for (final c in candidates) c.unit.instance: c.unit};
      _byHandleFor = candidates;
    }
    return _byHandle;
  }

  /// The group lookup over the picker's current candidates, or null while
  /// the host has no group (then every gesture is as before groups).
  UnitGroupLookup? _groupLookup() {
    final map = groups.value;
    if (map.isEmpty) return null;
    final candidates = picker.candidates;
    if (_lookup == null ||
        !identical(_lookupCandidates, candidates) ||
        !identical(_lookupGroups, map)) {
      // The picker lists visible units only; a locked one is listed.
      final lookup = UnitGroupLookup(map, [
        for (final c in candidates)
          GroupUnit(
              handle: c.unit.instance,
              label: c.unit.text,
              visible: true,
              locked: c.unit.locked,
              generated: c.unit.generated),
      ]);
      _lookup = lookup;
      _groupByHandle = {
        for (final id in map.keys)
          for (final t in lookup.visibleMembers(id)) t.handle: id,
      };
      _lookupCandidates = candidates;
      _lookupGroups = map;
    }
    return _lookup;
  }
```

  /// A secondary click at [world] that the view's listener let through
  /// (spec 14d S6; today's `ServiceView._onSecondaryUp`, service_view.dart:
  /// 212-227): with no `onUnitContextMenu` nothing, not even a pick; else
  /// the unit there takes [contextSelect]'s selection and, labelled, is
  /// reported at [globalPosition].
  void secondaryClick(
      Vector2 world, Offset globalPosition, SelectionController selection) {
    final report = options().onUnitContextMenu;
    if (report == null) return;
    final hit = picker.pick(world);
    if (hit == null) return;
    final label = contextSelect(hit, selection, group: groupKeysOf(hit));
    if (label != null) report(label, globalPosition);
  }
```
